verses.text: Aya ni amajambo ya Yeremiya mwene Hilukiya, umwe mu baherezi baba ahantu hitwa Anatoti mu ntara ya Benyamini.
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri we mu mwaka ugira cumi na gatatu Yosiya mwene Amoni umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma,

no ku ngoma ya Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda. Ryongeye gutumwa kuri we mu kwezi kwa gatanu kw’umwaka ugira icumi na rimwe Zedekiya mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, kandi ico gihe ni ho abantu b’i Yerusalemu batwarwa ari inyagano mu mahanga.
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryanjeko, riti:
“Ntarakubumbira mu nda nari ndakuzi, n’imbere y’uko uvuka nari naramaze kukurobanura; naguhisemwo ngo ube umuvugishwa wanje ku mahanga.”
Ndavuga nti: “Ewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, jewe sinzi kuvuga, kandi ndacari muto.”
Ariko Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Reka kuvuga uti: ‘Ndacari muto.’ Uzoja ku wo nzogutumako umubwire ico nzogutuma cose.
Ntuze ubatinye, kuko ndi kumwe nawe kandi nzogutabara,” ni jewe Uhoraho mbivuze.
Maze Uhoraho azana ukuboko kwiwe ankora ku munwa ambwira ati: “Ehe, nshize amajambo yanje mu kanwa kawe.
Ehe, uwu musi ndagutumye ku mahanga no ku bwami kurandura no gusambura, gutikiza no gusangangura, kwubaka no guteragira.”
Hanyuma Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryongera kunzako riti: “Ubona iki, ga Yeremiya?” Ndishura nti: “Mbona ishami ry’igiti ca alumonde.”
Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Ivyo ubonye ni vyo, kuko nteramira ijambo ryanje kugira ngo mbone ko rishitse.”
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rinzako kandi riti: “Ubona iki?” Ndishura nti: “Mbona inkono iriko irabira, iri ku ruhande rwo mu buraruko.”
Uhoraho ambwira ati: “Ivyago bizoza bivuye mu buraruko bije ku baba muri iki gihugu bose.

Ngira mpamagare amahanga yose y’abami bo mu buraruko,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Abami baho bazoza bashinge intebe zabo z’ubwami ku marembo y’i Yerusalemu; bazoza kugwanya inzitiro zihakikije zose n’ibisagara vy’i Buyuda vyose.
Nzocira imanza abantu banje kubera ububi bwabo berekanye mu kumpeba, bagaturirira ibimota neza izindi mana kandi bagasenga ivyabajwe n’amaboko yabo.”
“None rero, wewe niwitegure! Va hasi ubabwire ivyo nzogutegeka vyose. Ntuze uterwe ubwoba na bo, kugira ngo sinze ndaguteze ubwoba imbere yabo.

Uyu musi ndaguhinduye igisagara kizitijwe inzitiro, inkingi y’icuma n’uruhome rw’umwakaka ngo uhagarare uhange iki gihugu cose; uhange abami b’i Buyuda, abaganwa baho, abaherezi baho n’abantu bo mu gihugu.
Bazokugwanya ariko ntibazogutsinda, kuko ndi kumwe nawe ngo ngutabare,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rinzako riti:
“Genda umenyeshe ab’i Yerusalemu uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Ndibuka ubwizigirwa bwawe ukiri muto, uburyo wankunda ukiri umugeni, ukankurikira mu bugaragwa, mu gihugu kitamera.
Isirayeli yari uwera k’ Uhoraho , yari ivyeze imbere y’ibindi mu vyimburwa vyiwe; abamukorako bose baba bancumuyeko, kandi icago caca kibahwikira,’ ” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yemwe abakomoka kuri Yakobo, na mwebwe mwese nzu za Isirayeli.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Ba sogokuruza banyu nabacumuyeko iki, catumye baguma kure yanje? Bakurikiye ibigirwamana bitagira ikimazi, na bo baba abatagira ikimazi.

Ntibabajije bati: ‘ Uhoraho ari hehe, umwe yatudugana adukuye muri Egiputa akaturongora mu bugaragwa bwumye ata kintu na kimwe kihamera, mu gihugu c’ubugaragwa n’ibihomoka, igihugu cumye c’umwijima, igihugu kitagendwa kandi kitabamwo abantu?’
Nakuzanye mu gihugu kimera ngo urye ivyamwa vyaco n’ivyimburwa vyaco. Ariko waraje uhumanya igihugu canje uhindura ishamvu yanje aho kwankwa.

Abaherezi ntibabajije bati: ‘ Uhoraho ari he?’ Abari bashinzwe Ivyagezwe ntibigeze bamenya, abarongozi barangararije. Abavugishwa na bo bavugishwa mw’izina rya Bayali, bakurikira ibigirwamana bitagira ikimazi.
Ni co gituma nzokwongera kubaburanya,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Nzoburanya abana b’abana bawe.
Jabuka uje i Kupuro urabe, rungika intumwa i Kedari wihweze neza; raba ko higeze kuba ikintu nk’iki:
Mbega hari ihanga ryigeze rihindura imana zaryo, naho atari imana mu vy’ukuri? Ariko abantu banje, jewe Imana y’Ubwiza bangujije n’ibigirwamana bitagira ikimazi.
Kubera ivyo, nimuhinde agashitsi, yemwe mwa majuru, mugire ubwoba mutangare,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Abantu banje bakoze ivyaha bibiri: barampevye, jewe soko y’amazi y’ubugingo, maze biyimbira ibinogo vyo kubika amazi, ibinogo vyatobaguritse bidashobora kuzigama amazi.
Mbega Isirayeli ni umushumba, ni umugurano kuva akivuka? None ni kuki yahindutse uwo gusahurwa?
Intambwe zarivuze; zikamutontomera. Zahinduye igihugu ciwe umusaka; ibisagara vyiwe vyaraturiwe kandi nta bantu bakibibamwo.
Kandi, Abanyegiputa b’i Memfisi n’i Tafanihesi bakumenye umutwe.
Mbega vyose si wewe wavyikwegeye mu guheba Uhoraho Imana yawe igihe yakurongorera mu nzira?
None ni kuki uja muri Egiputa kunywa amazi y’uruzi Nili? Kandi ni kuki uja muri Ashuri Kunywa amazi y’uruzi Efurate?

Ubugarariji bwawe ni bwo buzoguhana; gusubira inyuma kwawe ni kwo kuzogutsinda. Iyumvire rero umenye ingene ari bibi kandi bibishe kuri wewe guheba Uhoraho Imana yawe kuko ata kuntinya kuri muri wewe,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
“Hashize igihe kirekire waravunye ingogo yawe, waraciye iminyororo yawe. Waravuze uti: ‘sinzogukorera!’ Ni ukuri, ku musozi wose muremure no musi y’igiti cose gitotahaye ni ho wiryamira nka maraya.
Nari naguteye uri umuzabibu w’indobanurwa wavuye mu mbuto nziza zo kwizigirwa. None ni kuki wambereye nabi ugahinduka umuzabibu w’ikijakija wo mw’ishamba?
Naho wokwiyogesha isabuni nziza cane, ugakoresha ivyo kwinyukura bikomeye, umwanda wo kugabitanya kwawe woguma imbere yanje,” ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze.
“Wovuga gute ngo: ‘Simpumanye; sinahurumbiye za Bayali’? Raba uko wigenjeje mu kiyaya; raba ivyo wakoze. Uri ingamiya y’ingore inyaruka yiruka hirya no hino,

indogoba y’inyeshamba yamenyereye ubugaragwa, yumviriza mu muyaga iyo impfizi iri mu gihe igomba kwima, kandi imaze gushaka kwima nta coyitururuza ngo itekane? Kandi impfizi zose ziyikurikira ntizirinda kuruha; mu gihe co kuyimya zizoyironka vyoroshe.
Ntiwiruke gushika aho ibirenge vyawe bigira amabavu n’umuhogo wawe ukuma. Ariko waravuze uti: ‘Reka kwigora! Nkunda imana z’inyamahanga, kandi nzoziruka inyuma.’
Nk’uko igisuma giteterwa iyo gifashwe, ni ko inzu ya Isirayeli iteterewe, n’abami babo n’abaganwa babo, abaherezi babo n’abavugishwa babo.
Babwira ibiti bati: ‘Uri data,’ n’ibuye bati: ‘Ni we wamvyaye.’ Banteye ibitugu ntibampindukiriye; ariko iyo batewe n’ivyago, baca bavuga bati: ‘Nuze udukize!’
None za mana zanyu mwikoreye ziri hehe? Nizibakize nimba zobishobora mu gihe c’ingorane zanyu! Kuko wewe Buyuda ufise imana nyinshi zingana n’ibisagara vyawe.
Ni igiki unyagiriza? Mwese mwarangararije,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Igihano nahanye abantu bawe nta co camaze; ntibemeye gukosorwa. Inkota yawe yariye ba kamenyi bawe nk’intambwe yaratse.

Yemwe abo muri uru runganwe, nimwumvirize ijambo ry’ Uhoraho : Mbega nabereye Isirayeli ubugaragwa canke igihugu c’umwijima mwinshi? Ni igiki gituma abantu banje bavuga bati: ‘Tuzoja aho dushaka; ntituzosubira kugaruka iwawe’?
Mbega inkumi yokwibagira kwambara ibituma iberwa, umugeni akibagira ivyo kwishariza ku musi w’ubukwe? Ariko abantu banje baranyibagiye, kumara imisi itoharurwa.
Ese ukugene uzi kwironderera abo wikundira! N’umugore w’igipfu yokwigirako ingene akwiye kwigenza.
Ku mpuzu zawe abantu basangako amaraso y’abatagira icaha kandi b’abakene, naho ata co wabafatanye nk’ikosa. Kandi naho bimeze uko,
uravuga uti: ‘Nta co niyagiriza; Uhoraho ntakinshavuriye.’ Ariko nzogucira urubanza kuko uvuga uti: ‘Sinacumuye.’
Ni igiki gituma ugenda wangara hirya no hino, uhindura inzira zawe? Uzohemukirwa na Egiputa nk’uko wahemukiwe na Ashuri.
Uzova muri ico kibanza wikoreye amaboko, kuko Uhoraho yahevye abo wizigiye; nta co bazokuvuna.

Umugabo yirukanye umugore wiwe maze akarongorwa n’uwundi mugabo, mbega yosubira kumugarukana bakabana? Mbega igihugu nticoca kirushiriza guhumana rwose? Ariko wewe wabaye maraya, ufise abo wikundira benshi, mbega wongarukako?” ni ko Uhoraho abaza.

“Unamura amaso urabe impinga z’imisozi. Mbega hoba hariho ahantu utahumanije? Wicara ku nzira urindiriye abo wipfuza ukunda, wicara nk’umuntu yangara mu bugaragwa. Wahumanije igihugu ugihumanishije ubusambanyi bwawe n’ibibi vyawe.
Ni co catumye imvura ibura, n’imvura y’impeshi ntiyagwa. Ariko mu maso hawe biraboneka ko uri maraya; mugabo ntunamaramara.
Mbega ntiwamye umpamagara ngo: ‘Data, mukunzi wanje wo kuva nkiri muto,
mbega uzokwama ushavuye? Mbega uburake bwawe ni ubw’ibihe vyose?’ Uko ni ko uvuga, ariko ugakora ibibi uko ushoboye kwose.”
Ku ngoma y’umwami Yosiya, Uhoraho yarambwiye ati: “Wabonye ivyo Isirayeli mutizigirwa yakoze? Yagiye ku musozi muremure wose no musi y’igiti cose gitotahaye maze asambanirayo.
Nibajije ko ahejeje gukora ivyo vyose azongarukako ariko si ko vyagenze, maze murumunawe Yuda arabibona.
Nahaye ikete ryo kwahukana Isirayeli maze ndamwirukana kubera ubusambanyi bwiwe bwose. Ariko nabonye na murumunawe Yuda mutizigirwa atigeze atinya; na we nyene yagiye mu vyo gusambana.
Kuko ubuhumbu bwa Isirayeli ata co bwamubwiye kinini, yahumanije igihugu asambana n’amabuye n’ibiti.
Naho vyabaye uko, murumunawe Yuda ntiyangarutseko n’umutima wiwe wose, atari mu majambo gusa,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Isirayeli mutizera ntakiri umugororotsi kurusha mutizigirwa Yuda.

Genda mumenyeshe iyi nkuru mutumbereye mu buraruko muti: ‘Garuka Isirayeli Mutizera,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze. ‘Sinzosubira kukurakira, kuko ndi umunyembabazi,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze. ‘Sinzokwama ndatse ibihe vyose.
Pfa kwemera icaha cawe, ko wagararije Uhoraho Imana yawe, wasanzaje ubwiza bwawe ku mana z’inyamahanga musi y’igiti cose gitotahaye, kandi ntiwanyumviye,’ ” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

“Nimungarukeko, mwa bana batizigirwa,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “kuko ndi shobuja. Nzobatoranya, ndabakure iyo mwasabagiriye, umwe ndamukure mu gisagara kimwe na babiri mu muryango umwe, maze ndabazane i Siyoni.
Hanyuma nzobaha abungere bahuye n’uko umutima wanje ugomba, bazobarongora mu kumenya no mu gutahura.

Muri iyo misi, ibitigiri vyanyu nivyamara kwongerekana cane mu gihugu,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “abantu ntibazosubira kuvuga ivy’Isandugu y’Isezerano ry’ Uhoraho . Ntizosubira na rimwe kwinjira mu bwenge bwabo; ntizokwibukwa, kandi ntizosubirizwa.
Muri ico gihe bazokwita Yerusalemu Umugwa w’ Uhoraho kandi amahanga yose azokoranira i Yerusalemu ngo bahe icubahiro izina ry’ Uhoraho . Ntibazosubira gukurikira ugukomantara kw’imitima yabo mibi.
Muri iyo misi ab’inzu ya Yuda bazokwifatanya n’ab’inzu ya Isirayeli maze bose baze bavuye mu buraruko baze mu gihugu nahaye ba sekuruza babo kw’ishamvu.

Ni jewe ubwanje navuze nti: ‘Ese ukuntu binezera kugufata nk’umwana wanje no kuguha igihugu ciza co kwipfuzwa, itongo rirusha ayandi yose kuba ryiza mu bihugu vyose.’ Niyumvira ko muzonyita Data kandi mutazontera ibitugu ngo mureke kunkurikira.
Ariko nk’uko umugore ahemukira umugabo wiwe, ni ko mwampemukiye, yemwe ab’inzu ya Isirayeli,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Urwamo rwumvikana ku dutwe tw’imisozi, Abisirayeli barira kandi batakamba, kuko banduje inzira zabo kandi bibagiye Uhoraho Imana yabo.
“Nimuhindukire, yemwe mwa bana batizerwa; nzobakiza ndabakuremwo ugusubira inyuma.” “Egome, tuzokugarukako, kuko uri Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Ni ukuri ugusenga ibigirwamana vyo ku dusozi no ku misozi ni uruhendo; ni ukuri agakiza k’Abisirayeli kari k’ Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Kuva mu buto bwacu imana ziteye isoni ni zo zatikije ivyavuye mu butame bwa ba sogokuruza, zariye imikuku n’amasho vyabo, abahungu n’abakobwa babo.

Reka twubame hasi kubera ibiteterwe, kandi ibimaramare vyacu bidutwikire. Twacumuye k’ Uhoraho Imana yacu, twebwe na ba sogokuruza bacu; kuva mu buto bwacu gushika uwu musi ntitwumviye Uhoraho Imana yacu.”
“Nimba wewe, Isirayeli, ugomba guhindukira,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “nungarukeko.” “Nimwakuraho ibigirwamana bisesema imbere yanje ntimusubire gukevya muta inzira,

kandi mu kuri kwose, mu nzira itunganye kandi igororotse mukarahira muvuga muti: ‘Ni ukuri nk’uko Uhoraho ari muzima,’ nuko amahanga azohabwa umugisha n’ Uhoraho kandi muri we ni ho hazoba ivyirato vyabo.”
Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho avuga ku bantu b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu ati: “Nimumene imishike kandi ntimubibe mu mahwa.

Nimukebwe mugaruke k’ Uhoraho , Nimukebwe mu mitima yanyu, yemwe bantu b’i Buyuda na mwebwe b’i Yerusalemu, kugira ngo uburake bwanje ntibururumbe bugaturira nk’umuriro kubera ibibi mwakoze, bukarurumba ata wo kubuzimya.
Menyesha i Buyuda kandi ubivuge i Yerusalemu uti: ‘Vuza inzamba mu gihugu cose! Semerera cane uvuge uti: Egeranira hamwe! Reka duhunge tuje mu bisagara bizitijwe inzitiro!’
Manika ibendera ry’ikimenyetso i Siyoni! Hunga mudatevye kugira ngo ntimugire ico muba! Kuko nzanye icago kivuye mu buraruko, kandi ni uguhonya guhambaye.”
Intare ivuye mu kibundo cayo; umuranduzi w’amahanga arasohotse. Yavuye iwe ngo asangangure igihugu canyu. Ibisagara vyanyu bizoba imisaka ata muntu n’umwe akibibamwo.
Nuko nimwambare amagunira, mucure intimba muboroge, kuko uburake bw’inkazi bw’ Uhoraho butaratuvako.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ati: “Kuri uwo musi, umwami n’abaganwa bazocika intege, abaherezi bazogira ubwoba bwinshi, na ba kamenyi bazoranduka imitima.”
Maze ndavuga nti: “Yewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, ese ukuntu wahenze aba bantu n’ababa i Yerusalemu mu kubabwira uti: ‘Muzoba amahoro,’ kandi ahubwo inkota iri ku mazosi yacu!”
Muri ico gihe aba bantu n’ababa i Yerusalemu bazobwirwa ngo: “Umuyaga uturira uvuye ku dutwe tw’imisozi yo mu bugaragwa uzohuha ku bantu banje, ariko ntikuzoba ari ukugosora canke kweza;
uzoba ari umuyaga uhambaye uje utegetswe nanje. Nzobashitsako urubanza rwanje.”
Raba! Agenda nk’ibicu, imikogote yiwe igenda nk’agashururu, amafarasi yiwe agenda anyaruka kurusha inkona. Turagowe! Turahonye!
Yewe Yerusalemu, wiyuhagire ububi bwose bwo mu mutima wawe kugira ngo ukizwe. Uzogeza ryari kwigenera ivyiyumviro bibi?
Ijwi rivugiye i Dani, rimenyesha icago kivuye mu misozi y’i Efurayimu.
“Bibwire amahanga, bimenyeshe ab’i Yerusalemu uti: ‘Ingabo zije gutera zivuye mu gihugu ca kure, urwamo rw’intambara ruje ku bisagara vy’i Buyuda.
Bahakikuje nk’abantu barinda umurima, kuko yangararije,’ ” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Inyifato yanyu n’ibikorwa vyanyu ni vyo bitumye ivyo bibazako. Ico ni igihano canyu. Ese ukuntu kirura! Ese ukuntu kinyengetera gushika mu mutima!

Ewe mubabaro wanje, ewe mubabaro wanje! Uburibwe ni bwinshi. Ese ingene umutima wanje usambagirika! Umutima wanje uradihagizwa muri jewe, kandi sinshobora guhora. Kuko numvise ijwi ry’inzamba; numvise akamo k’intambara.
Icago gikurikira ikindi; igihugu cose cahindutse imisaka. Mu kanya gato amahema yanje arasambuwe, n’ubwugamo bwanje mu kanya gato.
Mbega nzogeza ryari kubona ibendera y’intambara no kwumva ijwi ry’inzamba?
Abantu banje ni ibijuju; ntibanzi. Ni abana batiyumvira; ntibagira ugutahura. Ni abanyabwenge mu gukora ibibi; ntibazi ugukora iciza.”
Naravye isi, nsanga ntigira uko imeze kandi nta kirimwo; ndaba n’amajuru, nsanga umuco waho wagiye.
Naravye ku misozi, mbona iriko iratigita; n’udusozi twose turahuzenze.
Nararavye, nsanga nta bantu bariho; inyoni zose zo mu kirere zari zagurutse.
Ndavye, nsanga igihugu cimbuka ivyamwa vyinshi gisigaye ari ubugaragwa; ibisagara vyose vyaho ni imisaka imbere y’ Uhoraho imbere y’ubushangashirwe bwiwe bwinshi.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Igihugu cose kizoba amatongo, naho ntazogisambura rwose.
Ni co gituma isi yose izogandara n’amajuru yo hejuru yirabure, kuko ndabivuze kandi sinzokwigarura, namaze gufata ingingo sinzokwisubirako.”

Nihumvikana ijwi ry’abagendera ku mafarasi n’abanyamiheto igisagara cose kizohunga. Bamwe binjire mu vyatsi; abandi binjire mu bitandara. Mu bisagara vyose harera nta muntu arimwo; nta muntu n’umwe akibibamwo.

Mbega uriko urakora iki, wa gisagara we usambuwe? Ni kuki wiyambika inyambarabami, ukambara ubudede bwawe bw’inzahabu? Ko ushariza amaso yawe n’amarangi? Wishaririza ubusa gusa. Abo ushaka gukunda barakwanka; bagomba kukwica.

Ndumva ijwi nk’iry’umugore afashwe n’inda, ukuboroga nk’ukw’uwuvyara imfura yiwe, akamo k’umukobwa w’i Siyoni yipfuza akayaga, ataritse ukuboko avuga ati: “Karabaye, ncitse intege; ubugingo bwanje buhawe abicanyi.

Muduge kandi mumanuke mu mayira yose y’i Yerusalemu, murabe irya n’ino kandi mwitegereze, murondere mu mpande zose. Nimba mwoshobora kuronka umuntu n’umwe acuruza mu kugororoka kandi arondera ukuri, nanje nzobabarira iki gisagara.
N’aho bavuga bati: ‘Ni ukuri nk’uko Uhoraho ari muzima,’ barahira ibinyoma.”
Yewe Uhoraho , mbega inyonga zawe ntizirondera ukuri? Warabakubise, ariko ntibababara; warabamenaguye ariko ntibemera gukosorwa. Bakomantaje mu maso habo haba nk’ibuye maze banka kwihana.
Nariyumviriye nti: “Abo ni aboro; ni ibijuju, ntibazi inzira y’ Uhoraho , ntibazi ivyo Imana yabo ishaka.

Ni co gituma ngiye kurondera abarongozi babo maze mvugane na bo. Ni ukuri barazi inzira y’ Uhoraho , barazi ivyo Imana yabo ishaka.” Ariko n’abo nyene baravunaguye ingogo y’ Uhoraho kandi baracagaguye iminyororo.

Ni co gituma intambwe yo mw’ishamba izobatera, imfyisi yo mu bugaragwa ikabatabagura, ingwe izobabundira hafi y’ibisagara vyabo kugira ngo itabagure umuntu wese asohoka hanze, kuko ubugarariji bwabo ari bwinshi no gusubira inyuma kwabo ari kwinshi.
Ni kuki nobaharira? Abana banyu barampevye maze barahira mw’izina ry’izindi mana atari imana z’ukuri. Nabahaye ivyo bakeneye vyose, ariko bagiye mu busambanyi kandi bahurumbira amazu y’abamaraya.
Bameze nk’amafarasi avyibushe, umwe wese yiruka arondera umugore wa mugenziwe.
Mbega ivyo sinkwiye kubibahanira? Ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Mbega sinari nkwiye kwihora ihanga rimeze gutyo?
Nimugende muce mu mizabibu yaho, maze muyitikize, ariko ntimuyimare rwose. Musangangure amashami yawo, kuko aba bantu atari ab’ Uhoraho .
Inzu ya Isirayeli n’inzu ya Yuda barampemukiye bantera ibitugu, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Bavuze ibinyoma k’ Uhoraho ; baravuze bati: “Nta na kimwe azokora! Nta kibi kizodushikako; ntituzokwigera tubona inkota canke ikigoyi.
Abavugishwa ni umuyaga gusa kandi nta jambo riri muri bo. Ivyo bavuga nibibashikeko bo nyene.”

Nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose avuze: Kubera ko abantu bavuze ayo majambo, nzohindura amajambo yanje ari mu kanwa kawe acike umuriro aba bantu na bo babe nk’inkwi zo gutongorwa n’uwo muriro.
Yemwe ab’inzu ya Isirayeli, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, Nzozana ihanga rya kure rize kubagwanya, ni ihanga rikomeye kandi ryamyeho kuva kera, abantu bavuga ururimi mutazi, bafise imvugo mutumva.
Isaho y’imyampi yabo ni nk’imva yuguruye; kandi bose ni abagwanyi b’abahizi.

Bazorigita imyimbu yanyu n’indya zanyu, bazorandura abahungu banyu n’abakobwa banyu; bazoherengeteza amasho yanyu n’imikuku yanyu, bazorigata imizabibu yanyu n’imisukoni yanyu. Bazosambuza inkota ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro mwari mwizigiye.
“Ariko no muri iyo misi,” ni ko Uhoraho “sinzogusambura rwose.

Kandi igihe abantu bazobaza bati: ‘Ni kuki Uhoraho Imana yacu yadukoreye ibi vyose?’ Muzobabwire muti: ‘Ni kubera mwanteye ibitugu mugakorera izindi mana z’inyamahanga mu gihugu canyu bwite, ubu na ho muzokorera abanyamahanga mu gihugu kitari icanyu.’
Menyesha ibi ab’inzu ya Yakobo mubivuge i Buyuda:
nimwumve ibi, yemwe bantu b’ibipfu mutagira ubwenge, mufise amaso ariko ntimubone, mufise amatwi ariko ntimwumve.

Mbega ntimwonyubaha?” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Mbega ntimwohindira agashitsi imbere yanje? Naremye umusenyi ngo ushingire akarimbi ikiyaga, ube akarimbi k’ibihe bidashira kidashobora kurengana. Imipfunda yosuriranya, ariko ntishobora kuharenga; irashobora kubomborana, ariko ntishobora kurenga ako karimbi.
Ariko aba bantu bo bafise imitima ikomantaye kandi igarariza; bakikamiye hirya bigira ahandi.
Ntibibwira mu mitima bati: ‘Reka twubahe Uhoraho Imana yacu, aduha imvura y’agatasi n’iy’urushana ku gihe cayo, aduha amayinga meza yo kwimbura.’
Ibibi vyanyu mwakoze ni vyo vyababujije kubironka; ivyaha vyanyu ni vyo vyababujije ivyiza.
Mu bantu banje harimwo abantu babi babunda nk’abatega inyoni nk’abantu batega imitego yo gufata abandi.
Kurya imitego yuzuramwo inyoni zafashwe, ni ko amazu yabo yuzuyemwo kugunga, babaye abatunzi b’abanyenkomezi
kandi baravyibushe barasayangana. Ibikorwa vyabo bibi ntibigira akarimbi; ntibababara urubanza rw’impfuvyi ngo bazirenganure, ntibitaho urubanza rw’umukene.
Mbega ivyo sinkwiye kubibahanira?” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Mbega sinkwiye kwihora ihanga rimeze gutyo?
Ikintu giteye ubwoba kandi kibabaje carabaye mu gihugu:
abavugishwa bavugishwa ibinyoma, abaherezi baganzisha igikenye, kandi abantu banje barabinezerererwa. Ariko none kw’iherezo muzokora iki?

Hunga mukize amagara yanyu, yemwe bene Benyamini! Nimuhunge muve i Yerusalemu! Vuza inzamba i Tekowa! Manika ibendera i Beti-Hakeremu! Kuko icago kibahanamiye kivuye mu buraruko, kandi ni uguhonya guhambaye.
Nzosangangura umukobwa w’i Siyoni, umwe mwiza kandi abereye ijisho.
Abungere n’amasho yabo bazoza; bazohakikuza amahema yabo, umwe wese azoragira mu canya ciwe.
Mwitegurire kuja kuhagwanya! Muhaguruke tuhatere mu mashoka! Ariko, turagowe, kuko burije, kandi burahwibiriye.
Nuko rero nimuhaguruke, dutere mw’ijoro, maze dusambure inzitiro zaho!”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Nimwicire ibiti mwubake ivyo kwuririrako ngo mugwanye Yerusalemu. Iki gisagara gitegerezwa guhanwa; cuzuye agacinyizo.
Nk’uko iriba ridudubiza amazi yaryo, ni ko na co kidudubiza ibibi vyaho. Muri co humvikana umuryano n’uguhonya; ingwara yaho n’ibikomere vyama imbere yanje.
Burirwa wumve, yewe Yerusalemu, ngo simpave ndabaheba ngatuma igihugu canyu gisigara ari umusaka ata n’umwe agishobora kukibamwo.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Nibasorome amasigarira ya Isirayeli bamaririkanye nk’uko bagira ku muzabibu; nimusubiremwo musorome ivyasigaye mu mashami, nk’uko umuntu yegeranya inzabibu.”
Ni nde nobwira nkamumenyesha imburi yanje? Ni nde yonyumviriza? Amatwi yabo arazibwe ngo ntibashobore kwumva. Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ni igitsitaza kuri bo; ntibarinezerererwa.

Ariko nuzuye uburake bw’ Uhoraho kandi sinshobora kwihangana. “Busuke ku bana bari mu mabarabara no ku rwaruka rukoraniye hamwe; umugabo n’umugore wiwe bompi bazofatwa na bwo, n’abatama, bamwe bamaze kuremerwa n’imyaka bakagorama.
Amazu yabo azohabwa abandi, hamwe n’amatongo yabo n’abagore babo, ninaramvura ukuboko kwanje ngo ngwanye ababa mu gihugu,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Kuva ku muto gushika ku mukuru, bose buzuye umunoho w’amaronko; kandi kuva ku muvugishwa gushika ku muherezi, bose ni abanyabinyoma.
Bavura igikomere c’abantu banje nk’aho kitababaje; bakavuga ngo: ‘Ni amahoro, ni amahoro,’ kandi ata mahoro ariho.

Mbega none boba bamaramazwa n’inyifato yabo igayitse? Oya na mba, nta soni bafise; mbere ntibazi no kumaramara ico ari co. Ni co gituma bazogwa aho abandi baguye; bazotemba igihe nzoba ndiko ndabahana,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nimuhagarare mu mayirabiri murabe; mubaze inzira za kera izo ari zo, nimubaze inzira nziza iyo ari yo, maze muyicemwo, ni ho muzoronka uburuhukiro bw’imitima yanyu. Ariko mwaravuze muti: ‘Nta yo tuzocamwo.’
Nashizeho abarinzi bo kubarinda maze ndavuga nti: ‘Nimwumvirize ijwi ry’inzamba!’ Ariko mwavuze muti: ‘Ntituzoryumviriza.’
Nuko rero, nimwumve, yemwe mahanga; mwebwe muri ivyabona, nimurabe ibizobabako.
Niwumve, yewe wa si we: Nzoteza icago kuri aba bantu, gitewe n’ivyiyumviro vyabo bibi, kuko batumviye amajambo yanje bagatera ibitugu Ivyagezwe vyanje.
Ni igiki conezera mu bimota neza vy’i Sheba canke urubingo rumota neza rwo mu gihugu ca kure? Ibimazi vyo guturirwa vyanyu ntivyemerwa; ibimazi vyanyu ntibimpimbara.”
Ni co gituma Uhoraho avuze ati: “Nzoshira ibitsitaza imbere y’ubu bwoko. Ba se co kimwe n’abahungu bazotsitara kuri vyo; ababanyi n’abagenzi bazohona.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Raba, ingabo ziraje zivuye mu gihugu co mu buraruko; ihanga rikomeye rirahagurutse rivuye ku mpera z’isi.

Bitwaje imiheto n’amacumu; bateye ubwoba kandi ni ba ruburakigongwe. Akamo kabo, bariko bariruka ku mafarasi yabo, ni nk’ukubomborana kw’ikiyaga gisuriranya. Baje kurya kw’abagabo bariko barimenyereza intambara ngo bagutere, yewe mukobwa w’i Siyoni.”
Twumvise inkuru zabo, amaboko yacu yaciye acika inkokora. Umubabaro uradufata, umubabaro nk’uw’umugore ariko aravyara.
Ntimuje mu mirima canke ngo mugendagende mu mayira, kuko umwansi yitwaje inkota, kandi hari ibiteye ubwoba impande zose.
Yemwe bantu, nimwambare amagunira mwitembagaze mu minyota; mugandare muboroge cane nk’uko umuntu aririra umuhungu wiwe w’ikinege. Kuko umuranduzi adushitseko giturumbuka.
“Nakugize nk’igipimisho gipima ivyuma hamwe n’abantu banje, kugira ngo wihweze kandi upime inzira zabo.
Bose ni abagarariji bakomantaye imitima, bagenda hose bavuga abandi nabi. Bameze nk’umuringa n’icuma; bose bakora ivy’ubugarariji.
Itanure riraka cane ngo rishongeshe ubutare, ariko ivyuma ntibishonga; ababi ntibamarwa inkamba.
Bitwa ifeza yatawe, kuko Uhoraho yabataye.”
Iri ni ryo jambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’ Uhoraho :
“Hagarara kw’irembo ry’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho maze ushikirize ubu butumwa uri aho nyene uti: ‘Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yemwe bantu b’i Buyuda binjira muri aya marembo gusenga Uhoraho .
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli avuze: Nimuhindure ingeso zanyu n’ibikorwa vyanyu, nanje nzobaha kuba aha hantu.
Ntimwizigire amajambo y’uruhendo ngo muvuge muti: iyi ni Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , Ingoro y’ Uhoraho !
Nimwahindura vy’ukuri ingeso zanyu n’ibikorwa vyanyu kandi umuntu wese agakorera mugenziwe ibibereye,
nimutacinyiza inyambukira, impfuvyi canke umupfakazi kandi ntimusese amaraso y’uwutagira icaha muyasesa aha hantu, kandi nimutakurikira izindi mana ari vyo bibazanira amarushwa,
nuko nzobaha kuba aha hantu, mu gihugu nahaye ba sogokuruza banyu ibihe bidashira.
Ariko raba, mwizigiye amajambo y’uruhendo atagira ikimazi.
Mbega muzokwiba, mwice, musambane kandi murahire ibinyoma, muturirire Bayali ibimota neza, mukurikire izindi mana mutigeze mumenya,
hanyuma muheze muze guhagarara imbere yanje muri iyi Ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, muvuga muti: Turacuna! Muracuna kandi mukora ibibi nk’ivyo?
Mbega iyi Ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, yahindutse isenga ry’abambuzi kuri mwebwe? Ariko namye ndavyihweza! Ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimugende mu kibanza c’i Shilo aho nashize ubwa mbere ikibanza citirirwa izina ryanje, murabe uko nahagiriye kubera ibibi vy’abantu banje b’Abisirayeli.
Mu gihe mwariko murakora ivyo, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, navuganye namwe kenshi, ariko ntimwanyumviye; narabahamagaye ariko ntimwitaba, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Ni co gituma, ivyo nakoreye i Shilo ari vyo ngiye gukorera iyi Ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje, Ingoro mwashizemwo ivyizigiro, ikibanza nahaye mwebwe na ba sogokuruza banyu.
Nzobirukana mumve imbere, nk’uko nagiriye benewanyu ari bo Bisirayeli, abantu ba Efurayimu.’
Nuko rero ntusengere ubu bwoko, ntubaborogere canke ngo unyinginge, kuko ntazokwumviriza.
Ntubona ivyo bariko barakora mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu mayira y’i Yerusalemu?

Abana begeranya inkwi, ba se bagacana umuriro, abagore na bo bakagira igikandu co gukoramwo udukate tw’umwamikazi wo mw’ijuru. Basesa hasi ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa ku zindi mana ngo bavyure ishavu ryanje, bandatse.
Ariko mbega ni jewe bariko baratera ishavu? Ni ko Uhoraho abaza. Mbega si bo bariko barigirira nabi, ibintu bizotuma bamaramara?

Nuko rero, uku ni ko Uhoraho Nyeninganji avuze: Uburake bwanje n’ubushangashirwe bwanje bizosukwa aha hantu, ku muntu no ku gikoko, ku biti vyo mu mirima no ku vyimburwa biva mw’ivu, buzorurumba kandi nta wuzobuzimya.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli avuze ati: Bandanya, mwongere amashikanwa yanyu yo guturirwa ku bindi bimazi vyanyu, maze mwirire inyama!
Kuko igihe nakura ba sogokuruza banyu muri Egiputa kandi nkavugana na bo, sinabahaye amabwirizwa gusa yerekeye ibimazi vyo guturirwa;
ariko nabahaye iki cagezwe ngo: Munyumvire, nanje nzoba Imana yanyu namwe mube abantu banje. Muze mugendere mu nzira zose ndababwira, kugira ngo ivyanyu bigende neza.
Ariko ntibanyumviye canke ngo babishireko n’umutima; ahubwo, bakurikiye ugukomantara kw’imitima yabo yanduye. Basubiye inyuma aho kuja imbere.
Kuva mu gihe ba sogokuruza bava muri Egiputa kugeza n’ubu, ku musi ku musi, nama ndungika abasavyi banje abo navugisha.
Ariko ntibagomba kunyumviriza canke ngo babishireko umutima. Bagamitse izosi maze bakora ibibi biruta ivya ba sekuruza babo.
Niwababwira ibi vyose, ntibazokwumviriza; niwabahamagara, ntibazokwitaba.
Nuko rero uze ubabwire uti: Iri ni ryo hanga ritumviye Uhoraho Imana yabo canke ngo ryemere guhanurwa. Ukuri kwarahonyanzwe; kwaraheze ku minwa yabo.
Nimwimweshe umushatsi wanyu maze muwute kure, mucure intimba muri ku dutwe tw’imisozi y’uruharabuga, kuko Uhoraho yataye kandi yahevye uru runganwe ruri musi y’uburake bwiwe.
Abantu b’i Buyuda bakoze ibibi mu nyonga zanje, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Bashinze ibigirwamana vyabo vyo kwankwa urunuka mu Ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje maze barayihumanya.

Bubatse ibibanza basengeramwo vya Tofeti mu kiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu ngo bahatangire abahungu babo n’abakobwa babo babatuririye mu muriro, ivyo ntari nabategetse gukora, canke ngo bice no mu bwenge bwanje.

Nuko nimwiyubare, imisi iraje, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, aho abantu batazosubira kuhita Tofeti canke ikiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu, ahubwo hazokwitwa ikiyaya co gusogota, kuko bazohamba abapfuye i Tofeti kugeza aho hatazosigara ikibanza na kimwe.
Maze imivyimba y’aba bantu izoba ivyokurya vy’inyoni zo mu kirere n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba, kandi nta muntu azoshobora kuvyirukana.
Nzoshira kw’iherezo amajwi y’umunezero no guhimbarwa n’amajwi y’umukwe n’umugeni mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu mayira y’i Yerusalemu, kuko igihugu kizoba ari umusaka.
‘Muri ico gihe,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ‘amagufa y’abami n’abaganwa b’i Buyuda, ay’abaherezi n’ay’abavugishwa n’Imana, hamwe n’ay’abantu b’i Yerusalemu bose, azozurwa akurwe mu mva zayo.

Azokwanikirwa ku zuba, ku kwezi no ku nyenyeri zose zo kw’ijuru; ibigirwamana bakunze bakabikorera kandi ivyo bakurikiye, bakabisiguza, mbere bakanabisenga. Ntazokwegeranywa ngo asubire ahambwe, ahubwo azomera nk’amase ashanjwe kw’isi.
Aho nzobirukanira hose, abantu b’amasigarira bazoba barokotse bo muri iri hanga rikora ibizira bazohitamwo gupfa kuruta kubaho, ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.’
Babwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Iyo abantu baguye hasi, mbega ntibavyuka? Canke iyo umuntu ataye inzira, mbega ntagaruka?
None ni kuki aba bantu banteye ibitugu? Mbega ni kuki ab’i Yerusalemu bamvuyeko? Bumiye ku majambo y’uruhendo; baranse kugaruka.
Narabumvirije neza, ariko ntibavuga ibigororotse. Nta n’umwe yihana ububi bwiwe, ngo avuge ati: “Ibi nakoze ni ibiki?” Umwe wese ajana inzira yiwe ubwiwe nk’ifarasi igiye mu ntambara.
Mbere n’agasoza kari mu kirere karazi ibihe kashingiwe, kandi n’inuma, intamba n’umusambi bikurikiza ibihe vyo kuva ahantu bija ahandi. Ariko abantu banje ntibazi ivyo Uhoraho ashaka.
Ni kuki muvuga muti: “Turi abanyabwenge, kuko dufise Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho ,” kandi ikaramu y’ikinyoma y’abanyabwenge b’ivyanditswe yarabihinduye ikinyoma?
Abanyabwenge bazomaramara; bazoterwa n’ubwoba kandi bazofatwa mu mutego. Ko bataye ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , bafise ubwenge nyabaki?

Ni co gituma nzotanga abagore babo nkabaha abandi bagabo n’amatongo yabo nkayaha abandi. Kuva ku muto gushika ku mukuru, bose bafise umunoho w’amaronko; kandi kuva ku muvugishwa gushika ku muherezi, bose ni abanyabinyoma.
Bavura igikomere c’abantu banje nk’aho kitababaje; bakavuga ngo: “Ni amahoro, ni amahoro,” kandi ata mahoro ariho.

Mbega none boba bamaramazwa n’inyifato yabo igayitse? Oya na mba nta soni bafise; mbere ntibazi no kumaramara ico ari co. Ni co gituma bazogwa aho abandi baguye; bazotemba igihe nzoba ndiko ndabahana, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nzotwara ivyimburwa vyabo, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Nta nzabibu zizokwama ku mizabibu. Nta nsukoni zizokwama ku misukoni, kandi amababi yavyo azokabirana. Ivyo nabahaye bazovyakwa.’ ”

Ni kuki twicaye hano? Nimwegerane! Reka duhungire mu bisagara bizitijwe inzitiro maze duhonereyo! Kuko Uhoraho Imana yacu yaduciriye urwo gupfa maze akaduha amazi arimwo uburozi ngo tuyanywe, kuko twamucumuyeko.
Twari twizigiye amahoro ariko nta ciza catujeko, twari twiteze igihe co gukiza ariko twabonye ibidutera ubwoba gusa.
Imirindi y’amafarasi y’umwansi yumvikanira i Dani; umurindi w’ibinono vyayo binyiganyije igihugu cose. Baraje gukomvomvora igihugu n’ibiri muri co vyose, igisagara n’abari muri co bose.
“Raba, nzorungika inzoka z’ubumara muri mwebwe, incira zidashobora kugundwa, kandi zizobakomora,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Yewe wewe undemesha mu mibabaro, umutima wanje ucikiye intege muri jewe.

Umve uko abantu banje bariko baraboroga bari mu gihugu ca kure: bati: “Mbega Uhoraho ntari i Siyoni? Mbega Umwami waho ntakiriho?” “Ni kubera iki banteye ishavu bakandakisha ibishushanyo vyabo, n’imana zabo zidashoboye z’inyamahanga?”
“Iyimbura riraheze, ici rirarangiye, kandi natwe ntitwakize.”
Ko abantu banje bamenaguwe, nanje ndamenaguwe; ndagandaye, kandi nishwe n’agahinda.
Mbega i Gileyadi nta muti wo gusomora uriyo? Nta muganga ariyo? None ni kuki ata gukira kw’igikomere c’abantu banje?
Ese icompa umutwe wanje ukaba nk’isoko y’amazi n’amaso yanje akaba imiringoti y’amosozi! Norira ku murango no mw’ijoro kubera abantu banje bariko barasogotwa.
Ese icompa nkaba mfise mu bugaragwa inzu y’ingenzi, kugira ngo mve muri bano bantu banje nje kure yabo; kuko bose ari abasambanyi, igugu ry’abantu bataye ubwizigirwa.
“Bafora indimi zabo nk’umuheto, kugira ngo barase ibinyoma; si kubera ukuri kwabo batera imbere mu gihugu. Kuko bava mu caha kimwe bakaja mu kindi; kandi ntibamenye jewe,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Mwirinde abagenzi banyu; ntimwizigire umuntu n’umwe wo mu nzu iwanyu. Kuko umwe wese muri bo ari umusukanyi, kandi umugenzi wese akaba uwuvuga abandi nabi.
Umugenzi abesha mugenziwe, kandi nta n’umwe avuga ukuri. Bigishije indimi zabo kubesha; kandi biremereje ugucumura.
Uba hagati mu bubeshi; kandi mu bubeshi bwabo banka kumenya jewe,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: Raba, nzobavugutira ndabapime, kuko ikindi nokora ni igiki kubera icaha c’abantu banje?
Ururimi rwabo ni umwampi uriko ubumara; ruvuga ivyo guhendana. Mu kanwa kabo bose bavugana neza n’ababanyi babo, ariko mu mitima yabo bakabatega imitego.
Mbega ivyo sinkwiye kubibahanira? Ni ko Uhoraho abaza. Mbega sinkwiye kwihora abantu nk’abo?

Nzorira mboroge ndirira imisozi kandi nzocura intimba kubera uburagiro bwo mu bugaragwa. Ni agahinga katagendwa, kandi nta jwi ryo kwabira kw’amasho ryumvikana. Inyoni zo mu kirere zose zarahunze n’ibikoko vyaragiye.
Nzohindura Yerusalemu ikigunguzi c’isakamburira, ihuriro ry’imbwebwe; mpindure imisaka ibisagara vy’i Buyuda. Gushika aho ata n’umwe ashobora kuhaba.
Ni nde w’umunyabwenge ashobora gutahura ibi? Ni nde yigishijwe n’ Uhoraho ku buryo ashobora kubisobanura? Ni kuki igihugu casambuwe kigahinduka umusaka nk’ubugaragwa ata wokwubahuka gucamwo?
Uhoraho aravuze ati: Ni kubera bateye ibitugu ivyagezwe vyanje, ivyo nari narabashize imbere; ntibanyumviye canke ngo bitondere Ivyagezwe vyanje.
Ahubwo bakurikiye ugukomantara kw’imitima yabo; bakurikiye za Bayali, nk’uko ba sekuruza babo babigishije.
Ni co gituma Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli, avuze ati: Raba, nzorisha iri hanga indya zirura banywe n’amazi arimwo ishano.
Nzobasanzariza mu mahanga batigeze bamenya, baba bo canke ba sekuruza, kandi nzobakurikiza inkota gushika ndabahoneje.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: Nimwiyumvire neza rero! Nimutumeko abagore bazi kurira baze. Tumako abazi kuririra abapfuye kurusha abandi bo muri bo.
Nibaze bihuta kugira ngo batuborogere kugeza aho amaso yacu acunduguta amosozi kandi imigezi itembe iva mu bigohe vyacu.
Ijwi ryo kuboroga rirumvikana i Siyoni, riti: Ehe ukuntu dusambaguritse! Ehe ukuntu twuzuye ibimaramare! Dutegerezwa kuva mu gihugu cacu kuko amazu yacu ari imisaka.
None rero, yemwe bagore, nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ; mubangire amatwi yanyu amajambo yo mu kanwa kiwe. Mwigishe abakobwa banyu kuboroga; mwigishanye gucura intimba.
Urupfu rwuriye ruca mu madirisha maze rwinjira mu bisagara bizitijwe inzitiro; rwamaze gukura abana mu mabarabara n’abasore rwabamariye aho bahora bagandagaje.
Nimuvuge muti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Imivyimba y’abantu izokwandagara hasi nk’uko amase amera mu mirima, nk’imishi y’ingano inyuma y’uwimbura, ata n’umwe wo kuyegeranya.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Umunyabwenge ntiyirate ubwenge bwiwe canke umunyenkomezi ngo yirate inkomezi ziwe canke umutunzi ngo yirate ubutunzi bwiwe,

ariko uwirata wese yirate ibi: ko yamenye, akantahura ko ndi Uhoraho , nkerekana ukugira neza, ngaca imanza zibereye kandi ngakora mu bugororotsi kw’isi, kuko ivyo ari vyo bimpimbara, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Imisi iraje, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, aho nzohana abakebwe ku mubiri gusa,
Egiputa, Ubuyuda, Edomu, Amoni, Mowabu n’ababa mu bugaragwa bose mu bihugu vya kure. Kuko abo bose batakebwe vy’ukuri, kandi mbere n’ab’inzu ya Isirayeli ntibakebwe mu mitima yabo.
Nimwumve ivyo Uhoraho ababwira, yemwe bantu ba Isirayeli.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Ntimwige ingeso z’amahanga canke ngo muterwe ubwoba n’ibimenyetso vyo kw’ijuru, nk’uko ayo mahanga aterwa ubwoba na vyo.
Kuko imigenzo y’abo bantu ata co imaze; baca igiti mw’ishamba, maze umuhinga akakibaza akoresheje imbazo yiwe.
Bakagishariza n’ifeza n’inzahabu; bakagihagarika bakoresheje inyundo n’imisumari kugira ngo ntigitembe.
Ivyo bigirwamana bimeze nk’ibikanganyoni, mu mirima, ntibishobora kuvuga; bitegerezwa guterurwa kuko bidashobora kugenda. Ntimubitinye; nta co bishobora gukora caba kibi canke ciza.”
Nta n’umwe ameze nkawe Uhoraho ; kuko uri nkuru, kandi izina ryawe rirahambaye rifise ubushobozi.
Ni nde atokwubaha, yewe Mwami w’amahanga? Urabikwiye. Mu banyabwenge bose bo mu mahanga no mu bwami bwabo bwose, nta n’umwe ameze nkawe.
Bose ntibagira ubwenge kandi ni ibipfu; bigishijwe n’imana zibajwe mu biti ata co zimaze.
Ifeza yatunganijwe iva i Tarushishi n’inzahabu iva muri Ufazi. Ivyo abahinga n’abacuzi bakoze baca bavyambika impuzu z’agahama n’ubururu, zose zakozwe n’abahinga babimogoreye.
Ariko Uhoraho ni Imana y’ukuri; ni Imana nzima, Umwami ahoraho. Ashavuye, isi yose iratigita; amahanga ntashobora kwihanganira uburake bwiwe.
“Babwire ibi, uti: ‘Izo mana, zitaremye amajuru ntizireme isi, zizorandurwa zikurwe kw’isi no musi y’amajuru.’ ”
Ariko Imana yaremye isi mu bushobozi bwayo; iremesha isi ubwenge bwayo, kandi yagura amajuru mu gutahura kwayo.
Iyo ituragaye, amazi yo hejuru aca abomborana; ituma ibicu biduga biva ku mpera z’isi. Irungika umuravyo n’imvura, igasohora umuyaga iwukuye mu bubiko bwayo.
Umuntu wese ni ikijuju nta bwenge agira; umucuzi w’inzahabu wese naterwe isoni n’ibigirwamana vyiwe. Kuko ibishushanyo vyiwe ari ibinyoma gusa; nta mpwemu y’ubuzima iri muri vyo.
Nta co bimaze, ni ivyo gukengerwa gusa; igihe c’urubanza rwavyo nicashika, bizohona.
Ariko wa wundi, we mugabane wa Yakobo, ntameze nka vyo, kuko ari Umuremyi w’ibintu vyose harimwo na Isirayeli, abantu yagize inyegu yiwe. Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo zina ryiwe.
Nimwegeranye ibintu vyanyu kugira ngo muve mu gihugu, yemwe abugarijwe.
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho avuze: “Muri ico gihe, nzoshiburira hanze ababa muri iki gihugu bose; nzobateza ubwoba gushika bose bafashwe mpiri, nta wuzocika.”
Ewe jewe ndagowe, kuko nkomeretse! Kandi igikomere canje ntigishobora gukira! Ariko naribwiye mu mutima nti: “Iyi ni yo ngwara yanje, kandi ntegerezwa kuyihanganira.”
Ihema ryanje rirasambuwe; n’ibiziriko vyaryo vyose biracagaguwe. Abahungu banje bagiye kandi ntibakiriho; nta n’umwe asigaye ngo anyubakire ihema canke ngo anyubakire urusago.
Abungere nta co bibabwiye kandi ntibasiguza Uhoraho ; ni co gituma batazotera imbere kandi umukuku wabo wose ukaba usanzaye.
Umviriza! Inkuru iraje, ugutigita kw’isi kuje kuva mu gihugu co mu buraruko! Kuzosiga ibisagara vy’i Buyuda ari imisaka, ahakwiye kuba imbwebwe.
Ndazi, yewe Uhoraho , ko ubuzima bw’abantu batabuganza; kandi ko badashobora kwirongorera intambuko.
Nkosora, yewe Uhoraho , ariko ku rugezo rubereye, atari mu burake bwawe, kuko wompindura ubusa.
Suka uburake bwawe ku mahanga arya atakwemera, ku bantu batambaza izina ryawe. Kuko bashihaguye aba Yakobo; mbere barabashihaguye barabamara kandi basambuye n’igihugu ciwe.
Iri ni ryo jambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’ Uhoraho , rivuga riti:
“Nimwumve ibiri muri iri sezerano kugira ngo mubibwire abantu b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu.
Ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: Aravumwe umuntu atumvira ivyanditswe muri iryo sezerano,

ivyo nategetse ba sogokuruza banyu igihe nabakura muri Egiputa, mw’itanure rivugutira ivyuma.’ Navuze nti: ‘Munyumvire kandi mukore ivyo vyose ndabategetse, maze muzoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yanyu.
Ni ho nzoshitsa indahiro narahiye ba sogokuruza banyu, ko nzobaha igihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki, ico na co ni iki gihugu mubamwo uwu musi.’ ” Maze ndishura nti: “Amen, Uhoraho .”
Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Menyekanisha aya majambo yose mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu mabarabara y’i Yerusalemu, uti: ‘Nimwumve ibiri mu iri sezerano maze muvyitondere.
Kuva igihe nakuriye ba sogokuruza banyu muri Egiputa gushika uwu musi, narababuriye kenshi cane, mvuga nti: Nimunyumvire.

Ariko ntibanyumviye canke ngo banabibabare; ahubwo, bakurikiye ugukomantara kw’imitima yabo mibi. Ni co catumye ndabashitsako imivumo yose yari muri iryo sezerano nari nabahaye ngo baryitondere ariko bakarita.’ ”
Maze Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Hari uguhuza inama mbi mu bantu b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu.

Basubiye mu vyaha vya ba sekuruza, banse kwumva amajambo yanje. Bakurikiye izindi mana ngo bazisabe. Baba abo mu nzu ya Isirayeli canke abo mu nzu ya Yuda bavuye mw’isezerano nagiranye na ba sekuruza.
Ni co gituma Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Nzobateza icago badashobora kwikiza. Naho bazontakambira, sinzobumva.
Ibisagara vy’i Buyuda n’abantu b’i Yerusalemu bazogenda batakambire izo mana bazituririra ibimota neza, ariko ntizizobatabara na gatoya igihe icago kizoba kije.
Yemwe Bayuda, mufise imana zingana n’ibisagara vyanyu; kandi mwubatse ibicaniro vyo guturirirako ibimota neza iyo mana iteye isoni Bayali bingana n’amabarabara y’i Yerusalemu.’
Ntusabire aba bantu canke ngo unyambaze ku bwabo canke ngo ubingingire, kuko ntazokwumva nibantakambira mu gihe agatengo kabo kazoba kabafashe.

Mbega umukunzi wanje ariko akora iki mu Ngoro yanje ko mbona we, n’abandi benshi bakora ibikorwa bibi? Mbega inyama zejejwe zosubiza inyuma igihano muzohanwa? Kandi iyo muri mu bibi vyanyu, muranezerwa!”
Uhoraho yabita igiti gitotahaye ca Elayo gifise ivyamwa bisa neza. Ariko ukubomborana kw’igihuhusi gihambaye kuzotuma gifatwa n’umuriro, kandi amashami yaco azovunwa.
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, ari we yaguteye, yakugeneye ikiza, kuko abo inzu ya Isirayeli n’inzu ya Yuda bakoze ibibi bakandatsa mu guturirira ibimota neza Bayali.
Kubera Uhoraho yampishuriye inama bangira, narayimenye, kuko muri ico gihe yanyeretse ivyo bariko barakora.

Nari nabaye nk’umwagazi w’intama ujanwa kubagwa; sinamenya ko bari bangiriye inama, bavuga bati: “Reka duhonye igiti n’ivyamwa vyaco, reka tumurandure tumukure mw’isi y’abazima kugira ngo izina ryiwe ntirizosubire kwibukwa.”
Yewe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, ni wewe uca imanza zigororotse, ugasuzuma imitima y’abantu ukamenya ivyo biyumvira. Uze umpe kubona ingene uzobihora, kuko ari wewe nashikirije urubanza rwanje.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho abwira abantu bo muri Anatoti barondera kukwica, bakavuga bati: “Reka kuvugishwa mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho , bitari uko turakwica.”
Nuko uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Nzobahana. Abasore babo bazokwicwa n’inkota, abahungu babo n’abakobwa babo bicwe n’ikigoyi.
Nta n’umwe azorokoka. Nzorungikira ivyago abantu bo muri Anatoti mu mwaka wo guhanwa kwabo.”

headings.text: Bagira inama yo kugirira nabi Yeremiya

verses.text: Yewe Uhoraho , ibihe vyose uragororotse, igihe ndakuzaniye urubanza. Ariko nagomba mvugane nawe ku vy’ubutungane: Ni kuki abanyakibi batera imbere? Ni kuki abatizera biberaho neza?
Warabateye, bashora imizi; barakura bama ivyamwa. Bakwamana mu kanwa kabo mugabo uri kure y’imitima yabo.
Ariko jeho uranzi, yewe Uhoraho ; urambona kandi uzi n’ivyiyumviro nkwiyumvirako. Nubatware nk’intama zigiye kubagwa! Ubabikire umusi wo gusogotwa!

Igihugu kizogeza ryari kugandara n’ivyatsi ku misozi kwama bikabiranye? Kuko ababa muri co ari abanyakibi, ibikoko n’ibiguruka vyahonye. Vyongeye, abantu bavuga bati: “Ntazobona ibiriko biradushikako.”
“Nimba wasiganywe n’abiruka n’amaguru kandi bakakuruhisha, woshobora ute gusiganwa n’amafarasi? Ko utsitara mu gihugu kirimwo impore, uzobigenza gute igihe Yorodani ruzoba rwarenze inkombe?
Abavukanyi bawe, umuryango wawe bwite, na bo nyene baguhemukiye; baguhagurukiye ngo bakugwanye. Ntubizigire, naho bakuvuga neza.
Nzoheba inzu yanje, nzoreka n’iragi ryanje; nzotanga umwe nkunda mu maboko y’abansi biwe.
Iragi ryanje ryampindukiye nk’intare mw’ishamba. Riraroha rimbonye; ni co gituma ndaryanka.

Mbega iragi ryanje ntiryambereye nk’igisiga c’amero gifise amabara menshi ibindi bisiga vy’amero bikikuza ngo bikirye? Genda mukoranye ibikoko vyose vyo mw’ishamba; mubizane kugira ngo bishihagure amazimano.
Abungere benshi bazohonyanga uruzabibu rwanje kandi bazohonyanga umurima wanje; bazohindura umurima wanje nakunda ahantu h’ubugaragwa bw’agahinga.
Hazohindurwa agahinga, ahantu hahebwe kandi h’ubugaragwa imbere yanje; igihugu cose kizoba ubugaragwa kuko ata n’umwe abibabaye.
Ku dutwe twose tw’imisozi yose yo mu bugaragwa abasambura ni ho bazoca, kuko inkota y’ Uhoraho izoririka kuva ku mpera y’igihugu gushika ku yindi; nta n’umwe azokira.
Bazobiba ingano ariko bimbure amahwa; bazotama cane ariko ntihagire ico bunguka. Bazomaramazwe n’ivyo bimbuye ku bw’uburake bw’inkazi bw’ Uhoraho .”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Ku babanyi banje babi bafashe ishamvu nahaye abantu banje b’Abisirayeli, nzobarandura ndabakure mu bihugu vyabo ndandure n’inzu ya Yuda ndayikure hagati muri bo.
Ariko ninamara kubarandura, nzosubira ndabagirire imbabazi ngarukane umwe wese wo muri bo mw’ishamvu yiwe no mu gihugu ciwe bwite.

Kandi nibiga neza inzira z’abantu banje bakarahira mw’izina ryanje, bavuga bati: ‘Ni ukuri nk’uko Uhoraho ari muzima,’ naho babanje kwigisha abantu banje ngo barahire mw’izina rya Bayali, nuko bazoronka ikibanza mu bantu banje.
Ariko nihagira ihanga na rimwe ritumvira, nzorirandura rwose kandi ndariherengeteze,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho yambwiye, ati: “Genda ugure umukanda wera derere maze uwambare mu rukenyerero, ariko ntihagire amazi awukorako.”
Nuko ngura umukanda, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabintegetse, ndawukenyera mu rukenyerero.
Maze Uhoraho aza aho ndi ubwa kabiri, ati:
“Twara uwo mukanda waguze kandi ukenyeje, maze ugende uwunyegeze i Perati mu mugaga wo mu bitandara.”
Nuko ndagenda ndawunyegeza hafi ya Perati, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabimbwiye.
Hashize imisi Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Ubu na ho genda i Perati maze uzane wa mukanda nakubwira ngo ugende unyegezeyo.”
Nuko nja i Perati nzura wa mukanda ndawukura aho nari narawunyegeje, ariko wari wononekaye rwose ata woshobora kuwukoresha.
Maze Uhoraho ambwira ijambo ati:
“Uko uwo mukanda umeze, ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Uko ni ko nzokwonona ubwibone bwa Yuda n’ubwibone buhambaye bwa Yerusalemu.
Abo banyakibi, banka kwumva amajambo yanje, bagakurikira ugukomantara kw’imitima yabo kandi bagakurikira izindi mana ngo bazisabe bongere bazisenge, bazoba nk’uwu mukanda, ata co ugishoboye kumara!

Kuko, nk’uko umukanda bawukenyera mu rukenyerero, ni ko nakenyeye inzu yose ya Isirayeli n’inzu yose ya Yuda,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze, kugira ngo babe abantu banje, bitirirwe izina ryanje, maze bampimbaze kandi bampe icubahiro. Ariko ntibanyumviye.
Uze ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: Umukuza wose w’urusato ukwiye kwuzuzwa umuvinyu. Kandi nibakubwira bati: None ntitubizi ko umukuza wose ukwiye kwuzuzwa umuvinyu?’

Uzoce ubabwira uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ngiye kuzokwuzuza akaborerwe abantu bose baba muri iki gihugu, harimwo n’abami bicara ku ntebe y’ubwami ya Dawidi, abaherezi, abavugishwa, n’abantu bose baba i Yerusalemu.
Nzobamenagura umwe wese kuri mugenziwe, abavyeyi n’abana co kimwe, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Nta kagongwe nzogira canke imbabazi canke ikibabarwe ngo bimbuze kubaherengeteza.’ ”
Nimwumve kandi muntege amatwi, ntimugire ubwibone, kuko Uhoraho aravuze.

Nimuhe Uhoraho Imana yanyu icubahiro atarazana umwijima, ibirenge vyanyu bigatsitara ku misozi kuko iri mu mwijima. Mwizigira umuco, ariko azowuhindura umwijima w’umuzitanya kandi azowuhindura nk’igicu gitwaye isegenya.
Ariko nimutanyumvira, nzoririra mu mpisho kubera ubwibone bwanyu; amaso yanje azorira abogoze, amosozi acundugute, kuko umukuku w’ Uhoraho uzoba utwawe kw’inyagano.
Bwira umwami n’umugabekazi uti: “Nimuve ku ntebe zanyu z’ubwami, kuko ingori z’ubwiza zizokoroka zive ku mitwe yanyu.
Ibisagara vy’i Negebu bizokwugarwa, kandi ntihazoboneka uwo kuvyugurura. Abayuda bose bazojanwa ari inyagano, bazojanwa bose nta wuzosigara.
Nimwunamure amaso yanyu murabe abaje bava mu buraruko. Mbega umukuku bakuragije uri he, intama wari wishimiye?
Mbega uzovuga iki Uhoraho niyatuma abo wimenyereje ko ari abakunzi bawe bagutegeka? Mbega ntuzofatwa n’uburibwe nk’ubw’umugore afashwe n’ibise?
Kandi niwibaza uti: ‘Ni kuki ibi vyanshikiye?’ Ni kubera ivyaha vyawe vyinshi vyatumye uduhuzu twawe tugutabagurikirako n’umubiri wawe ukaba warakubaguwe.
Mbega Abanyetiyopiya bohindura urukoba rwabo canke ingwe yohindura amabara yayo? Ni ko na wewe utoshobora gukora ivyiza kuko wamenyereye gukora ibibi.
Nzobasanzaza nk’umuguruka utwarwa mu bugaragwa n’umuyaga.
Uyu ni wo mugabane wawe, umugabane nakugereye,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “kuko wanyibagiye ukizigira imana z’ibinyoma.
Nzoduza agahuzu kawe gashike mu maso yawe kugira ngo umaramare,

Narabonye ubusambanyi bwawe n’ivyipfuzo vyawe, n’ubumaraya bwawe buteye isoni! Narabonye ibikorwa vyawe vyo kwankwa urunuka, ivyo wakoreye ku mirambi no ku misozi. Uragowe, Yewe Yerusalemu! Mbega uzogeza ryari kuba uwuhumanye?”
Iri ni ryo jambo Uhoraho yatumye kuri Yeremiya ryerekeye uruzuba, ati:
“I Buyuda baragandaye, ibisagara vyaho bicitse intege; baraborogera igihugu, kandi akaruru kumvikana kava i Yerusalemu.
Abaganwa baho batuma amazi abakozi babo; na bo bakaja ku binogo bibika amazi, bagasanga nta mazi ariyo. Bagasubirana inyuma imibindi yabo ata kirimwo; bamaramaye, bihebuye, bitwikiriye imitwe.
Isi yase imigaga kuko ata mvura ikigwa mu gihugu; abarimyi barihebuye kandi bitwikiriye imitwe.
Mbere n’impongokazi iri mw’ishamba yataye umwagazi wayo ihejeje kuvyara kuko ata bwatsi.
Indogoba z’inyeshamba zihagarara ku dutwe tw’imisozi y’uruharabuga zihuzagizwa nk’imbwebwe zinyotewe; zahwereye mu maso kubera kubura ico zirya.”
Naho ivyaha vyacu bitwagiriza, yewe Uhoraho , gira ico ukoze ku bw’icubahiro c’izina ryawe. Kuko twakugararije kenshi; twaragucumuyeko.
Yewe vyizigiro vy’Abisirayeli, kandi ukaba umukiza wabo mu gihe c’amagorwa, ni kuki uri nk’umunyamahanga mu gihugu, nk’ingenzi iraye hano ijoro rimwe gusa?
Ni kuki umeze nk’umuntu azazaniwe, nk’umuhizi atagira inkomezi zo gutabara? Uhoraho , wewe uri hagati muri twebwe kandi twitirirwa izina ryawe, ntuduhebe!
Uku ni ko Uhoraho abwira aba bantu: “Bakunda cane kwangara; ibirenge vyabo ntibitekana. Ni co gituma Uhoraho atabemera; agiye kwibuka ibibi vyabo, abahanire ivyaha vyabo.”
Maze Uhoraho arambwira ati: “Ntusengere aba bantu ngo bamererwe neza.
Naho bisonzesha, sinzokwumviriza ugutakamba kwabo; naho batanga ibimazi bituriwe n’amashikanwa y’ifu, sinzobemera. Ahubwo, nzobamarisha inkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza.”
Ariko ndavuga nti: “Ewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, abavugishwa babo baguma bababwira bati: ‘Ntimuzobona inkota canke ngo mwicwe na kigoyi. Ni ivy’ukuri, nzobaha amahoro adashira muri aha hantu.’ ”

Maze Uhoraho ambwira ati: “Abo bavugishwa bavuga ibinyoma mw’izina ryanje. Sinabatumye canke ngo ndabatoranye canke ngo mvugane na bo. Bavugishwa kuri mwebwe ivyo beretswe bitari vyo, n’indagu, ubupfumu n’uruhendo rw’ubwenge bwabo.

Nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ku vyerekeye abo bavugishwa bariko bavugishwa mw’izina ryiwe: Si jewe nabatumye, ariko bavuga bati: ‘Inkota n’inzara ntibizoshika muri iki gihugu.’ Abo bavugishwa nyene bazorandurwa n’inkota n’inzara.

Kandi abo bariko baravugishwako bazotererwa mu mayira y’i Yerusalemu kubera ikigoyi n’inkota. Nta muntu wo kubahamba azoboneka baba bo canke abagore babo, abahungu babo canke abakobwa babo. Nzobarekurirako ivyago bibakwiye.
Uze ubabwire iri jambo uti: ‘Amaso yanje yuzuye amosozi mw’ijoro no ku murango ubudasiba; kuko umukobwa wanje w’inkumi, ari bo bantu banje, bakomerekejwe cane, uruguma rudakira.
Ninjiye mu gihugu, mbona abicishijwe inkota; iyo ngiye mu gisagara, mbona abishwe na kigoyi. Umuvugishwa n’umuherezi bagiye mu gihugu batazi.’ ”

Mbega warahevye Ubuyuda rwose? Mbega warataye Siyoni? Ni kuki watubabaje gushika aho tutagikira? Twari twizigiye amahoro, ariko nta ciza twabonye; twari twiteze igihe co gukira, ariko haje iterabwoba gusa.
Yewe Uhoraho , turemeye ububi bwacu n’ukugabitanya kwa ba sogokuruza; ni ukuri twaragucumuyeko.
Ku bw’izina ryawe ntuduhebe; ntutetereze intebe yawe y’ubwami. Niwibuke isezerano wasezeranye natwe nturyice.
Mbega ibigirwamana vy’amahanga vyotanga imvura? Mbega amajuru yonyene yozana imvura? Oyaye ni wewe wenyene, yewe Uhoraho Mana yacu. Ni co gituma tukwizigiye, kuko ari wewe ukora ivyo vyose.
Maze Uhoraho ambwira ati: “Naho Mose na Samweli bohagarara imbere yanje, basabira aba bantu umutima wanje ntiwobagirira imbabazi. Barungike kure bave imbere yanje! Nibagende!

Nibakubaza bati: ‘Tuje he?’ Uze ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Abagerewe gupfa, baje gupfa; abagerewe kwicishwa inkota, baje kwicwa n’inkota; abagerewe kwicwa n’inzara, baje kwicwa n’inzara; abagerewe kujanwa ari inyagano, bajanwe ari inyagano.’
Nzorungika ivyo kubazimanganya bine,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “inkota yo kubica, imbwa zo kubakwega, ibisiga hamwe n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba vyo kubashihagura no kubahonya.
Nzobahindura akajoreza mu bwami bwose bwo kw’isi kubera ivyo Manase mwene Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda yakoze i Yerusalemu.
Ni nde azokugirira akagongwe, ga yewe Yerusalemu? Ni nde azokugandarira? Ni nde azohagarara ngo abaze uko umeze?
Warantaye,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Ushishikara gusubira inyuma. Ni co gituma nzotuma ukuboko nkagusangangura; singishoboye kukwihanganira.
Nzobagosoza icuma c’amenyo bari ku marembo y’igisagara ca kino gihugu. Nzosanzaza abantu banje ndabarandure, kuko bataretse ingeso zabo mbi.
Nzorushaho kugwiza abapfakazi babo barute umusenyi wo ku kiyaga. Mu mashoka nzorungika umuranduzi wo kwica ba nyina b’imisore; nzobahwikiza giturumbuka ibiteye ubwoba n’uguhungabana.
Nyina w’abana indwi azocika intege, hanyuma acikane. Izuba ryiwe rizocokera hakiri ku murango; azoteterwa amaramare. Amasigarira nzoyamarisha inkota imbere y’abansi babo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Ese ayo ngowe, kubona mama yaramvyaye, jewe nkankwa n’igihugu cose! Sinaguranye canke ngo ngire uwungurana, ariko bose baramvuma.
Uhoraho yavuze ati: “Ni ukuri nzogukiza ku bw’intumbero nziza; kandi ni ukuri abansi bawe bazoza bagutakambira mu bihe vy’ivyago n’amarushwa.
Mbega umuntu yovuna icuma, icuma kivuye mu buraruko, canke umwakaka?
Ubutunzi bwanyu n’ibitayega vyanyu nzobitanga bibe isahu, ata kiguzi, kubera ivyaha vyanyu biri mu gihugu canyu cose.
Nzobahindura abagurano b’abansi banyu mu gihugu mutazi, kuko uburake bwanje buzokwatsa umuriro kandi uzokwaka uturira mwebwe.”
Yewe, Uhoraho , urabizi; unyibuke kandi unyiteho. Umporere abampama. Kuko uteba kuraka, ntuze unjane kure; wibuke ko nihanganiye ibitutsi ku bwawe.
Aho amajambo yawe yaza, narayariye; yambereye umunezero kandi yahimbaye umutima wanje, kuko nambaye izina ryawe, yewe Uhoraho Mana Mushoboravyose.
Sinigeze nicarana n’abacokoranyi, ngo nje mu bihimbaro vyabo; nicaye ukwanje kuko ukuboko kwawe kwari kuri jewe kandi ukaba wanyujuje umubabaro.
Ni kuki umubabaro wanje udashira n’igikomere canje ntigikire? Mbega umbereye nk’umugezi utari wo, nk’isoko umuntu atokwizigira?

Nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Niwihana, nzokugarukana kugira ngo unkorere; niwavuga amajambo abereye, ukareka ayatabereye, uzoba umuvugizi wanje. Abo bantu baze bahindukire baze iyo uri, ariko wewe ntuze uhindukire ngo uje iyo bari.
Nzoguhindura nk’uruzitiro kuri aba bantu, uruzitiro rukomeye rw’umwakaka; bazokugwanya ariko ntibazokunesha, kuko ndi kumwe nawe ngo ndagukize,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Nzogukiza ndagukure mu maboko y’abanyakibi ndagucungure abantu babi b’ibirara.”
Maze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimbwira riti:
“Ntuze urongore ngo uvyarire abahungu n’abakobwa aha hantu.
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho avuze ku vyerekeye abahungu n’abakobwa bavukiye muri iki gihugu no ku bagore ari bo ba nyina babo n’abagabo ari bo ba se babo.

Bazokwicwa n’ingwara zihonya. Ntibazogandarirwa canke ngo bahambwe, ariko bazoba nk’amase yandagaye hasi. Bazohona bishwe n’inkota n’ikigoyi, kandi imivyimba yabo izoba indya z’inyoni zo mu kirere n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba.”

Kuko ibi ari vyo Uhoraho avuze: “Ntuze winjire aho bariko bararya ibiryazagu; ntuze uje kugandara canke ngo ugire ikibabarwe, kuko namaze gukuraho umugisha wanje, urukundo rwanje n’akagongwe kanje kuri ubu bwoko,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Abakuru n’abato bose hamwe bazopfira muri iki gihugu. Ntibazohambwa canke ngo bagandarirwe, kandi nta n’umwe azokwimosha inkomvorera canke ngo yikebagure ku bwabo.
Nta n’umwe azozana indya zo kugaburira abagandaye, naho yoba ari se canke nyina, nta n’umwe azotanga ivyo kunywa ngo abagarukireko.
Kandi ntuze winjire aho bari mu birori ngo wicare urye canke unywe.”
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli avuze: Mu maso yawe kandi ukiriho nzokuraho ijwi ry’akanyamuneza n’uguhimbarwa hamwe n’amajwi y’umukwe n’umugeni aha hantu.
“Niwabwira aba bantu ibi vyose maze bakakubaza bati: ‘Ni kuki Uhoraho yageze ivyo vyago ngo bituzeko? Ikibi twakoze ni igiki? Ni ikihe caha twacumuye k’ Uhoraho Imana yacu?’
Maze uze ubishure uti: Ni kubera ba sogokuruza banyu bampevye, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, bagakurikira izindi mana bakazisaba bakazisenga. Barantaye ntibakurikira Ivyagezwe vyanje.
Ariko mwigenjeje nabi kurusha ba sogokuruza banyu. Raba ingene umuntu akurikira ugukomantara kw’umutima wiwe mubi aho kunyumvira.

Ni co gituma nzobaterera hanze y’iki gihugu nkabajana mu gihugu; baba mwebwe canke ba sogokuruza banyu mutigeze mumenya, aho ni ho muzokorera izindi mana ku murango no mw’ijoro, kuko ntazobagirira ubuntu na gatoya.”
“Ariko, imisi iraje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “aho abantu batazosubira kuvuga ngo: Ni ukuri nk’uko Uhoraho ari muzima, yakuye Abisirayeli muri Egiputa,
ariko bazovuga bati: Ni ukuri nk’uko Uhoraho ari muzima, yakuye Abisirayeli mu gihugu co mu buraruko no mu bihugu vyose yari yarabangarijemwo. Kuko nzobasubiza mu gihugu nahaye ba sekuruza.”
“Ariko ubu ngira ntume abarovyi benshi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “babarobe. Inyuma y’ivyo nzotuma abahigi benshi, bazobahiga ku musozi wose n’akarambi kose no mu bihoro vyo mu bitandara.
Inyonga zanje ziri ku nzira zabo zose; ntizihishijwe inyonga zanje, canke ngo icaha cabo gihishwe inyonga zanje.
Nzobasubiriza mu nkoko incuro zibiri ibibi vyabo n’icaha cabo, kuko bahumanije igihugu canje n’ibishushanyo vyabo bitagira ubuzima, bakuzuza ishamvu yanje ibigirwamana vyabo vyo kwankwa urunuka.”

Yewe Uhoraho , nkomezi zanje n’igihome kinkingira, ubwihisho bwanje mu gihe c’ivyago, amahanga azoza kuri wewe bavuye ku mpera z’isi bavuge bati: “Ba sogokuruza nta co bari batunze atari ibigirwamana, imana zitagira akamaro nta ciza zabazaniye.
Mbega abantu bokwiremera imana zabo bwite? Egome, ariko si imana z’ukuri!”
Nuko rero nzobigisha; ubu ngiye kubigisha ububasha bwanje n’inkomezi zanje. Maze bazomenya ko izina ryanje ari Uhoraho .
Icaha ca Yuda candikishijwe ikaramu y’icuma, gikorogoshowe n’isonga rya diyama, ku bisate vy’imitima yabo no ku mahembe y’ibicaniro vyabo.
N’abana babo baribuka ibicaniro vyabo n’inkingi za Ashera biri i ruhande y’ibiti bitotahaye no ku misozi miremire.
Umusozi wanje uri mu gihugu n’ubutunzi bwanyu n’ibitayega vyanyu vyose nzobitanga bibe isahu; hamwe n’ibitabo vyanyu vyo ku misozi, kubera icaha cakorewe hose mu gihugu canyu.
Kubera icaha canyu muzotakaza ishamvu yanyu nabahaye. Nzotuma muba abaja b’abansi banyu mu gihugu mutazi, kuko mwakije uburake bwanje, kandi uburake bwanje buzobarurumbirako ibihe vyose.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Aravumwe uwizigira umuntu, akishimira umuntu w’inyama n’amaraso kandi umutima wiwe ukava k’ Uhoraho .
Azoba nk’igiti kiri mu bugaragwa; ntazobona ugutera imbere kumuzako. Azoba ahagadutse ho mu bugaragwa, mu gihugu c’umunyu ata muntu ahaba.
Ariko hahiriwe umuntu yizigira Uhoraho , ivyizigiro vyiwe bikaba muri we.

Azomera nk’igiti gitewe hafi y’amazi gishorera imizi yaco mu migende y’amazi. Ntigitinya mu gihe c’ubushuhe; ibibabi vyaco bihora bitotahaye. Nticiganyira no mu mwaka w’uruzuba kandi nticigera kireka kwama ivyamwa.
Umutima uribesha kuruta ibintu vyose kandi ugwaye ingwara idakira. Ni nde yowutahura?
Jewe Uhoraho ni jewe nsesa umutima nkagera umushaha, ngo ngerere umuntu wese ibihwanye n’ingene yigenza, ibikwiranye n’ibikorwa vyiwe.”
Nk’uko inkware ibundikira amagi itataye ni ko n’umuntu aronka ubutunzi mu buryo bubi ameze. Niyacagatiza imyaka yiwe yo kubaho, ubwo butunzi buzomuhunga, kandi kw’iherezo azoboneka ko ari igipfu.
Hariho intebe y’icubahiro ishizwe hejuru, uhereye kw’itanguriro, iyo ni ca kibanza c’urusengero.
Yewe Uhoraho , vyizigiro vy’Abisirayeli, abaguta bose bazomaramara. Abagutera ibitugu bazomera nk’abanditswe mu mukungugu kuko bahevye Uhoraho , ari we soko y’amazi y’ubugingo.
Mvura, ewe Uhoraho , nca nkomera; nkiza nca nkira vy’ukuri, kuko ari wewe mpimbaza.
Baguma bambaza bati: “Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riri hehe? Nirishike none!”
Sinahunze ngo ndeke kuba umwungere wawe; urazi ko ntipfuje umusi wo kwihebura. Ibiva mu minwa yanje vyose biri imbere yawe.
Ntumbere agaterabwoba; uri ubuhungiro bwanje ku musi w’ivyago.
Abampiga nibamaramare, ariko jeho undinde kumaramara; nibagwe igihumura, ariko jeho undinde iterabwoba. Ubashitseko umusi w’ivyago; ubaranduze agatikizo incuro zibiri.
Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yambwiye, ati: “Genda uhagarare kw’Irembo ry’Abantu, iryo umwami w’i Buyuda acamwo asohoka canke yinjira; wongere uhagarare no mu yandi marembo y’i Yerusalemu.
Ubabwire uti: ‘Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yemwe bami b’i Buyuda namwe bantu bose b’i Buyuda na mwebwe mwese muba i Yerusalemu mugaca muri aya marembo.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Mwiyubare ntihagire uwikorera umuzigo ku musi w’Isabato canke ngo awinjize aciye mu marembo y’i Yerusalemu.
Ntimusohore umuzigo muwukuye mu mazu yanyu canke ngo hagire igikorwa na kimwe mukora ku musi w’Isabato, ariko mwitondere Isabato kuko ari iyera, nk’uko nategetse ba sogokuruza banyu.
Ariko baranse kunyumviriza canke ngo banabishireko umutima, bagamitse amazosi banka kunyumviriza canke kwemera gutozwa indero.
Ariko nimwanyumvira, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ntimwinjize imizigo muri iki gisagara kw’Isabato, mukitondera Isabato yera mu kutagira ico mukora kuri yo,

nuko rero abami bicara ku ntebe ya Dawidi bazoca muri aya marembo y’iki gisagara bari kumwe n’abaganwa babo. Bazokwinjira bari mu mikogote no ku mafarasi yabo, baherekejwe n’abantu b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu, kandi iki gisagara kizokwama kirimwo abantu ibihe bidashira.

Abantu bazoza bavuye mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu mihana ikikije Yerusalemu, no mu ntara ya Benyamini no mu kiyaya co mu burengero, no mu ntara y’imisozi y’i Negebu, bazanye amashikanwa n’ibimazi vyo guturirwa, amashikanwa y’ifu, ibimota neza vyose vy’ishimwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Ariko nimutanyumvira ngo mwubahe Isabato ngo mureke kugira ivyo mwiremeka kuri yo mwinjira mu marembo y’i Yerusalemu ku musi w’Isabato, nuko nanje nzokwatsa umuriro udashobora kuzima mu marembo y’i Yerusalemu uzoturira ingoro zaho.’ ”
Iri ni ryo jambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’ Uhoraho , rivuga riti:
“Manuka uje ku nzu y’umubumvyi, aho ni ho nzogira ico ndakubwiye.”
Nuko ndamanuka ku nzu y’umubumvyi, maze nsanga ariko arabumba.
Ariko inkono yariko arabumbamwo iryo bumba yononekarira mu ntoke ziwe; maze wa mubumvyi aca yongera kuribumbamwo iyindi nkono, ayigira uko yagomba.
Maze Uhoraho ambwira ijambo ati:

“Yemwe ab’inzu ya Isirayeli, mbega sinoshobora kubagira nk’uko uwo mubumvyi yagize?” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Nk’uko ibumba rimera mu ntoke z’umubumvyi, ni ko mumeze mu kuboko kwanje, yemwe ab’inzu ya Isirayeli.
Ninamenyesha ko ihanga canke ubwami bugiye kurandurwa, gusamburwa no gusangangurwa,
maze iryo hanga naburiye niryihana rikava mu bibi vyaryo, nzokwigarura sindabateze ivyago nari nateguye kubahanisha.
Kandi ikindi gihe ninamenyesha ko nzokwubaka ngashinga ihanga canke ubwami,
maze iryo hanga rigakora ibibi mu nyonga zanje ntirinyumvire, nuko nanje nzoreka kubashitsako ivyiza nari nabagereye.

Nuko rero bwira abantu b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Raba! Nateguye icago kuri mwebwe kandi nateguye kubagirira nabi. Nuko nimureke inzira zanyu mbi, umwe wese, maze mugaruke mu nzira nziza mureke n’ibikorwa vyanyu bibi.’
Ariko bazokwishura bati: ‘Oya na mba. Tuzokwibandaniriza mu migambi yacu; umwe wese azokwibandaniriza mu gukomantara kw’umutima wiwe mubi.’ ”
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nimubaze mu mahanga: ni nde yigeze yumva ikintu nk’ico? Hariho ikintu c’ubuyobe cakozwe n’umukobwa wanje Isirayeli!
Mbega shelegi y’i Libani murigera mubona yavuye ku gitandara yiberako? Amazi akanye ava muri yo arigera areka gutemba?
Ariko abantu banje baranyibagiye; baturirira ibimota neza imana zitagira ikimazi, bituma batsitara mu ngendo zabo no mu nzira zabo za kera. Bituma baca mu nzira zidaharuye no mu miharuro itubatse.
Nzohindura igihugu cabo amatongo, ahantu abantu bavugiriza agahwa; abazohaca bose bazotangara kandi bazozunguza imitwe.
Nk’uko umuyaga uhuha uvuye mu buseruko, nzobasanzaza imbere y’abansi babo; nzobatera umugongo ndabahishe mu nyonga hanje ku musi w’ivyago vyabo.”

Baravuze bati: “Nimuze, tugire imigambi yo kugwanya Yeremiya; kuko umuherezi ntazoreka kwigisha ivyagezwe, umunyabwenge ntazoreka gutanga impanuro, canke abavugishwa ngo bareke gushikiriza ijambo. Nimuze rero, tumugwanye mu kumuvuga nabi kandi ntitwumvirize ikintu na kimwe avuga.”
Nyumviriza, yewe Uhoraho ; niwumve ivyo abanyagiriza bariko bavuga!
Mbega iciza cokwishurwa ikibi? Ariko banyimbiye ikinogo. Wibuke ko nahagaze imbere yawe nkabavugira kugira ngo uhwamike uburake bwawe bubaveko.
Nuko rero reka abana babo bicwe n’ikigoyi; batange babe musi y’ubushobozi bw’inkota. Abagore babo nibabe ingumba n’abapfakazi; abagabo babo nibicwe, abahungu babo bicwe n’inkota mu ntambara.
Amaborogo niyumvikane mu mazu yabo aho uzozana giturumbuka abo kubatera, kuko bimvye ikinogo ngo ndakigwemwo kandi banteze imitego yo mu mpisho.
Ariko wewe Uhoraho , urabizi inama bangira zo kunyica. Ntubaharire ibibi vyabo canke ngo uhanagure ivyaha vyabo imbere yawe. Nibatsitarire imbere yawe; ubagwanye mu gihe c’uburake bwawe.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Genda ugure umubindi w’ibumba ku mubumvyi. Jana na bamwe mu batware, hamwe n’abaherezi
maze usohoke uje mu kiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu, i ruhande y’Irembo ry’Inkono zamenetse. Aho ni ho uzobamenyeshereza amajambo nzokubwira.

Uze uvuge uti: ‘Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yemwe bami b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu. Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli, avuze: Umviriza! Ngiye guteza icago aha hantu kizotuma mu matwi ya bose haza iminzerere.

Kuko bantaye maze bagahindura aha hantu ikibanza c’imana z’inyamahanga; barahatangiye ibimazi vy’imana batigeze bamenya; baba bo, baba ba sekuruza canke abami b’i Buyuda, kandi bujuje aha hantu amaraso y’abatagira icaha.

Batavye ibibanza vya Bayali ahantu hejuru ku misozi ngo bahatangire abahungu babo kw’ibimazi babishikanire Bayali, ikintu ntigeze ndabategeka canke ngo ncishe no mu kanwa, canke ngo cigere kiza no mu bwenge bwanje.
Nuko nimwiyubare, imisi iraje, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, aho abantu batazoba bacita aha hantu Tofeti canke ikiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu, ahubwo bazohita ikiyaya co gusogotwa.

Muri iki kibanza ni ho nzokwicira imigambi y’Ubuyuda n’iya Yerusalemu. Nzobareka bicwe n’inkota y’abansi babo, bagwe mu maboko y’ababahiga ngo babice, kandi imivyimba yabo nzoyihindura indya z’inyoni zo mu kirere n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba.
Nzosambura iki gisagara ndagihindure umusaka n’akajoreza; abahaca bose bazohinda agashitsi bavuze agahwa kubera ibikomere vyaho.
Nzotuma barya inyama z’abahungu babo n’iz’abakobwa babo, kandi bazoryana mu gihe bazoba bugarijwe n’abansi babo barondera kubica.’
Maze uze umene uwo mubindi mu maso y’abazoba bajanye nawe,

ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: Nzomenagura iri hanga n’iki gisagara nk’uko uwu mubindi w’umubumvyi umenaguritse kandi ata woshobora kuwunga. Bazohamba abapfuye muri Tofeti kugeza aho ata kibanza kizoba kigisigaye.
Uku ni ko nzogirira aha hantu n’abahaba, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Nzohindura iki gisagara nk’i Tofeti.
Amazu y’i Yerusalemu n’ingoro z’abami b’i Buyuda bizohumanywa nk’aha i Tofeti, amazu yose batuririyemwo ibimota neza, bageneye inyenyeri, bagashikanira ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa izindi mana.’ ”
Maze Yeremiya arataha avuye i Tofeti, aho Uhoraho yari yamutumye kuvugishwa, hanyuma ahagarara ku mbuga y’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho abwira abantu bose ati:

“Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli avuze: ‘Nimwumve! Ngiye guteza muri iki gisagara no mu mihana ihakikije ivyago vyose vyahagenewe, kuko bagamitse amazosi ntibumvire amajambo yanje.’ ”
Umuherezi Pashuri mwene Imeri, umukuru w’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , yumvise Yeremiya avugishwa ivyo,
aca atuma abamukubita kandi amushira mu minyororo kw’Irembo rya Benyamini riri haruguru y’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .
Bukeye bw’aho, Pashuri arekuye Yeremiya, akamukura mu minyororo, Yeremiya aca amubwira ati: “Uhereye ubu, izina ryawe Uhoraho aguhaye si Pashuri, ariko ni Magori Misabibu, ni ukuvuga uwuba mu bwoba.

Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Nzokurungikira ibiteye ubwoba wewe na bagenzi bawe bose; kandi uzobabonesha amaso yawe ubwawe basogotwa inkota n’abansi babo. Nzotanga Abayuda bose mu maboko y’umwami w’i Babiloni, na we azobatwara i Babiloni canke abicishe inkota.
Nzotanga ubutunzi bwose bw’iki gisagara ndabuhe abansi babo, ibintu vyaho vyose, ivy’igiciro n’ibitayega vy’abami b’i Buyuda.
Nawe Pashuri n’ababa mu nzu yawe bose muzojanwa mu kinyago i Babiloni. Aho ni ho uzopfira uhambwe, wewe n’abagenzi bawe abo wavugishijweko ibinyoma.’ ”
Yewe Uhoraho , warampenze, nanje ndemera; wandushije inkomezi uranesha. Nahindutse ikimaramare umusi urira; bose barantwenga.
Iyo mvuze, ndasemerera menyesha umuryano n’uguhona. None rero ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryanzaniye gutukwa no gucokorwa rikarinda rirenga.

Ariko iyo mvuze nti: “Sinzovuga ijambo ryiwe canke ngo nsubire kuvuga mw’izina ryiwe,” ijambo ryiwe rica rimera nk’umuriro mu mutima wanje, umuriro ukaka mu magufa yanje. Ndarushe no kuvyihanganira; ni ukuri, sindabishoboye.
Numva benshi bongorerana bati: “Ibiteye ubwoba impande zose! Murege! Reka tumurege!” Abagenzi banje bose biteze ko ntirimuka, bakavuga bati: “Kumbure bomusuka; natwe tugaca tumunesha, tukamwihora.”
Ariko Uhoraho ari kumwe nanje nk’umuhizi w’inkomezi; ni co gituma abangwanya bazotsitara, ntibazonesha. Bazotemba rwose maze bamaramare; kandi ibiteterwe vyabo ntibizokwigera vyibagiranwa.
Yewe Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, wewe usuzuma abagororotsi, ugatandukanya umutima n’umushaha, uze umpe kubona uguhora kwawe kuri bo, kuko urubanza rwanje naruguhaye.
Ririmbira Uhoraho ! Himbaza Uhoraho ! Akiza ubugingo bw’umukene abukuye mu maboko y’abanyakibi.
Umusi navukiyeko urakavumwa! Umusi mama yamvyariyeko ntugahezagirwe!
Uwazaniye inkuru data arakavumwa, uwatumye anezerwa, akavuga ati: “Uronse umwana, umuhungu!”
Uwo muntu arakaba nk’ibisagara Uhoraho yasambuye ata kagongwe. Arakumva akaruru mu gatondo, akaruru k’intambara mu mashoka.
Kubera ko atanyishe nkiri mu nda, ngo mama ampindukire imva, ku buryo nigumira muri we ibihe vyose.
Ni kuki navutse nkava mu nda ngo mbone umubabaro n’amarushwa kandi ngo ndangirize imisi yanje mu biteterwe?
Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya igihe umwami Zedekiya yamurungikira Pashuri mwene Malikiya n’umuherezi Zefaniya mwene Mayaseya. Bavuga bati:
“Dusigurize Uhoraho ubu kuko Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni ariko aradutera. Kumbure Uhoraho yodukorera ibitangaza nko mu bihe vya kera maze akagenda akareka kudutera.”
Ariko Yeremiya arabishura ati: “Bwira Zedekiya muti:

‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: Ngiye kuguhindukirizako ibigwanisho vyose vy’intambara ufise mu ntoke zawe, ivyo uriko urakoresha mu kugwanya umwami w’i Babiloni n’Abanyababiloni bari inyuma y’uruzitiro bamaze kukwugariza. Kandi nzobakoraniriza hagati muri iki gisagara.
Jewe ubwanje nzokugwanya n’ukuboko kwanje kubanguye kandi kw’inkomezi no mu burake n’ubushangashirwe n’ishavu ryinshi.
Nzokwica abantu bose baba muri kino gisagara, abantu n’ibikoko, kandi bazokwicwa n’ivyago biteye ubwoba.

Inyuma y’ivyo, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda, abaganwa biwe n’abantu bo muri iki gisagara bazosigara batishwe n’icago, inkota n’ikigoyi, nzobatanga mu maboko ya Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni n’abansi babo bashaka kubamara. Azobicisha inkota; ntazobagirira imbabazi canke akagongwe canke ikibabarwe.’
Vyongeye, bwira abantu muti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Raba, ngira nshire imbere yanyu inzira y’ubugingo n’inzira y’urupfu.
Umuntu wese azoguma muri iki gisagara azokwicishwa inkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza. Ariko uwuzokivamwo akishikana ku Banyababiloni babugarije azobaho; azokiza ubugingo bwiwe.
Nafashe ingingo yo kugirira nabi iki gisagara, si ineza, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Kizotangwa mu maboko y’umwami w’i Babiloni, na we azogitongoza umuriro.’
Vyongeye, bwira abo mu nzu y’ingoma y’i Buyuda muti: ‘Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .

Yemwe abo mu nzu ya Dawidi, uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Nimuce imanza zibereye uko bukeye, mukure mu maboko y’uwuhahaza uwanyazwe utwiwe, ahandi ho uburake bwanje buzoziriringa kubera ibibi mwakoze, buzorurumba nk’umuriro utazima.
Nzobagwanya mwebwe, ab’i Yerusalemu, mwebwe mwibera hejuru y’iki kiyaya, mu kibande c’amabuye, ni ko Uhoraho avuze; mwebwe muvuga muti: “Ni nde yoza kutugwanya? Ni nde yokwinjira mu bwihisho bwacu?”
Nzobahana ibikwiranye n’ibikorwa vyanyu, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Nzokwatsa umuriro mu mashamba yanyu na wo uzotongora ibintu vyose bibakikije.’ ”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho yambwiye: “Manuka uje ku kirimba c’umwami w’i Buyuda, maze uvuge ubu butumwa uti:
‘Niwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yewe mwami w’i Buyuda, wicara ku ntebe y’ubwami ya Dawidi, namwe baganwa hamwe n’abantu banyu muca muri aya marembo.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Nimukore ibigororotse n’ibibereye, mukize uwanyazwe mumukure mu maboko y’uwumucinyiza. Ntimugirire nabi canke ngo murenganye umunyamahanga, impfuvyi canke umupfakazi, kandi ntimuvishirize aha hantu amaraso y’uwutagira icaha.

Kuko nimwagira umwete wo kwitondera aya mabwirizwa, abami bo kwicara ku ntebe y’ubwami ya Dawidi bazokwama baca muri aya marembo y’iki kirimba, bari mu mikogote kandi bagendera ku mafarasi, baherekejwe n’abaganwa babo n’abantu babo.
Ariko nimutitondera aya mabwirizwa, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, indahiro ni jewe nyene; aha hantu hazohinduka umusaka.’ ”

Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho avuze ku vyerekeye iki kirimba c’umwami w’i Buyuda, ati: “Naho mumeze nka Gileyadi kuri jewe, mukamera nk’agatwe k’umusozi w’i Libani, ni ukuri nzoguhindura nk’ubugaragwa, nk’ibisagara ata muntu abibamwo.
Nzorungika abo kugusambura, umuntu wese afise ikigwanisho ciwe, maze bazoca ibiti vyizavyiza vy’amasederi yawe babiterere mu muriro.
Abantu bo mu bihugu vyinshi bazoca i ruhande y’iki gisagara maze babazanye bati: ‘Ni kuki Uhoraho yakoreye ibi bintu iki gisagara gihambaye?’
Maze bazokwishura bati: ‘Ni kubera bahemutse kw’isezerano ry’ Uhoraho Imana yabo, bagasenga bakongera bagakorera izindi mana.’ ”
Ntimuze muririre umwami apfuye canke ngo mumugandararire; ahubwo, muze muborogere uwujanywe nk’inyagano, kuko atazogaruka canke ngo asubire kubona igihugu c’amavukiro.
Kuko ibi ari vyo Uhoraho avuze ku vyerekeye Shalumu mwene Yosiya, yasubiye ku ngoma ya se umwami w’i Buyuda ariko akaba yarajanywe nk’inyagano: “Ntazogaruka.
Azopfira mu gihugu bamujanyemwo nk’inyagano; ntazosubira kubona iki gihugu.
Aragowe uwubakisha ikirimba ciwe ibigabitanyo, akubakisha ivyumba vyo hejuru akarenganyo, agakoresha abantu biwe atabahemba, ntabahembe ku bw’ubutame bwabo.
Avuga ati: ‘Nzokwiyubakira ikirimba kinini gifise ivyumba vyo hejuru vyagutse.’ Maze agaca amadirisha manini kuri co, akayashariza akoresheje amasederi hamwe n’irangi ritukura.
Mbega kugwiza amasederi menshi ni kwo kukugira umwami? Mbega so ntiyari afise ivyokurya n’ivyokunywa? Yakoze ibigororotse n’ibikwiye, kandi vyose vyagenze neza kuri we.
Yaraburanira abakene n’impahazwa, maze vyose bikagenda neza. Mbega ivyo si co bisigura kumenya jewe Uhoraho ?” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Ariko amaso yawe n’umutima wawe vyose wabishize ku nyungu mbi, ku kuvisha amaraso y’uwutagira icaha gucinyiza no kunyaga.”

None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze kuri Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda: “Ntibazomugandarira, ngo bagire bati: ‘Yo! Musazanje! Yo! Mushikanje!’ Ntibazomugandarira bati: ‘Yo! Databuja! Yo! Nyakwubahwa!’
Azohambwa nk’indogoba, azokwegwa hasi maze atererwe hanze y’amarembo y’i Yerusalemu.
Duga i Libani maze usemerere, ijwi ryawe ryumvikane i Bashani, semerera uri i Abarimu, kuko abo wikundiye bamenaguwe.
Narakuburiye igihe wari ukiri mu mutekano, ariko uravuga uti: ‘Sinzokwumviriza!’ Uko ni ko wagenda kuva mu buto bwawe; ntiwanyumviye.
Umuyaga uzotwara abungere bawe ahandi, n’abo wikundiye bazojanwa ari inyagano. Maze na we uzomaramara uteterwe ku bw’ibibi vyawe.
Wewe uba i Libani, wubatse icari cawe mu masederi, ese ukuntu uzoboroga mu gihe uburibwe buzogufata, nk’umugore afashwe n’ibise!”
“Ndahiye uguhoraho kwanje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “naho wewe, Yehoyakini mwene Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda, wari impeta yo ku kuboko kwanje kw’i buryo, nzogukura ku rutoke rwanje.
Nzogutanga mu maboko y’abashaka kukwica, abo utinya, ari bo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni n’Abanyababiloni.
Wewe na nyoko yakuvyaye nzobirukana muje mu kindi gihugu mutavukiyemwo, kandi aho ni ho mwempi muzopfira.
Ntuzogaruka muri iki gihugu ico wipfuza kugarukamwo.”
Mbega uwu muntu Yehoyakini, si umuntu yankwa, si inkono imenetse, ikintu ata n’umwe agishaka? Ni kuki we n’abana biwe birukanywe mu gihugu, bakaja mu gihugu batigeze bamenya?
Yewe wa gihugu, wa gihugu, wa gihugu, niwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho !

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nimwandike uwu muntu nk’aho ari umuntu atagira abana, umuntu atazokwigera atera imbere mu buzima bwiwe, kuko ata wo mu ruvyaro rwiwe azotera imbere, nta n’umwe azokwicara ku ntebe y’ubwami ya Dawidi ngo aganze i Buyuda.
Haragowe abungere bariko baratikiza bongera basanzaza intama zo mu buragiro bwanje!” Ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Ku bw’ivyo, uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, abungere baragira intama zanje: “Kubera mwasanzaje umukuku wanje mukazirukana ntimuzibabare, nzobasukako igihano kubera ibibi mwakoze,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Jewe ubwanje nzokwegeranya amasigarira y’umukuku wanje ndawukure mu bihugu nabirukaniyemwo maze ndabagarukane mu buragiro bwabo, aho bazogwirira kandi bakongerekana.
Nzoshiraho abungere babo bazobaragira, kandi ntibazosubira gutinya canke ngo bagwe igihumura, kandi nta n’umwe azobura muri bo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Ehe imisi iraje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “aho nzohagurukiriza Dawidi uwitwa Shami agororotse, umwami azoganzisha ubwenge kandi agakora ibiroranye n’ibigororotse mu gihugu.
Mu misi yiwe Yuda azokizwa na Isirayeli azoba mu mutekano. Iri ni ryo zina azokwitwa: Uhoraho ni Ukugororoka Kwacu.”
“Nuko rero, imisi iraje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “aho abantu batazosubira kuvuga ngo: ‘Ni ukuri nk’uko Uhoraho ari muzima,’ yakuye Abisirayeli muri Egiputa,
