ariko bazovuga bati: ‘Ni ukuri nk’uko Uhoraho ari muzima,’ yakuye uruvyaro rwa Isirayeli mu gihugu co mu buraruko mu bihugu yari yarabangarijemwo. Maze bazokwibera mu gihugu cabo bwite.”

Ku vyerekeye ba kamenyi: Umutima wanje umenekeye muri jewe; amagufa yanje yose ahinda agashitsi. Meze nk’imborerwa, meze nk’umugabo akomeye mugabo yaneshejwe n’umuvinyu, kubera Uhoraho n’amajambo yiwe yera.
Igihugu cuzuye abasambanyi; kubera umuvumo utumye igihugu kigandara kandi uburagiro bwo mu bugaragwa burakabiranye. Abavugishwa bakurikira ikibi kandi bakoresha ububasha bwabo ukutari kwo.
“Umuvugishwa n’umuherezi bompi nta vy’Imana bababaye; no mu Ngoro yanje nsangamwo ukugira nabi kwabo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Ni co gituma inzira yabo izoba iy’ubunyerere; bazokwirukanirwa mu mwiza kandi aho ni ho bazogwa. Nzobateza icago mu mwaka bazohanirwamwo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Mu bavugishwa b’i Samariya nabonye ikintu gisesema: Bavugishwa mw’izina rya Bayali bakazimiza abantu banje b’Abisirayeli.

No mu bavugishwa b’i Yerusalemu Nabonye ikintu c’ubuyobe: barasambana kandi bakibera mu binyoma. Bakomeza amaboko y’abanyakibi, kugira ngo ntihagire n’umwe ava mu bibi vyiwe. Kuri jewe bose bameze nka Sodomu; abantu b’i Yerusalemu bameze nka Gomora.”

Nuko rero, uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze ku vyerekeye abo bavugishwa: “Nzobarisha ivyokurya birura kandi nzobanywesha amazi arimwo ishano, kuko mu bavugishwa babo b’i Yerusalemu havuyemwo ukutubaha Imana kwakwiye mu gihugu hose.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Ntiwumvirize ivyo abo bavugishwa babavugako; babuzuza ivyizigiro bitari vyo. Bavuga ivyo beretswe bikuriye mu mitwe yabo, bitavuye mu kanwa k’ Uhoraho .
Bashishikara babwira abankengera bati: ‘ Uhoraho avuze ngo: Muzoba amahoro.’ N’abashishikara inzira z’ugukomantara kw’imitima yabo bababwira bati: ‘Nta co muzoba.’
Ariko ni nde wo muri bo yahagaze mu nama y’ Uhoraho ngo abone canke yumve ijambo ryiwe? Ni nde yumvirije canke yumvise ijambo ryiwe?
Raba, isegenya y’ Uhoraho izoza ivuye mu burake bwiwe, igihuhusi kizomanuka kizunguruke ku mitwe y’abanyakibi.
Uburake bw’ Uhoraho ntibuzosubira inyuma kugeza aho azoba yashikije imigabo yo mu mutima wiwe. Mu misi izoza muzobitahura neza.
Sinatumye abo ba kamenyi, ariko bagiye bariruka bajanye ubutumwa bwabo; sinavuganye na bo, ariko baravugishijwe.
Mugabo iyo baba barashishikaye mu nama yanje, bari kumenyesha abantu banje amajambo yanje kandi baba baratumye bahindukira bakava mu nzira zabo mbi no mu bikorwa vyabo bibi.
Mbega ndi Imana ya hafi gusa,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “mbega sindi n’Imana ya kure na ho?
Hari uwokwinyegeza ahantu kugira ngo sindamubone?” ni ko Uhoraho abaza. “Mbega sinuzuye ijuru n’isi?” Ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Numvise ivyo abavugishwa bavuga bavugishwa ibinyoma mw’izina ryanje. Bavuga bati: ‘Narose! Narose!’
Ivyo bizobandanya gushika ryari mu mitima y’abo ba kamenyi babesha, bavugishwa ibitagira epfo na ruguru vyo mu bugunge bwabo?
Biyumvira ko inzozi babwirana zizotuma abantu banje bibagira izina ryanje, nk’uko ba sekuruza baryibagiye mu gusenga Bayali?
Uwuvugishwa afise ivyo yarose nabivuge, ariko uwufise ijambo ryanje narivuge mu bwizigirwa. Mbega ivyatsi bipfana iki n’imbuto?” Ni ko Uhoraho abaza.
“Mbega ijambo ryanje si nk’umuriro,” ni ko Uhoraho abaza, “canke si nk’inyundo imenagura urutare?
Nuko rero,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “nzogwanya abo bavugishwa b’ibisuma bibana amajambo; maze bakavuga ngo avuye iwanje.
Ego cane,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “nzogwanya abo bavugishwa bavuga amajambo bishakiye bakavuga bati: ‘ Uhoraho yavuze.’

Ni ivy’ukuri, nzogwanya abo berekwa inzozi z’ibinyoma,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Babibwira abantu banje bakabazimirisha ivyo binyoma vyabo, kandi ntabatumye canke ntabatoranije. Nta co bamariye aba bantu na mba,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Aba bantu canke uwuvugishwa canke umuherezi, nibakubaza bati: ‘Mbega ijambo rivuye k’ Uhoraho ni irihe?’ Uze ubabaze uti: ‘Ijambo irihe? Nzobaheba, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.’
Uwuvugishwa canke umuherezi canke umuntu wese niyavuga ati: ‘Iri ni ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ,’ nzomuhana we n’abo mu nzu yiwe.
Ibi ni vyo umwe wese aguma abwira mugenziwe canke uwo mu muryango w’iwabo ati: ‘Mbega inyishu y’ Uhoraho ni iyihe?’ canke ati: ‘Mbega Uhoraho avuze ngw’iki?’

Ariko ntimuze musubire kuvuga ngo: ‘Iri ni ijambo rivuye k’ Uhoraho ’ kuko ijambo ry’umuntu wese ku giti ciwe rizoba ari irivuzwe na we. Rero mugoreka amajambo y’Imana nzima, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana yacu.
Mushishikara mubaza kamenyi ngo: ‘Mbega Imana yakwishuye iki?’ canke ngo: ‘Mbega Uhoraho yavuze iki?’
Naho mwemeza ngo: ‘Iri ni ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ,’ uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Mwakoresheje amajambo avuga ngo: ‘Iri ni ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ,’ naho nari nababujije kuvuga ngo: ‘Iri ni ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .’
Ni co gituma, vy’ukuri nzobibagira maze ndabaterere kure y’aho ndi mwe n’igisagara nabahaye mwebwe na ba sogokuruza banyu.
Nzoshitsa kuri mwebwe agakengerwe n’ibimaramare bidashira kandi bitazokwigera vyibagirwa.”

Igihe Yehoyakini mwene Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda n’abatware bose, abakora utugenegene n’abanyamyuga b’i Buyuda bari bamaze kujanwa i Babiloni na Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni abakuye i Yerusalemu, Uhoraho yanyeretse ibiseke bibiri vy’insukoni biri imbere y’Ingoro y’Uhoraho.
Igiseke kimwe carimwo insukoni nziza cane, nk’insukoni zeze imbere y’izindi, igiseke kindi carimwo insukoni mbi cane, ku buryo zitashobora kuribwa.
Maze Uhoraho arambaza ati: “Mbega ubona iki ga Yeremiya?” Ndishura nti: “Mbona insukoni. Muri zo harimwo nziza cane, ariko harimwo na mbi cane ku buryo zitoribwa.”
Maze Uhoraho ambwira ijambo ati:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: ‘Nk’uko izo nsukoni nziza zimeze, ni ko mbona abatwawe nk’inyagano b’i Buyuda, abo narungitse ngo bave aha hantu baje mu gihugu c’Abanyababiloni.
Inyonga zanje zizoba kuri bo kugira ngo ndabagirire neza, kandi nzobagarukana muri iki gihugu. Nzobubaka sinzobasambura, nzobateragira sinzobarandura.
Nzobaha umutima wo kumenya ko jewe ndi Uhoraho . Bazoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yabo, bazongarukako n’umutima wabo wose.’

Ariko nk’uko zirya nsukoni zindi ari mbi, gushika n’aho zitoribwa, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, uko ni ko nzogirira Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda, abatware biwe n’amasigarira y’ab’i Yerusalemu, baba abagumye mu gihugu canke abahungiye muri Egiputa.
Nzobahindura agaterabwoba kandi bazoba nk’icago ku bwami bwose bwo mw’isi, bazoba agatukisha n’agatwengo, agacamugani n’umuvumo ahantu hose nzoba nabasanzarije.
Nzotuma inkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza kuri bo gushika aho bazoherengeterera mu gihugu nabahaye bo na ba sekuruza babo.”

Ijambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho, rigenewe abantu bose b’i Buyuda, mu mwaka ugira kane Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, ukaba wari umwaka wa mbere Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni ari ku ngoma.
Nuko Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana abwira abantu bose b’i Buyuda n’ababa i Yerusalemu ati:

Kumara imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itatu, uhereye umwaka ugira icumi na gatatu Yosiya mwene Amoni umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma kugeza n’uwu musi, Uhoraho yampaye ijambo ndababwira kandi navuganye namwe ibihe vyinshi, ariko ntimwumva.
Kandi naho Uhoraho yarungitse abasavyi biwe yavugisha kuri mwebwe kenshi yongera yisubiriza, ntimwumviye canke ngo mubishireko umutima.
Barababwiye bati: “Hindukira, umwe wese ave mu nzira ziwe mbi n’ibikorwa vyiwe bibi, maze muzoshobore kuguma mu gihugu Uhoraho yabahaye mwebwe na ba sogokuruza banyu ibihe vyose.
Mureke gukurikira izindi mana, kuzikorera no kuzisaba, ntimundatse n’ibikorwa vy’intoke zanyu, maze nanje nta co nzobagira.”
“Ariko ntimwanyumviye,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “maze murandatsa mundakishije ibikorwa vy’intoke zanyu, bituma mwikwegera ingorane.”
Ni co gituma Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze ibi: “Ko mutumviye amajambo yanje,

nzohamagaza amahanga yose yo mu buraruko n’umusavyi wanje Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “maze batere iki gihugu n’abakibamwo n’amahanga yose ahakikuje. Nzobarandura ndabaherengeteze, kandi ndabahindure agaterabwoba n’abo kwankwa habe umusaka ibihe vyose.
Nzokuraho amajwi y’umunezero, n’imisi mikuru, amajwi y’umukwe n’umugeni, ijwi ry’urusyo n’umuco w’itara.
Iki gihugu cose kizohinduka umusaka, kandi aya mahanga azokorera umwami w’i Babiloni kumara imyaka mirongo indwi.

Ariko, iyo myaka mirongo indwi niyashira, nzohana uwo mwami w’i Babiloni n’ihanga ryiwe, igihugu c’Abanyababiloni, kubera ukugabitanya kwabo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “maze ndahahindure umusaka ibihe vyose.
Nzoshitsa kuri ico gihugu ibintu vyose navuze ko nzogiteza, vya bindi vyose vyanditswe muri iki gitabu vyavugishijwe na Yeremiya ku mahanga yose.
Bo ubwabo bazoba abagurano b’amahanga menshi n’abami bakomeye; nzobasubiriza mu nkoko ibikorwa bakoze n’ivyo bakoresheje intoke zabo.”
Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, yambwiye, ati: “Akira iki gikombe kiri mu ntoke zanje cuzuye umuvinyu w’uburake bwanje maze ukinyweshe amahanga yose nzogutumako.
Nibakinywako, bazozungurirwa badandabagirane kubera inkota nzoba ndungitse hagati muri bo.”
Nuko nakira ico gikombe mu kuboko kw’Uhoraho ndakinywesha amahanga yose Uhoraho yantumyeko.
Yerusalemu n’ibisagara vy’i Buyuda, abami baho n’abaganwa, ngo bihinduke imisaka n’ahantu hateye ubwoba ho gucokorwa no kuvumwa, nk’uko biri uwu musi;
Farawo umwami w’i Egiputa, abasavyi biwe, abaganwa biwe n’abantu biwe bose;
n’abanyamahanga bose baba aho; abami bose bo muri Uzi; abami bose bo mu Bafilisitiya (abo muri Ashikeloni, i Gaza, i Ekuroni, n’abantu basigaye i Ashidodi);
muri Edomu, i Mowabu n’i Amoni;
abami bose b’i Tiro n’i Sidoni; abami bo mu bizinga biri hakurya y’ikiyaga;
i Dedani, i Tema, i Buzi n’abari kure;
abami bose b’i Arabiya n’abami bose bo mu bihugu vy’abanyamahanga baba mu bugaragwa;
abami bose b’i Zimuri, i Elamu n’i Mediya;
n’abami bose bo mu buraruko, abo hafi n’abari kure, uko bakurikirana, ubwami bwose buri kw’isi. Kandi inyuma yabwo bwose, umwami w’i Sheshaki na we nyene azonywako.
Maze uze ubabwire uti: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli, avuze: ‘Nimunywe kandi muborerwe maze mudahwe, hanyuma mugwe ubutakivyuka kubera inkota nzorungika muri mwebwe.’
Ariko nibanka kwakira igikombe kiri mu kuboko kwawe ngo bakinywereko, uze ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: Mutegerezwa kukinywako!

Raba, ntanguye guteza icago iki gisagara citirirwa izina ryanje, none muzogenda mudahanywe? Ntimuzogenda mudahanywe, kuko mpamagaye inkota ngo ize ku bari mw’isi bose, ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.’

Nuko rero nuvugishwe aya majambo yose kuri bo, ubabwire uti: ‘ Uhoraho azokwivuga ari iyo hejuru; azoturagara ari ahera hiwe maze yivuge n’inkomezi atontomera iki gihugu. Azosemerera nk’abadandaza inzabibu, akankamire ababa kw’isi yose.
Urwo rwamo ruzokwumvikana gushika ku mpera z’isi, kuko Uhoraho azokwagiriza amahanga; azocira amateka abantu bose maze yicishe inkota ababi bose,’ ” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Raba, icago kiriko kirakwira hose kiva kw’ihanga kija ku rindi; isegenya ihambaye iraje iva ku mpera y’isi ija ku yindi.”

Muri ico gihe abasogoswe n’ Uhoraho bazoba ahantu hose, kuva ku mpera y’isi imwe gushika ku yindi. Ntibazogandarirwa canke ngo begeranywe canke ngo bahambwe, ahubwo bazoba nk’amase yandagaye ku musozi.
Murire muboroge, yemwe bungere; mwitembagaze mu mukungugu, yemwe bakuru b’umukuku. Kuko igihe canyu co kwicishwa inkota gishitse; muzogwa hasi nk’ikibumbano c’igiciro.
Abungere ntibazoronka aho bahungira, abarongoye umukuku nta buhungiro bazoronka.
Umve amaborogo y’abungere, ugutakamba kw’abarongoye umukuku, kuko Uhoraho aranduye rwose uburagiro.
Uburagiro butotahaye bubaye uruharabuga kubera uburake buhambaye bw’ Uhoraho .
Azoheba ikibundo ciwe nk’intambwe, kandi igihugu cabo kizoba umusaka kubera inkota y’uwuhonya no kubera uburake bw’inkazi bw’Uhoraho.

headings.text: Imyaka mirongo indwi yo mu kinyago

verses.text: Ingoma ya Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda igitangura, ni ho iri jambo ryaje rivuye k’ Uhoraho riti:

“Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Hagarara mu rugo rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho maze ubwire abantu bose bo mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda baza gusengera mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ivyo nzogutegeka vyose; ntugire ikintu na kimwe ukuramwo.
Kumbure bazokwumviriza maze umwe wese areke inzira yiwe mbi. Nuko nanje nzokwigarura ngo sindabarekurireko icago nagabiye kubashitsako kubera ibibi bakoze.
Uze ubabwire uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Nimutanyumvira ngo mwitondere Ivyagezwe vyanje, ivyo nabashize imbere,
kandi nimutumvira amajambo y’abasavyi banje ari bo bavugishwa, abo nabatumyeko ibihe vyinshi; naho mutabumviye,
nuko nzohindura iyi Ngoro nk’i Shilo, n’iki gisagara nzogihindura aho kuvumwa mu mahanga yose yo kw’isi.’ ”
Abaherezi, abavugishwa hamwe n’abantu bose bumva Yeremiya avuga ayo majambo ari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Ariko Yeremiya agiheza kubwira abantu ivyo Uhoraho yamutumye kuvuga vyose, abaherezi, abavugishwa n’abantu bose baramufata bavuga bati: “Utegerezwa gupfa!
Ni kuki uvugishwa mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho ko iyi Ngoro izomera nk’i Shilo kandi iki gisagara kikazoba umusaka ata muntu agishobora kukibamwo?” Maze abantu bose bakoranira aho ari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Abatware b’i Buyuda bumvise ivyo, baraduga bava ku kirimba c’umwami baja ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho hanyuma bicara mu bibanza vyabo vyari ku rwinjiriro rwo kw’Irembo Rishasha ry’ Uhoraho .
Nuko abaherezi n’abavugishwa babwira abatware n’abantu bose bati: “Uyu muntu akwiye gucirwa urubanza rwo gupfa kuko yavugishijwe ibibi kuri iki gisagara. Mwavyiyumviye n’amatwi yanyu ubwanyu!”
Nuko Yeremiya abwira abatware n’abantu bose ati: “ Uhoraho yantumye kuvugishwa kuri iyi Ngoro n’iki gisagara ibintu vyose mwamaze kwumva.
None rero nimuhindure ingeso zanyu n’ibikorwa vyanyu maze mwumvire Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Nuko Uhoraho azokwigarura ngo ntabateze icago yavuze ko azobateza.
Ku binyerekeye ndi mu maboko yanyu; nimunkoze ico mubona ari ciza kandi kibereye.

Ariko mumenye neza ko nimwanyica, muzoba mushize kuri mwebwe, ku gisagara canyu no ku bantu bose bakibamwo, amaraso y’uwutagira icaha, kuko mu vy’ukuri Uhoraho yandungitse kuri mwebwe ngo ndababwire ayo majambo yose muriko murumva.”
Nuko rero abatware n’abantu bose babwira abaherezi n’abavugishwa bati: “Uyu muntu ntakwiye gucirwa urubanza rwo gupfa! Yatubwiye amajambo mw’izina ry’Uhoraho Imana yacu.”
Bamwe mu bakurambere bo mu gihugu bigira imbere babwira ikoraniro ryose bati:

“Mika w’i Moresheti yaravugishijwe mu gihe ca Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda. Yabwiye abantu bose b’i Buyuda ati: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: Siyoni hazorimwa hamere nk’umurima, Yerusalemu hazoba ikigunguzi c’isakamburira, umusozi wubatsweko Ingoro na wo uzomerako ibisaka.’

Yaba umwami Hezekiya w’i Buyuda canke uwundi uwo ari we wese w’i Buyuda, hari uwamwishe? Mbega Hezekiya ntiyubashe Uhoraho akarondera ubuntu bwayo? Kandi Uhoraho ntiyigaruye, ngo ntashitse ivyago yari yabagereye? Ni twebwe nyene tugomba kwikwegera ivyago!”
Kandi Uriya mwene Shemaya w’i Kiriyati-Yeyarimu ni uwundi muntu yavugishijwe mw’izina ry’Uhoraho; avugishwa ivyo nyene kuri iki gisagara n’iki gihugu nk’uko Yeremiya yavuze.
Nuko umwami Yehoyakimu n’abatware biwe n’abakuru b’ingabo bumvise ayo majambo yiwe, umwami aca afata ingingo yo kumwica. Ariko Uriya avyumvise, agira ubwoba, aca arahunga aja muri Egiputa.
Umwami Yehoyakimu arungika Elunatani mwene Akubori muri Egiputa, bari kumwe n’abandi bantu.
Bakura Uriya muri Egiputa bamushira umwami Yehoyakimu, na we amwicisha inkota umuvyimba bawuterera aho bahamba abantu basanzwe.
Vyongeye, Ahikamu mwene Shafani ashigikira Yeremiya, bituma adashirwa mu maboko y’abantu ngo bamwice.
Mu bihe vya mbere vy’ingoma ya Zedekiya mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda, iri jambo ni ho ryatumwa kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’ Uhoraho .
Ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yambwiye: “Ukore ingogo n’ibiziriko hanyuma ubishire ku bitugu vyawe.
Maze utumeko abami: uwa Edomu, uwa Mowabu, uwa Amoni, uwa Tiro n’uwa Sidoni, ubicishije ku ntumwa zaje i Yerusalemu kwa Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda.
Uze ubahe ubutumwa bashira ba shebuja buvuga buti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: Muze mubwire ba shobuja muti:
Nakoresheje ubushobozi bwanje buhambaye n’ukuboko kwanje kw’inkomezi mu kurema isi n’abantu bayibako, n’ibikoko biri kuri yo, ndabiremesha ukuboko kwanje kubanguye, kandi ndabiha uwo ngomvye wese.
None rero ngira nshire ibihugu vyanyu mu maboko y’umusavyi wanje Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni; kandi n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba bizomwubaha.
Amahanga yose azomukorera we n’umuhungu wiwe n’umwuzukuru wiwe kugeza aho igihe c’igihugu ciwe kizorangirira. Maze na we amahanga menshi n’abami bahambaye bazoza bamuganze.

Ariko nihagira ihanga na rimwe canke ubwami na bumwe bwanka gukorera Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni canke bakanka kwicisha bugufi musi y’ingogo yiwe, nzohanisha iryo hanga inkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, gushika ndagisambuje ukuboko kwiwe.
Nuko rero ntimwumvirize abavugishwa banyu, canke abahamagara imizimu, abasobanura inzozi, abarozi canke abapfumu banyu bazobabwira bati: Ntimuzokorera umwami w’i Babiloni.
Bavugishwa ibinyoma imbere yanyu, ari vyo bizotuma mujanwa kure y’ibihugu vyanyu; nzobirukana kandi muzohonerayo.
Ariko nihagira ihanga ryunama musi y’ingogo y’umwami w’i Babiloni rikamukorera, nzotuma iryo hanga riguma mu gihugu ngo bakirime bongere bakibemwo, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.’ ”
Narungikiye ubwo butumwa nyene Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda. Ndamubwira nti: “Tega ibitugu vyawe ingogo y’umwami w’i Babiloni; umukorere we n’abantu biwe, ni ho uzobaho.
Ni iki cotuma wewe n’abantu bawe mupfa mwishwe n’inkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza ivyo Uhoraho yateguye kuzokwicisha ihanga ryose ritazosaba umwami w’i Babiloni?
Ntiwumvirize amajambo y’abavugishwa bakubwira ngo: ‘ntuzokorera umwami w’i Babiloni,’ kuko bariko bavugishwa ibinyoma.
‘Si jewe nabatumye,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Bavugishwa ibinyoma mw’izina ryanje. Ni co gituma nzobirukana aha hantu maze mupfireyo, mwebwe n’abo bavugishwa banyu bavugishwa imbere yanyu.”

Maze mbwira abaherezi n’abantu bose nti: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Ntimwumvirize abo bavugishwa bavuga ngo: Vuba cane ibikoresho vyo mu Ngoro y’Uhoraho bizogarukanwa bivuye i Babiloni. Bariko baravugishwa ibinyoma imbere yanyu.
Ntimubumvirize. Nimukorere umwami w’i Babiloni, kugira ngo mushobore kubaho. Ni igiki cotuma iki gisagara gihinduka umusaka?

Nibaba ari abavugishwa bafise ijambo ry’Uhoraho, nibinginge Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, bamusabe kugira ngo ibikoresho bisigaye mu Ngoro y’Uhoraho no mu ngoro y’umwami w’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu ntibize bijanwe i Babiloni.
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze ku vyerekeye inkingi, ikiyaga c’umwakaka, vya bikarabiro biterurwa n’ibindi bikoresho vyasigaye muri iki gisagara,

ivyo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni atajanye igihe yatwara Yehoyakini mwene Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda nk’inyagano amukuye i Yerusalemu akamujana i Babiloni, ari kumwe n’abishikira b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Ego, uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli avuze ku vyerekeye ibintu vyasigaye mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho no mu ngoro y’umwami w’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.
Bizojanwa i Babiloni kandi bizogumayo kugeza ku musi nzozira kubigarukana, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Maze nzobigarukana ndabisubize aha hantu.’ ”

Mu kwezi kwa gatanu kw’uwo mwaka, umwaka ugira kane, mu misi ya mbere y’ingoma ya Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda, kamenyi Hananiya mwene Azuri, yava i Gibeyoni, arambwira turi mu Ngoro y’Uhoraho imbere y’abaherezi n’abantu bose ati:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: ‘Nzovunagura ingogo y’umwami w’i Babiloni.
Mu myaka ibiri nzogarukana aha hantu ibikoresho vyose mu Ngoro y’Uhoraho ivyo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni yakuye ngaha akabijana i Babiloni.

Kandi nzogarukana aha hantu Yehoyakini mwene Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda n’abajanywe bose ari inyagano i Babiloni bakuwe i Buyuda,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ‘kuko nzovunagura ingogo y’umwami w’i Babiloni.’ ”
Maze umuvugishwa Yeremiya yishura uwo muvugishwa Hananiya bari imbere y’abaherezi n’abantu bose bari bahagaze ngaho mu Ngoro y’Uhoraho;
amubwira ati: “Amen! Icompa Uhoraho akabikora uko! Icompa Uhoraho agashitsa amajambo uvugishijwe akagarukana ibikoresho vyo mu Ngoro y’Uhoraho n’abajanywe ari inyagano i Babiloni bakagaruka hano.
Ariko rero, niwumve ivyo ngomba mvugire imbere yawe n’imbere y’abantu bose:
Kuva mu bihe vya kera abavugishwa bakwitangiye imbere na jewe twavugishijwe ivy’intambara, ikiza n’icago bizoba ku bihugu vyinshi n’ubwami bukomeye.
Ariko umuvugishwa avugishwa ivy’amahoro azomenyekana ko vy’ukuri yatumwe n’Uhoraho mu gihe ivyo yavugishijwe bizoba bishitse gusa.”
Maze uwo muvugishwa Hananiya afata ya ngogo yari ku bitugu vy’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya arayivunagura,

aca avugira imbere y’abantu bose ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Uku ni ko nzovunagura ingogo y’umwami Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni nkayikura ku bitugu vy’amahanga mu gihe kitarenze imyaka ibiri.’ ” Avuze ivyo, uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya aca arigira.
Inyuma y’igihe gitoya umuvugishwa Hananiya ahejeje kuvunagura ya ngogo ku bitugu vy’umuvugishwa Yeremiya, ijambo ry’Uhoraho ritumwa kuri Yeremiya riti:
“Genda ubwire Hananiya uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Wavunaguye ingogo y’igiti, ariko mu gishingo cayo uzoronka ingogo y’icuma.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: Nzoshira ingogo y’icuma ku bitugu vy’aya mahanga ngo ndabahe gukorera Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni, kandi bazomukorera. Mbere nzomuha no kuganza ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba.’ ”
Maze uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya abwira uwo muvugishwa Hananiya ati: “Umve, yewe Hananiya! Uhoraho ntiyagutumye, ariko wabwiye aba bantu ngo bizigire ibinyoma.
Kubera ivyo, uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Ngiye kugukura kw’isi. Muri uwu mwaka nyene ugiye gupfa, kuko wigishije abantu kugarariza Uhoraho .’ ”
Mu kwezi kw’indwi kw’uwo mwaka nyene, umuvugishwa Hananiya arapfa.

Ibi ni vyo vyari mw’ikete uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya yarungitse ari i Yerusalemu ku batware bacitse kw’icumu bari mu bajanywe ari inyagano, no ku baherezi, n’abavugishwa hamwe n’abandi bantu bose Nebukadineza yari yarajanye mu kinyago i Babiloni abakuye i Yerusalemu.

Aho hari inyuma y’uko umwami Yehoyakini n’umugabekazi ari we nyina, abatware b’i bwami n’abarongozi b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, abazi ubuhinga butandukanye n’abanyamyuga bari barajanywe mu kinyago bakuwe i Yerusalemu.
Yarungikanye iryo kete Elasa mwene Shafani na Gemariya mwene Hilukiya, igihe bari bagiye i Babiloni kuvugana n’umwami Nebukadineza batumwe na Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda. Yanditse avuga ati:
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze ku bajanywe ari inyagano bava i Yerusalemu bakaja i Babiloni:
“Nimwubake amazu muyabemwo; murime imirima murye ivyo yeze.
Murongore muvyare abahungu n’abakobwa; mukwere abahungu banyu abagore mushingire abakobwa banyu, kugira ngo na bo nyene bavyare abahungu n’abakobwa. Mugwire mube benshi; ntimugabanuke.
Vyongeye, muronderere amahoro no gutera imbere igisagara mwajanywemwo muri inyagano. Mugisengere k’ Uhoraho , kuko nicatera imbere, na mwebwe muzotera imbere.”
Ego, uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: “Ntimwemere ko abavugishwa n’abahamagara imizimu bari hagati muri mwebwe babahenda. Ntimwumvirize inzozi mubasaba kurota.
Bariko baravugishwa ibinyoma mw’izina ryanje. Si je nabatumye,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Imyaka mirongo indwi niyahera muri i Babiloni, nzoza aho muri maze nshitse isezerano ryo kugira neza kwanje ryo kubagarukana aha hantu.
Kuko nzi imigambi ndabafitiye,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “ni imigambi yo kubateza imbere, si iyo kubagirira nabi, ni imigambi yo kubaha ivyizigiro muri kazoza.
Maze, muzonyambaza muze munsenge, nanje nzobumva.
Muzondondera kandi muzombona mundondeye n’imitima yanyu yose.

Nzokwemera mumbone,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “kandi nzobagarukana ndabakure mu kinyago. Nzobegeranya ndabakure mu mahanga n’ahantu hose aho nabangarije,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “maze ndabagarukane hano aho nabakuye nkabajana mu kinyago.”
Mwovuga muti: “Uhoraho yaduhagurukirije abavugishwa na we i Babiloni,”
ariko uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ku vyerekeye umwami yicara ku ntebe y’ubwami ya Dawidi n’abantu bose mu basigaye muri iki gisagara, abo musangiye igihugu batajanywe nkamwe mu kinyago.
Ego, uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Nzorungika inkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza kuri bo bamere nk’insukoni ziboze zimwe ata muntu yoshobora kuzirya.
Nzobakinagiza n’inkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza kandi nzotuma bazinukwa n’ubwami bwose bwo kw’isi babe abantu bo kuvumwa bankwa na bose, bo gucokora n’iciro ry’umugani mu mahanga yose.
Kuko batumviye amajambo yanje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “ayo narungikanye kenshi abasavyi banje navugisha. Kandi namwe nyene abagiye mu kinyago ntimwumviye,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nuko rero, nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yemwe abajanywe nk’inyagano abo nirukaniye i Babiloni bavuye i Yerusalemu.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze kuri Ahabu mwene Kolaya na Zedekiya mwene Mayaseya, bariko baravugishwa ibinyoma muri mwebwe mw’izina ryanje: “Nzobashira mu maboko ya Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni, maze azobicira imbere y’amaso yanyu.
Kubera bo, abajanywe ari inyagano bavuye i Buyuda bari i Babiloni bazovuma abantu bavuga bati: ‘ Uhoraho arakakugirira nk’ivyo yagiriye Zedekiya na Ahabu, abo umwami w’i Babiloni yaturiye mu muriro.’

Kuko bakoze ivyo kwankwa urunuka mu Bisirayeli; bakoze ivy’ubusambanyi hamwe n’abagore b’ababanyi babo kandi bavuze ibinyoma mw’izina ryanje, ivyo ntari nababwiye gukora. Ndabizi kandi ndi icabona cavyo,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Mubwire Shemaya Umunehelamu, muti:

“Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: Warungikiye amakete abantu bose b’i Yerusalemu mw’izina ryawe, no kuri Zefaniya mwene Mayaseya umuherezi, no ku bandi baherezi. Wabwiye Zefaniya uti:
‘ Uhoraho yagutoranije ngo ube umuherezi mu gishingo ca Yehoyada ngo uzezwe inzu y’Uhoraho; uze ushire umusazi wese yiyadukiza ngo ni umuherezi mu minyororo no mu mpatane z’ivyuma mw’izosi.
None rero ni igiki catumye ata co ukora kuri Yeremiya w’i Anatoti, yigize umuvugishwa muri mwebwe?
Yaturungikiye ubu butumwa turi i Babiloni, ngo: tuzotebayo. Nuko nimwubake amazu muyabemwo; murime imirima murye ivyeze muri yo.’ ”
Maze Zefaniya umuherezi asomera uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya iryo kete.
Hanyuma ijambo ry’Uhoraho ritumwa kuri Yeremiya riti:
“Rungika ubu butumwa ku bajanywe nk’inyagano bose uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze kuri Shemaya Umunehelamu: kuko Shemaya yabavugishirijwe imbere, naho ntari namutumye, agatuma mwizera ikinyoma,

uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ni ukuri nzohana Shemaya Umunehelamu n’abamukomokako. Ntazogira n’umwe azosigara muri mwebwe, canke ngo abone ivyiza nzogirira aba bantu, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, kuko yigishije abantu kungarariza.’ ”
Iri ni ryo jambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli, avuze: ‘Niwandike mu gitabu amajambo yose nakubwiye.
Imisi iraje, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, aho nzogarukana abantu banje b’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda ndabakuye mu kinyago nkabasubiza mu gihugu nahaye ba sekuruza babo ngo bacegukire, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.’ ”
Aya ni yo majambo Uhoraho yavuze, yerekeye Isirayeli na Yuda:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Induru itewe n’ubwoba irumvikanye, ni iterabwoba, si ijwi ry’amahoro.
Nimubaze kandi murabe: Mbega umugabo yoja ku bise ngo avyare abana? None ni kuki mbona umugabo wese w’inkomezi agenda yifashe ku nda nk’umugore ari ku bise, mu maso habo bose hijiriwe biteye ubwoba?
Ewe kuntu uwo musi uzoba ari mubi! Nta wundi uzosa na wo. Kizoba ari igihe c’amarushwa kuri Yakobo, ariko azokivamwo impore.
‘Kuri uwo musi,’ ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze, ‘nzovuna ingogo yari ku mazosi yabo maze ncagagure iminyororo ibaboshe. Abanyamahanga ntibazokwongera kubagira abaja babo.
Ahubwo, bazokorera Uhoraho Imana yabo na Dawidi umwami wabo, uwo nzohagurutsa ku bwabo.

Nuko ntutinye, yewe Yakobo musavyi wanje; ntugire ubwoba yewe Isirayeli,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Ni ukuri nzogukiza ndagukure mu kibanza ca kure, abagukomokako bave iyo bajanywe ari inyagano. Yakobo azokwongera kwibera mu mahoro n’umutekano, kandi nta wuzosubira kumutera ubwoba.

Ndi kumwe nawe kandi nzogukiza, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. N’aho noherengeteza amahanga yose ayo nakwangarijemwo, wewe sinzoguherengeteza. Nzoguhana, ariko nzobikora ku rugero rukwiye; sinzokureka ngo ugende udahanywe.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Igikomere cawe ntigishobora gukira, wakomeretse ku buryo bidashoboka ko ukira.
Nta wo kukuburanira, nta muti w’igisebe cawe, nta muti wogukiza.

Abo mwasezeranye bose barakwibagiye; nta co bitwararitse mu vyawe. Nagukubise nk’uko umwansi wawe yobigira kandi naguhanye nka ruburakigongwe, kuko ukugabitanya kwawe ari kwinshi ivyaha vyawe bikaba umurengera.
Ni kuki urizwa n’igikomere cawe, kandi uburibwe bwawe butagira umuti? Kubera ukugabitanya kwawe guhambaye n’ivyaha vyawe vyinshi ni co catumye nkugirira gutyo.
Ariko abagusahuye na bo bazosahurwa; abansi bawe bose bazojanwa ari inyagano. Abagusahura bose bazosahurwa; ababanyaga na bo bazonyagwa.
Ariko mwebwe nzobakiza kandi nzokiza ibikomere vyanyu,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “kuko witwa umuntu ata co amaze, Siyoni hahebwe.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nzosubira kwubaka amahema ya Yakobo ngirire akagongwe aho muba; igisagara kizosubira cubakwe ku misaka yaco, kandi ikirimba kizosubira guhagarara mu kibanza cahozemwo.
Muri bo hazokwumvikana indirimbo n’amashimwe n’ijwi ry’umunezero. Nzobagwiza, ntibazoba bake na mba; nzobatera iteka, ndabakureko agakengerwe.
Abana babo bazoba nk’uko bahoze kera, kandi bazosubira kuba ikoraniro imbere yanje; nzohana abacinyiza bose.
Umurongozi wabo azoba umwe muri bo; umutware wabo azova hagati muri bo. Nzomwiyegereza na we azonyegera, kuko ni nde yokwemera kwiheba ngo aze yegere aho ndi?” Ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Nuko muzoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yanyu.”
Raba, isegenya y’ Uhoraho izozanana n’uburake, igihuhuta gikomeye kizoza ku mitwe y’abakora ibibi.
Ishavu ry’inkazi ry’ Uhoraho ntirizosubira inyuma kugeza ashikije imigambi iri mu mutima wiwe. Mu misi izoza ivyo muzobitahura.
Muri ico gihe, Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Muri ico gihe, nzoba Imana y’imiryango yose ya Isirayeli, na bo bazoba abantu banje.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Abantu bazoba barokotse inkota bazogirirwa ubuntu bageze mu bugaragwa kuko nzoza kugira ngo mpe akaruhuko Isirayeli.”
Uhoraho yaratwiyeretse muri kahise, avuga ati: “Narabakunze urukundo rudashira; nabakwegesheje imbabazi zanje.
Nzosubira kububaka kandi wewe mukobwa Isirayeli, uzosubira kwubakwa. Kandi uzosubira gutora udushako tw’ingoma twawe maze usohoke utamba uri kumwe n’abanezerewe.
Kandi uzosubira gutera imizabibu yawe ku turambi tw’i Samariya; abarimyi bazoyitera kandi bazonezererwa ivyo yamye.
Hazobaho umusi abarinzi bazosemerera bari ku mirambi ya Efurayimu bati: ‘Nimuze tuduge i Siyoni, tuduge aho Uhoraho Imana yacu iri.’ ”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Muririmbane umunezero ku bwa Yakobo; nimutere impundu ku bw’ihanga riruta ayandi. Mutume uguhimbaza kwanyu kwumvikana, muvuga muti: ‘Yewe Uhoraho , kiza abantu bawe, amasigarira y’Abisirayeli.’
Raba, nzobazana ndabakuye mu gihugu co mu buraruko, ndabegeranye ndabakuye ku mpera z’isi. Muri bo hazoba harimwo impumyi n’abamugaye, abagore bibungenze n’abari ku bise; bazogaruka ari isinzi.
Bazoza barira; bazonsenga nanje ndabagarukane. Nzobarongorera i ruhande y’imigezi y’amazi mu nzira igororotse aho batazotsitara, kuko ndi Se wa Isirayeli, kandi Efurayimu akaba imfura yanje.”
Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho , yemwe mahanga; murimenyeshe mu bizinga vya kure muti: “Uwasabagije Abisirayeli azobegeranya kandi azoragira umukuku wiwe nk’umwungere.
Kuko Uhoraho azobohora aba Yakobo abacungure abakuye mu maboko y’ababarusha inkomezi.

Bazoza biha akamo k’umunezero ku misozi ya Siyoni; bazonezererwa ivyo Uhoraho azobaha, ingano, umutobe musha w’umuvinyu n’amavuta ya elayo, imyagazi y’imikuku n’inyana z’inka. Bazomera nk’umurima wavomerewe neza, kandi ntibazosubira kubabara.
Abakobwa b’inkumi bazotamba banezerwe, n’abasore hamwe n’abatama. Nzohindura ikigandaro cabo umunezero; nzobahoza ndabanezereze mu gishingo c’umubabaro.
Nzoha abaherezi umusesekara, kandi abantu banje bazohazwa n’ivyo ndabahaye birusha ibindi, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Induru yumvikaniye i Rama, amarira n’amaborogo menshi, Rasheli aririra abana biwe kandi yanka guhozwa, kuko batakiriho.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Hoza ijwi ryawe rireke kurira n’amaso yawe areke gukorora amosozi, kuko igikorwa cawe kizohabwa ingero, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Bazogaruka bavuye mu gihugu c’umwansi wabo.
Nuko rero hariho ivyizigiro ku bagukomokako, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Abana bawe bazogaruka mu gihugu cabo.”
“Numvise neza ukuniha kwa Efurayimu, ngo: Wampanye nk’uko bakubita ishuri y’ikigaba, kandi warampanye vy’ukuri. Ngarukana, nanje nzogaruka, kuko uri Uhoraho Imana yanje.
Inyuma y’aho nangariye, narihanye; aho mariye gutahura, narikubise mu gikiriza. Naramaramaye nterwa n’isoni kuko niremetse ibiteterwe vyo mu buto bwanje.
Mbega Efurayimu si umuhungu wanje nkunda, umwana wanje nezererwa? Naho namwagirije kenshi, ndacamwibuka. Ni co gituma umutima wanje ukimugirira ikibabarwe; ndamubabara cane,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Shinga ivyapa vyo ku nzira; ushinge imambo. Wiyumvire inzira, ibarabara ucamwo. Garuka, yewe mukobwa wa Isirayeli, garuka mu bisagara vyawe.
Uzogeza ryari kwangara, yewe mukobwa w’ikigaba wa Isirayeli? Uhoraho agira areme ikintu gishasha kw’isi, umugore azorondera umugabo.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: “Aho nzobagarukanira ndabakuye mu kinyago, abantu bo mu gihugu c’i Buyuda no mu bisagara bihakikije bazosubira kuvuga aya majambo bati: ‘Uhoraho aguhezagire, yewe wa nzu y’ubugororotsi, yewe musozi wera.’
Abantu bazoba hamwe i Buyuda no mu bisagara vyaho vyose, abarimyi n’abaragira amasho yabo.
Nzosubiza intege abadendebukiwe, mpaze n’abaguye isari.”
Inyuma y’ivyo nca ndikangura nderaguza hirya no hino. Itiro ryanje ryari riryoshe cane.
“Imisi iraje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “nzoteragira ubwami bwa Isirayeli n’ubwa Yuda mu kubaha umunago w’abantu n’uw’ibitungwa.
Nk’uko nabakurikiranye kugira ngo ndabarandure, ndabatsinde hasi, ndabahonye, ndabamare kandi ndabateze ivyago, ni ko nzogira umwete wo kububaka no kubateragira,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Muri iyo misi abantu ntibazosubira kuvuga ngo: ‘Ba se bariye inzabibu zitarera, abahungu babo baba ari bo bajigurwa mu menyo.’ ”
Ahubwo, umwe wese azozira ivyaha vyiwe; uwuzorya inzabibu zitarera, ni we nyene azojigurwa mu menyo.
“Igihe kiraje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “aho nzogirana isezerano rishasha n’inzu ya Isirayeli hamwe n’inzu ya Yuda.

Ntirizoba risa na rya sezerano nagirana na ba sekuruza babo, aho nabafata ukuboko nkabarongora ndabakura mu gihugu ca Egiputa, kuko bavuye mw’isezerano ryanje, naho nari Shebuja,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

“Iri ni ryo sezerano nzogirana n’inzu ya Isirayeli inyuma y’ico gihe,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Nzoshira ivyagezwe vyanje mu bwenge bwabo, ndavyandike mu mitima yabo. Nzoba Imana yabo, na bo babe abantu banje.

Ntibazosubira kwigisha ababanyi babo, canke ngo babwirane hagati yabo bati: ‘Menya Uhoraho ,’ kuko bose bazomenya jewe, kuva kuri muto muri bo kugeza ku mukuru,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Kuko nzobaharira ibibi vyabo kandi sinzosubira kwibuka ivyaha vyabo.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, uwatumye izuba kwaka ku murango, agategeka ukwezi n’inyenyeri ngo vyake mw’ijoro, avyura ikiyaga ngo gisuriranye imikuba yaco, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo zina ryiwe:
“Kiretse ivyo vyagezwe nashinze bimvuye imbere,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “Abisirayeli ntibazokwigera bareka kuba ihanga imbere yanje.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Iyo amajuru aba yoshobora gupimwa n’amatanguriro y’isi agashobora guserangurwa ni ho noshobora guheba uruvyaro rwa Isirayeli kubera ivyo bakoze vyose,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Imisi iraje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “aho iki gisagara kizokwubakwa ku bwanje uhereye ku munara wa Hananeli kugeza kw’Irembo ryo mu Mfuruka.
Umugozi wo kugera uzogororwa kuva ngaho kugeza ku gasozi ka Garebu maze uhindukire gushika i Gowa.

Mu Kiyaya cose aho bata imivyimba n’umunyota, no ku misezero yose gushika mu mwonga wa Kidironi kubandanya mu buseruko gushika mu mfuruka yo kw’Irembo ry’Amafarasi, hazoba ahera h’Uhoraho. Iki gisagara ntikizosubira kurandurwa no gusamburwa.”
Iri ni ryo jambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’ Uhoraho mu mwaka ugira icumi Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, ukaba wari umwaka wa cumi n’umunani Nebukadineza ari ku ngoma.
Ingabo z’umwami w’i Babiloni zari zugarije i Yerusalemu, kandi Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana yari yugaraniwe mu rugo rw’abarinda ku kirimba c’umwami w’i Buyuda.

Maze Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda yari yamushize mw’ibohero ngaho amwagiriza ati: “Ni kubera iki uvugishwa gutyo? Uvuga uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ngira nshire iki gisagara mu maboko y’umwami w’i Babiloni, kandi azogifata.
Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda ntazokwikiza ngo ave mu maboko y’Abanyababiloni ariko ni ukuri azofatwa mpiri n’umwami w’i Babiloni, kandi azovugana na we imbonankubone amwibonere n’amaso yiwe.
Azojana Zedekiya i Babiloni, aho azoguma gushika maze guhigura na we, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Niwagwana n’Abanyababiloni ntuzotsinda.’ ”
Yeremiya avuga ati: “Ijambo Uhoraho yantumyeko ryavuga riti:
‘Hanameli mwene Shalumu sowanyu agira aze aho uri akubwire ati: Gura itongo riri i Anatoti, kuko uri uwo mu muryango wa hafi ufise uburenganzira kandi utegerezwa kurigura.’

Maze, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabivuze, mwenewacu Hanameli aza aho ndi mu rugo rw’abarinzi bo ku kirimba arambwira ati: Gura itongo ryanje riri i Anatoti mu ntara ya Benyamini. Ko biri mu vyo urekuriwe ngo uricungure ribe iryawe, ryigurire. Nari nzi ko ivyo bivuye k’ Uhoraho .
Nuko nca ngura iryo tongo ryari i Anatoti ryari irya mwene datawacu Hanameli nca ndamupimira shekeli icumi n’indwi z’ifeza.
Ndamwandikira kandi nshirako n’ikidodo ku rwandiko rw’ubuguzi, nshirako n’ivyabona, mpima na za feza ku munzane.
Ntwara rwa rwandiko rw’ubuguzi, ruriko vya bidodo rwanditsemwo ingingo n’amasezerano, hamwe n’urundi rutariko ikidodo,

Maze mpa rwa rwandiko Baruki mwene Neriya, mwene Mahaseya, imbere ya mwenewacu Hanameli na vya vyabona vyose vyashira umukono kuri urwo rwandiko n’Abayuda bose bari bicaye mu rugo rw’abarinzi b’umwami.
Mbwirira Baruki mu maso yabo nti:

‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli, avuze: Akira aya makopi yompi, y’urwandiko rw’ubuguzi, iyiriko ikidodo n’iyitariko ikidodo, maze ubishire mu mubindi w’ibumba kugira ngo aze amare igihe kirekire.’
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli, avuze: ‘Amazu, amatongo n’imizabibu bizosubira kugurwa muri iki gihugu.’
Maze gutanga ya makete y’ubuguzi nkayaha Baruki mwene Neriya, nsenga Uhoraho nti:
‘Ewe, Uhoraho Nyeninganji, waremye ijuru n’isi ubiremesheje ububasha bwawe n’ukuboko kwawe kw’inkomezi, nta na kimwe kikunanira.
Werekanye urukundo ku bantu ibihumbi ariko uzana igihano c’ivyaha vy’abavyeyi ku bana babo. Yewe Mana ihambaye, izina ryawe ni Uhoraho Mushoboravyose,
imigambi yawe irahambaye kandi ivyo ukora birakomeye. Inyonga zawe zibona inzira zose z’abantu; uha ingero umuntu wese ikwiranye n’ingeso ziwe n’ibikorwa vyiwe.
Wakoze ibitangaza n’ibimenyetso muri Egiputa kandi washishikaye kubikora, haba muri Isirayeli, haba no mu bantu bose, kandi wihaye izina rihambaye nk’uko biri n’uwu musi.
Wakuye ubwoko bwawe Isirayeli muri Egiputa ubukujeyo ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza, n’ukuboko kwawe kw’inkomezi kuramvuye n’ibiteye ubwoba.
Wabahaye iki gihugu wari wararahiye ba sekuruza babo, igihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki.
Baraza baracinjira baracegukira, ariko ntibakwumvira canke ngo bitondere Ivyagezwe vyawe; ntibakora ivyo wabategetse gukora. Ni co catumye ubateza ivyago.
Raba ingene hubatswe ivyo kwuririrako ngo bafate igisagara. Kubera inkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza, igisagara kizoshirwa mu maboko y’Abanyababiloni bagiteye. Ivyo wavuze vyarashitse, nk’uko mubibona ubu.
Kandi naho iki gisagara kizogwa mu maboko y’Abanyababiloni, wewe Uhoraho Nyeninganji, umbwiye uti: Nugure itongo n’ifeza zawe urondere n’ivyabona.’ ”
Nuko ijambo ry’Uhoraho ritumwa kuri Yeremiya riti:
“Ndi Uhoraho , Imana y’abafise umubiri bose. Hari ikintu conanira jewe?”
Nuko, uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ati: “Ngira nshire iki gisagara mu maboko y’Abanyababiloni na Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni, na bo bazogifata.

Abanyababiloni bariko batera iki gisagara bazocinjira bagiturire; bazogitongoza umuriro, harimwo n’amazu yose abantu bantereyemwo ishavu mu kwurira hejuru kuri yo no gucanira ibimota neza Bayali no mu kumijagira amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa imbere y’izindi mana.

Abantu bo muri Isirayeli mu Buyuda nta kindi bakoze atari ibibi gusa mu nyonga zanje uhereye mu buto bwabo; ni ukuri, Abisirayeli nta kindi atari ukuntera ishavu kubera ivyo intoke zabo zakoze,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Kuva igihe cubakiwe gushika uwu musi, iki gisagara cavyuye uburake n’ubushangashirwe bwanje ku buryo ntegerezwa kukirandura mu nyonga zanje.
Abisirayeli n’Abayuda n’abantu bose baranshavuje kubera ibibi bakoze, bo ubwabo, abami babo n’abaganwa babo, abaherezi babo n’abavugishwa, abantu b’i Buyuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu.
Banteye ibitugu, ntibantumbera; naho nabigishije kenshi, ntibanyumviye canke ngo bemere guhanwa.
Bashinze ibigirwamana vyabo vy’ubuyobe mu Ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje maze barayihumanya.

Bubatse ibibanza vya Bayali mu kiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu ngo bahashikanire ibimazi vy’abahungu babo n’abakobwa babo babiha Moleki, naho ntigeze ndabibategeka, canke ngo vyinjire no mu bwenge bwanje, ko bokora ikizira kingana gutyo gituma Yuda acumura.
Muvuga kuri iki gisagara muti: ‘Iki gisagara kizoshirwa mu maboko y’umwami w’i Babiloni biciye mu nkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza,’ ariko uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze:
‘Ni ukuri nzobegeranya bavuye mu bihugu vyose ivyo nzobirukaniramwo mu bushangashirwe no mu burake bwanje; nzobagarukana aha hantu bahabe mu mahoro.
Bazoba abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yabo.
Nzobaha kugira umutima umwe wo kunyumvira, kugira ngo bame banyubaha imisi yose kandi kugira ngo bibabere vyiza bo ubwabo n’abana babo bazovuka hanyuma.
Nzogiriranira na bo isezerano ritazoshira: Sinzokwigera mpeba kubagirira neza, kandi nzobashiramwo umutima wo kunyubaha, kugira ngo ntibaze bantere ibitugu na mba.
Nzonezerwa no kubagirira neza kandi vy’ukuri nzobateragira muri iki gihugu n’umutima wanje wose n’umushaha wanje wose.’ ”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nk’uko narekuriye ubu bugesera bungana butya kuri aba bantu, ni ko nzobaha ukugubwa neza nabasezeraniye.
Bazosubira kugura amatongo muri iki gihugu ico muvuga muti: ‘Ni umusaka, nta bantu canke ibikoko bikirimwo, kuko cahawe Abanyababiloni.’

Amatongo azogurwa ifeza, impapuro z’ubuguzi zizokwandikwa zishizweko umukono, zishirweko ikidodo n’ivyabona bijeko mu ntara ya Benyamini, mu mihana ikikije Yerusalemu, mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu bisagara vyo mu ntara y’imisozi, iri mu kiyaya n’iy’i Negebu, kuko nzosubira kuhubaka, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.”
Yeremiya acugaraniwe mu rugo rw’abarinzi, ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryatumwe kuri we ubwa kabiri, riti:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze, Uwaremye isi, Uhoraho yayiremye akayikomeza, Uhoraho ni ryo zina ryiwe, ati:
‘Mpamagara nanje ndakwitaba ndakubwire ibihambaye kandi bidaserangurwa utazi.’

Kuko uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze ku vyerekeye amazu yo muri iki gisagara n’ibirimba vy’abami b’i Buyuda vyasambuwe kugira ngo bikoreshwe mu kugwanya igitero kibugarije hamwe n’inkota y’umwansi

mu gihe bazoba bariko baragwanya Abanyababiloni: amazu yabo azokwuzura imivyimba y’abantu nzokwicisha inkota kubera ishavu ryanje n’uburake bwanje. Nzohisha mu nyonga zanje iki gisagara kubera ibibi vyose bakoze.
Ariko, nzohazana amagara meza n’ugukiza; nzokiza abantu banje kandi nzobaha kunezererwa amahoro y’umusesekara n’umutekano mwinshi.
Nzogarukana Abayuda n’Abisirayeli ndabakuye mu kinyago maze nzobubaka ndabahindure nk’uko bahoze ubwa mbere.
Nzobeza icaha cabo bancumuyeko ndabababarire ivyaha vyabo vyose vy’ubugarariji bakoze.

Maze iki gisagara kizosubira kumbera izina ry’umunezero, ubwiza n’icubahiro imbere y’amahanga yose yo kw’isi azokwumva ivyiza vyose nzohagirira; kandi bazotangara bahinde agashitsi bumvise amahirwe, n’amahoro nzobaha.”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Muravuga kuri aha hantu muti: ‘Ni ahantu h’umusaka, hatagira abantu canke ibikoko.’ Ariko mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu mabarabara y’i Yerusalemu agaragara, atagiramwo abantu canke ibikoko bihaba, hazosubira kwumvikana

amajwi y’umunezero n’agahimbare, amajwi y’umukwe n’umugeni, n’amajwi y’abazana ibimazi vy’ishimwe mu nzu y’Uhoraho, bavuga bati: ‘Nimushimire Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, kuko Uhoraho ari mwiza; urukundo rwiwe rwamaho ibihe vyose.’ Kuko nzosubira kwubaka igihugu nk’uko cari kimeze ubwa mbere, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Muri iki kibanza, kigaragara kitarimwo abantu canke ibikoko, mu bisagara vyaho vyose hazoba uburagiro bw’abungere aho bazovyagiza imikuku yabo.

Mu bisagara vyo mu ntara y’imisozi, mu kiyaya co mu burengero n’i Negebu, mu ntara ya Benyamini, mu mihana bikikije i Yerusalemu no mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda, imikuku izosubira guca musi y’ukuboko k’uwuziharura,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Imisi iraje,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “aho nzoshitsa rya sezerano ryiza nagiranye n’ab’inzu ya Isirayeli n’ab’inzu ya Yuda.
Muri iyo misi no muri ico gihe nzomeza Ishami rigororotse mu ruvyaro rwa Dawidi; azokora ibigororotse n’ivy’ukuri mu gihugu.
Muri iyo misi Yuda azokizwa kandi Yerusalemu hazoba impore. Iri ni ryo zina azokwitwa: ‘Uhoraho ni Ukugororoka Kwacu.’
Kuko uku ari ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Dawidi ntazokwigera abura uwo kwicara ku ntebe yiwe y’ubwami muri Isirayeli,
canke ngo abaherezi, ari bo Balewi, babure uwo guhagarara imbere yanje ubudasiba ngo atange ibimazi biturirwa, atange n’ifu iturirwa yongere anshikanire ibimazi.’ ”
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryongera gutumwa kuri Yeremiya riti:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Nimba mwoshobora gukuraho isezerano ryanje nasezeranye n’umurango hamwe n’iryo nasezeranye n’ijoro, bigatuma bidaseruka mu bihe vyavyo vyashingiwe;

aho rero n’isezerano ryanje nagiranye n’umusavyi wanje Dawidi, hamwe n’iryo nasezeranye n’Abalewi ari bo baherezi bakorera imbere yanje, ryoheza rigashobora gukurwaho, kandi Dawidi ntazosubira kuronka uwo mu ruvyaro rwiwe wo kumusubirira ku ngoma.
Nzogwiza abo mu ruvyaro rwa Dawidi umusavyi wanje n’Abalewi bakorera imbere yanje babe nk’inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru canke nk’umusenyi wo kw’isesero ry’ikiyaga udashobora guharurwa.’ ”
Ijambo ry’Uhoraho ryongera gutumwa kuri Yeremiya riti:
“Ntiwamenye ko aba bantu bariko bavuga bati: ‘Uhoraho yarahevye Abisirayeli n’Abayuda, imiryango ibiri yari yaratoranije’? Nuko rero baranka abantu banje kandi ntibakibabona nk’ihanga.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Nimba ntagiraniye isezerano n’umurango n’ijoro kandi ntashizeho amategeko y’intahava agenga ijuru n’isi,

nuko rero nzoshobora guheba uruvyaro rwa Yakobo na Dawidi umusavyi wanje kandi sinzotoranya abahungu biwe ngo baganze abakomoka kuri Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo. Kuko nzosubira kububaka ndabagirire akagongwe.’ ”

Mu gihe Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni n’ingabo ziwe zose n’ubwami butandukanye bwo mu bwami bunini yaganza bariko baragwanya Yerusalemu n’ibisagara bihakikije, iri jambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho, riti:

“Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: ‘Genda kuri Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda maze umubwire uti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ndi hafi gutanga iki gisagara mu maboko y’umwami w’i Babiloni, na we azogitongoza umuriro.
Ntuzokira ariko uzofatwa mpiri utangwe mu maboko yiwe. Uzokwibonera uwo mwami n’amaso yawe, kandi azovugana nawe imbonankubone, kandi uzoja i Babiloni.
Ariko kandi niwumve isezerano ry’Uhoraho, yewe Zedekiya mwami w’i Buyuda. Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ku bikwerekeye: Ntuzokwicishwa inkota,

uzokwipfira mu mahoro. Nk’uko abantu bacana umuriro wo guhesha icubahiro ba sogokuruza bawe mu kubagandarira, abami bakwitangiye imbere, ni ko na wewe bazogucanira uwo muriro bongere bagucurire intimba bati: Yo, mwami! Ni jewe ubwanje nsezeranye iri sezerano, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.’ ”
Maze Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana abwira ivyo vyose Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda, abimubwirira i Yerusalemu,

mu gihe ingabo z’umwami w’i Babiloni zariko ziragwanya Yerusalemu n’ibindi bisagara vy’i Buyuda vyari bizitijwe inzitiro, Lakishi na Azeka. Ivyo ni vyo bisagara vyonyene vyari bizitijwe inzitiro vyari bisigaye i Buyuda.
Ijambo ryongera gutumwa kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’Uhoraho inyuma y’aho umwami Zedekiya yari yagiranye isezerano n’abantu bose b’i Yerusalemu ngo bahe umwidegemvyo abaja.
Umuntu wese yasabwe kurekura umuja wiwe w’Umuheburayo, yaba umugabo canke umugore; nta n’umwe yari yemerewe kugumiza mu buja mugenziwe w’Umuyuda.
Nuko abaganwa bose n’abantu bose binjiye muri iryo sezerano bemera kurekura abagurano babo b’abahungu canke b’abakobwa ngo ntibashishikare kubagumiza mu buja. Baravyemera, maze barabarekura.
Ariko inyuma y’aho barisubirako bagarukana abo bari barekuye babasubiza mu buja.
Maze ijambo ry’Uhoraho ritumwa kuri Yeremiya riti:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: ‘Nasezeranye isezerano na ba sogokuruza banyu igihe nabavana muri Egiputa, mu gihugu c’ubuja. Ndavuga nti:

Uko imyaka indwi iheze muze mureke bagenzi banyu b’Abaheburayo babigurishijeko ngo babe abaja banyu bidegemvye. Bamaze kubakorera imyaka itandatu, muze mubareke bidegemvye. Ariko ba sogokuruza banyu ntibanyumviye canke ngo bantege ugutwi.
Haciye igihe gitoya mwihanye mukora ivy’ukuri kandi bigororotse: umwe wese yaramenyesheje ko arekuye mugenziwe. Kandi mwaranashizeho isezerano imbere yanje muri mu Ngoro yitirirwa izina ryanje.
Ariko raba mwagarukanye abagurano banyu b’abahungu n’abakobwa mwari mwarekuye ngo baje aho bagomba. Mwabategetse ngo basubire kubabera abaja.’ ”

Nuko rero uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Ntimwanyumviye; ntimwatangaje umwidegemvyo kuri bagenzi banyu b’Abaheburayo. Ko bimeze gutyo, nanje ndamamaje umwidegemvyo kuri mwebwe, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, umwidegemvyo wo kwicwa n’inkota, ikiza n’ikigoyi. Nzobahindura akabarore ku bami bose bo kw’isi.
Abantu bose barenze kw’isezerano ryanje ntibitondere ivyanditswe muri ryo kandi barigiriye imbere yanje, nzobagenza nka ya mpfizi bacamwo kubiri bagaca hagati y’ibihimba vyayo.
Abatware b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu, abajejwe guca imanza, abaherezi n’abantu bose bo mu gihugu baciye hagati y’ivyo bihimba bibiri vy’iyo mpfizi,
nzobatanga mu maboko y’abansi babo barondera kubica. Imivyimba yabo izoba indya z’ibisiga vyo mu kirere n’ibikoko vyo mw’ishamba.
Nzotanga Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda n’abaganwa biwe mu maboko y’abansi babo bagomba kubica, mu maboko y’umwami w’i Babiloni, naho yaretse kubatera.

Ngiye gutegeka, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, maze ndabagarukane muri iki gisagara. Bazokigwanya, bagifate, bagitongoze umuriro. Kandi nzosiga ibisagara vy’i Buyuda ari imisaka ku buryo ata n’umwe azoshobora kubibamwo.”
Iri ni ryo jambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’ Uhoraho ku ngoma ya Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda, rivuga riti:
“Genda ku muryango wa Rekabu ubatumire ngo baze mu cumba kimwe co mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ubahe umuvinyu banywe.”
Nuko ngenda kurondera Yazaniya mwene Yeremiya, mwene Habaziniya, n’abavukanyi biwe n’abahungu biwe, umuryango wose w’Abarekabu.
Ndabazana mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , mu cumba ca bene Hanani mwene Igidaliya umuntu w’Imana. Cari i ruhande y’icumba c’abatware, cakurikirana n’ica Mayaseya mwene Shalumu umurinzi w’irembo.
Maze nzana imibindi yuzuye umuvinyu n’ibikombe imbere y’Abarekabu nca ndababwira nti: “Nimunywe uwu muvinyu.”
Ariko barishura bati: “Ntitunywa umuvinyu, kuko sogokuruza wacu Yonadabu mwene Rekabu yadutegetse ati: ‘Yaba mwebwe canke uruvyaro rwanyu ntimuze munywe umuvinyu.

Kandi vyongeye ntimuze mwigere mwubaka inzu, ngo mubibe imbuto canke ngo mutere inzabibu; ntimuze mukore na kimwe muri ivyo, ariko muze mugume mwibera mu mahema. Ni ho muzorambira mu gihugu murimwo nk’ingenzi.’
Twumviye ikintu cose Sogokuruza Yonadabu mwene Rekabu yadutegetse. Baba twebwe, baba abagore bacu, abahungu bacu canke abakobwa bacu, ntitwigeze tunywa umuvinyu
canke ngo twubake amazu yo kubamwo canke ngo dutere imizabibu, tugire imirima canke ivyimburwa.
Twabaye mu mahema kandi twumviye ivyo sogokuruza wacu Yonadabu yadutegetse.
Ariko igihe Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni yatera iki gihugu, twaravuze tuti: ‘Nimuze, tugende i Yerusalemu kugira ngo dukire ingabo z’Abanyababiloni n’Abanyaramu.’ Nuko twagumye i Yerusalemu.”
Maze ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rica ritumwa kuri Yeremiya, riti:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: Genda ubwire abantu b’i Buyuda n’ab’i Yerusalemu uti: ‘Ntimuriga icigwa ngo mwumvire amajambo yanje?’ Ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

‘Yonadabu mwene Rekabu yategetse abahungu biwe ngo ntibanywe umuvinyu kandi ico cagezwe baracitondeye. Gushika uwu musi ntibanywa umuvinyu, kuko bubahirije icagezwe ca sekuruza wabo. Jewe navuganye namwe kenshi, ariko ntimwanyumviye.

Ni kenshi natumye abasavyi banje navugisha kuri mwebwe. Bakavuga bati: Umwe wese nave mu nzira ziwe mbi ahindure ibikorwa vyiwe; ntimukurikire izindi mana ngo muzisabe. Ni ho muzoba mu gihugu nabahaye mwebwe na ba sogokuruza banyu. Ariko ntimwanteze ugutwi canke ngo munyumvire.
Uruvyaro rwa Yehonadabu mwene Rekabu bagumye bitondera icagezwe yabahaye, ariko aba bantu ntibanyumviye.’

Ni co gituma, Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze ati: ‘Nimwumve! Ngiye kuzana ku Bayuda no ku baba i Yerusalemu ivyago vyose nabagereye ko nzobateza. Navuganye na bo, ariko ntibumva; narabahamagaye, ariko ntibitaba.’ ”

Maze Yeremiya abwira umuryango w’Abarekabu ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli, avuze: ‘Mwitondeye icagezwe ca sogokuruza wanyu Yonadabu, mwumvira ivyo yategetse vyose kandi mukora ivyo yababwiye vyose.’
Nuko rero, uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli, avuze: ‘Yonadabu mwene Rekabu ntazokwigera abura umuntu wo kunkorera.’ ”
Mu mwaka ugira kane Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, iri ni ryo jambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’ Uhoraho riti:
“Fata igitabu wandike muri co amajambo yose nakubwiye yerekeye Isirayeli, Yuda n’ayandi mahanga yose uhereye igihe natanguriye kuvugana nawe ku ngoma ya Yosiya kugeza n’ubu.
Kumbure abantu b’i Buyuda nibumva ivyago vyose nateguye kubahanisha, umwe wese azohindukira ave mu nzira yiwe mbi; maze nanje nzobababarira ibibi vyabo n’icaha cabo.”
Nuko Yeremiya ahamagara Baruki mwene Neriya, maze Yeremiya amubwira amajambo yose Uhoraho yamubwiye, Baruki na we ayandika mu gitabu.
Maze Yeremiya abwira Baruki, ati: “Ndapfunzwe; sinshobora kuja ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Nuko rero uze uduge uje mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ku musi wo kwisonzesha uheze usomere abantu ivyo muri iki gitabu, amajambo yose y’ Uhoraho wanditse nk’uko nakubwiye. Uze uyasomere abantu bose b’i Buyuda bazoza bavuye mu bisagara vyabo vyose.
Kumbure bazokwinginga Uhoraho , maze umwe wese ave mu nzira ziwe mbi, kuko ishavu n’uburake Uhoraho yavuze ko bizoza kuri ubu bwoko bihambaye cane.”
Baruki mwene Neriya akora vyose nk’uko Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana yabimubwiye; aja mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ahasomera amajambo y’ Uhoraho yari muri ca gitabu.

Mu kwezi kw’icenda kw’umwaka wa gatanu Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, hashingwa igihe co kwisonzesha imbere y’ Uhoraho ku bantu bose b’i Yerusalemu no ku bari baje bavuye mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda.

Uhereye ku cumba ca Gemariya mwene Shafani umunyamabanga, cari mu rugo rwo haruguru ku muryango w’Irembo Rishasha ry’urusengero, Baruki asomera abantu bari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho amajambo ya Yeremiya yari muri ca gitabu.
Igihe Mikaya mwene Gemariya, mwene Shafani, yumva ayo majambo y’ Uhoraho yari muri ico gitabu,

amanuka mu cumba c’umunyamabanga mu kirimba c’umwami, aho abatware bose bari bicaye: Elishama umukarani, Delaya mwene Shemaya, Elunatani mwene Akubori, Gemariya mwene Shafani, Zedekiya mwene Hananiya, n’abandi batware bose.
Mikaya amaze kubabwira ivyo yumvise vyose Baruki ariko arasomera abantu biri mu gitabu,

abo batware bose batuma Yehudi mwene Netaniya, mwene Shelemiya, mwene Kushi, ngo abwire Baruki ati: “Zana ico gitabu wasomeye abantu kandi na wewe uze.” Nuko Baruki mwene Neriya aja iyo bari afise ca gitabu mu minwe.
Baramubwira bati: “Niwicare, turabigusavye, maze ukidusomere.” Nuko Baruki arakibasomera.
Bumvise ayo majambo yose, barabana mu maso bafise ubwoba maze babwira Baruki bati: “Dutegerezwa kumenyesha umwami aya majambo yose.”
Nuko babaza Baruki bati: “Tubwire, ibi vyose wavyanditse gute? Mbega Yeremiya ni we yabikubwiye?”
Baruki arabishura ati: “Egome, yambwiye aya majambo yose, nanje ndayandikisha irangi muri iki gitabu.”
Maze ba baganwa babwira Baruki bati: “Wewe na Yeremiya, nimugende mwinyegeze. Ntihagire uwumenya aho mwinyegeje.”
Bamaze gushira ico gitabu mu cumba ca Elishama umunyamabanga, baja aho umwami yari ari mu rugo bamubwira vyose.
Umwami atuma Yehudi kuzana ico gitabu, maze Yehudi arakizana agikuye mu cumba ca Elishama umunyamabanga maze agisomera umwami n’abatware bose bari bahagaze i ruhande yiwe.
Hari mu kwezi kw’icenda kandi umwami yari yicaye mu nzu yo kwikingira imbeho, umuriro uriko uraka mu cotero imbere yiwe.
Uko Yehudi yaba amaze gusoma uduce dutatu canke tune two mu gitabu, ni ko umwami yaja araducagagura akoresheje imbugita y’umwanditsi aduterera mu cotero, kugeza ca gitabu cose gihiye kigaherengetera.
Umwami n’abagendanyi biwe bose bumvise ayo majambo ntibagira ubwoba, canke ngo bitaburireko impuzu.
Naho Elunatani, Delaya na Gemariya binginze umwami ngo ntaturire ico gitabu, ntiyabumviye.

Ahubwo umwami yategetse Yerameyeli, umuhungu w’umwami, Seraya mwene Aziriyeli na Shelemiya mwene Abudeyeli ngo bafate Baruki umwanditsi na Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana. Ariko Uhoraho yari yabanyegeje.
Umwami amaze guturira ico gitabu carimwo amajambo Baruki yari yanditse nk’uko Yeremiya yabimubwiye, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ritumwa kuri Yeremiya riti:
“Fata ikindi gitabu wandike ya majambo yari muri ca gitabu ca mbere, ico umwami Yehoyakimu w’i Buyuda yaturiye.

Kandi ubwire Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda uti: ‘ Uhoraho avuze ati: Waturiye igitabu maze urabaza uti: ni kuki wanditse muri co ko umwami w’i Babiloni ategerezwa kuza no gusambura iki gihugu akureho abantu n’ibikoko vyo muri co?

Nuko rero, uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ku vyerekeye Yehoyakimu umwami w’i Buyuda ngo: ntazoronka n’umwe wo kwicara ku ntebe y’ubwami ya Dawidi; umuvyimba wiwe uzotererwa hanze uhure n’ubushuhe bw’izuba ku murango hamwe n’imbeho yo mw’ijoro.
Nzomuhana we n’abana biwe n’abamukomokako kubera ibibi bakoze; nzoshitsa kuri bo no ku baba i Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda ivyago vyose navuze ko nzobateza, kuko batumviye.’ ”

Nuko Yeremiya afata ikindi gitabu agiha umwanditsi Baruki mwene Neriya, maze yandika muri co amajambo yose yari muri ca gitabu umwami Yehoyakimu w’i Buyuda yaturira, uko Yeremiya yayamubwira. Kandi amajambo menshi asa nk’ayo arongerwamwo.
Zedekiya mwene Yosiya yimitswe na Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni ngo abe umwami w’i Buyuda; atwara mu kibanza ca Yehoyakini mwene Yehoyakimu.
Yaba we, yaba abamukorera canke abantu bo mu gihugu, nta n’umwe yumviye amajambo y’Uhoraho ayo yacishije mu kanwa k’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya.
Ariko umwami Zedekiya arungika Yehukali mwene Shelemiya hamwe na Zefaniya mwene Mayaseya kuri Yeremiya umuvugishwa ngo bamubwire bati: “Ndakwinginze udusengere k’ Uhoraho Imana yacu.”
Muri ico gihe Yeremiya yarashobora kuja aho abandi bari no gutaha, kuko atari bwashirwe mw’ibohero.
Ingabo za Farawo zari zasohotse ziva muri Egiputa, maze Abanyababiloni bari bugarije Yerusalemu bavyumvise, baca bava i Yerusalemu.
Nuko ijambo ry’Uhoraho ritumwa kuri Yeremiya umuvugishwa riti:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: ‘Bwira umwami w’i Buyuda, yakurungitse ngo unsiguze uti: Ingabo za Farawo, zaje ngo zigutabare, zizokwisubirira inyuma, muri Egiputa.
Maze Abanyababiloni bazogaruka batere iki gisagara; bazogifata mpiri bagitongoze umuriro.’ ”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ati: “Ntimwihende, ngo mwibaze muti: Turazi ko Abanyababiloni bazotureka. Ntibazobareka!
Naho mwonesha ingabo zose z’Abanyababiloni ziriko zirabatera maze hagasigara abakomeretse gusa bari mu mahema yabo, bosohoka bagatongoza iki gisagara umuriro.”
Ingabo z’Abanyababiloni zimaze kuva i Yerusalemu kubera ingabo za Farawo,
Yeremiya atangura kuva mu gisagara ngo aje mu ntara ya Benyamini ngo aronke umugabane wiwe w’itongo mu bantu baho.
Ariko ashitse kw’Irembo rya Benyamini, Umukuru w’Abarinzi, yitwa Iriya mwene Shelemiya, mwene Hananiya, aramufata aca avuga ati: “Uriko urahunga Abanyababiloni!”
Yeremiya amwishura ati: “Ivyo si ukuri! Simpunze Abanyababiloni.” Ariko, Iriya ntiyamwumviriza; ahubwo, afata Yeremiya amujana ku batware.
Bari bashavujwe na Yeremiya bituma bamukubita baca bamushira mw’ibohero mu nzu ya Yonatani umunyamabanga, iyo bari bahinduye ibohero.
Yeremiya ashirwa mu kumba gatoya k’ibohero, aho yamaze igihe kirekire.

Hanyuma, umwami Zedekiya aramutumako, baramumuzanira ku kirimba, maze aramubaza biherereye ati: “Mbega hari ijambo na rimwe rivuye k’Uhoraho ufise?” Yeremiya aramwishura ati: “Egome, uzotangwa mu maboko y’umwami w’i Babiloni.”
Nuko Yeremiya abwira umwami Zedekiya ati: “Ni ikihe kibi nagukoreye wewe canke abatware bawe canke ubu bwoko, cotuma unshira mw’ibohero?
Abavugishwa bawe bari hehe, bamwe bakuvugishwako ngo: ‘Umwami w’i Babiloni ntazogutera canke ngo ntazotera iki gihugu’?
Ariko ubu, mwami wanje, ndakwinginze unyumvirize. Ndakwinginze ntunsubize muri irya nzu ya Yonatani umunyamabanga, kuko nopfirayo.”

Umwami Zedekiya ategeka ko bashira Yeremiya mu rugo rw’abarinzi bakamuha umukate uvuye kw’ibarabara ry’abakora imikate uko bukeye gushika aho imikate muri ico gisagara itazoba ikiboneka. Nuko Yeremiya aguma mu rugo rw’abarinzi.
Shefatiya mwene Matani, Gedaliya mwene Pashuri, Yehukali mwene Shelemiya, na Pashuri mwene Malikiya bumva ivyo Yeremiya yariko arabwira abantu bose igihe yavuga ati:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Uwuzoguma muri iki gisagara wese azokwicwa n’inkota, ikigoyi canke ikiza, ariko abantu bose bazokwishikana ku Banyababiloni bazobaho. Bazokiza ubuzima bwabo, bazobaho.’
Kandi uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Iki gisagara nta kabuza kigiye gutangwa mu maboko y’ingabo z’umwami w’i Babiloni, na we azogifata.’ ”

Maze abatware baca babwira umwami bati: “Uwu mugabo akwiye kwicwa. Ariko araca intege ingabo zisigaye mu gisagara, hamwe n’abantu, kubera ibintu ariko arababwira. Uyu mugabo ntariko ararondera ineza y’aba bantu atari ukubamara.”
Umwami Zedekiya abishura ati: “Ari mu maboko yanyu, umwami nta co yokora kinyuranye n’ico mugomba.”

Nuko bafata Yeremiya bamushira mu kinogo ca Malikiya umuhungu w’umwami, cari mu rugo rw’abarinzi. Bamanura Yeremiya n’ibiziriko muri ico kinogo; nta mazi yarimwo, atari ivyondo gusa, maze Yeremiya anyikira muri ivyo vyondo.
Ariko Ebedi-Meleki, Umunyakushi, umutware yakora ku kirimba i bwami, yumva ko bataye Yeremiya muri ico kinogo. Umwami acicaye mw’Irembo rya Benyamini,
Ebedi-Meleki asohoka ava mu kirimba aramubwira ati:

“Nyakwubahwa mwami wanje, aba bantu bakoze nabi ku vyo bakoreye Yeremiya uwuvugishwa n’Imana. Bamutereye mu kinogo c’amazi, aho azokwicwa n’inzara gushika apfuye mu gihe ata vyokurya bizoba bikiri mu gisagara.”
Nuko umwami ategeka Ebedi-Meleki Umunyakushi ati: “Fata abantu mirongo itatu ubakuye ngaha mujane mukure Yeremiya uwuvugishwa muri kirya kinogo atarapfa.”
Nuko Ebedi-Meleki afata abantu bajana na we baja mu cumba cari musi y’ububiko ku kirimba. Akurayo ibihuzu vy’imishire abimanuza imigozi aho Yeremiya yari muri ca kinogo.
Ebedi-Meleki Umunyakushi abwira Yeremiya ati: “Shira ibi bihuzu vy’imishire mu kwaha kwawe ubipfundikeko ibi biziriko.” Yeremiya agira atyo,
maze baca bakwega vya biziriko bamukura muri ca kinogo. Nuko Yeremiya aguma mu rugo rw’abarinzi.
Nuko umwami Zedekiya atumako uwavugishwa Yeremiya bamumuzanira ku muryango ugira gatatu w’Ingoro y’Uhoraho. Umwami abwira Yeremiya ati: “Ngomba nkubaze ikintu, kandi ntugire ico umpisha.”
Yeremiya abwira Zedekiya ati: “Ninakwishura, ntuca unyica? Kandi naho noguha impanuro, ntiwonyumvira.”
Ariko umwami Zedekiya arahira Yeremiya mu mpisho ati: “Ni ukuri nk’uko Uhoraho ari muzima, ari we yaduhaye guhumeka, sinzokwica canke ngo ndagutange ku bagomba kukwica.”

Nuko Yeremiya abwira Zedekiya ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: ‘Niwishikana ku bakuru b’ingabo z’umwami w’i Babiloni, ubuzima bwawe buzorokoka kandi iki gisagara ntikizotongozwa umuriro; wewe n’umuryango wawe muzobaho.
Ariko nutishikana ku bakuru b’ingabo z’umwami w’i Babiloni, iki gisagara kizotangwa mu maboko y’Abanyababiloni kandi bazogitongoza umuriro; kandi nawe ubwawe ntuzocika ariko uzogwa mu maboko yabo.’ ”
Umwami Zedekiya abwira Yeremiya ati: “Ndatinya Abayuda bamaze kwishikana ku Banyababiloni, kuko abo Banyababiloni bohava bandekurira mu maboko yabo na bo bakangirira nabi.”
Yeremiya amwishura ati: “Ntibazogutanga. Niwumvire Uhoraho ku vyo ndakubwiye, ni ho ivyawe bizogenda neza, ugakiza ubuzima bwawe.
Ariko niwanka kwishikana, ibi ni vyo Uhoraho yampishuriye:

Abagore bose basigaye mu kirimba c’umwami w’i Buyuda bazosohorwa bahabwe abatware b’umwami w’i Babiloni. Maze abo bagore bazokubwira bati: ‘Baraguhenze kandi barakunesheje, abari abagenzi bawe bizigiwe. Ibirenge vyawe biranyitse mu vyondo; abagenzi bawe bose bagutaye.’
Abagore bawe bose n’abana bawe bazosohorwa bahabwe Abanyababiloni. Nawe ubwawe ntuzokira amaboko yabo ariko uzofatwa n’umwami w’i Babiloni; kandi iki gisagara kizotongorwa n’umuriro.”
Nuko Zedekiya abwira Yeremiya ati: “Ntubwire umuntu n’umwe ivyo tuvuganye, kuko ubikoze wopfa.
Abatware nibumva ko navuganye nawe, maze bakaza kukubaza bati: ‘Tubwire ivyo wabwiye umwami n’ivyo umwami yakubwiye; kandi ntuduhishe canke na ho tukwice,’
uze ubabwire uti: ‘Nariko ndinginga umwami ngo ntansubize mu nzu kwa Yonatani gupfirayo.’ ”

Abaganwa bose baca baja kuraba Yeremiya baramubazagiza, na we ababwira ivyo umwami yari yamutegetse vyose kuvuga. Nuko ntibasubira kugira ico bamubaza, kuko ata n’umwe yari yumvise ivyo bavuganye n’umwami.
Maze Yeremiya aguma mu rugo rw’abarinzi gushika ku musi Yerusalemu hafatiweko. Uku ni ko i Yerusalemu hafashwe:

headings.text: Yeremiya atererwa mu kinogo kibika amazi

verses.text: Mu mwaka ugira icenda Zedekiya ari umwami w’i Buyuda, mu kwezi kw’icumi, Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni ni ho yaja gutera Yerusalemu ajanye n’ingabo ziwe zose, barahakikuza.
Maze ku musi ugira icenda w’ukwezi kwa kane kw’umwaka ugira cumi na rimwe Zedekiya akiri ku ngoma, basatura uruzitiro rw’igisagara.

Abakuru b’ingabo z’umwami w’i Babiloni bose baraza bicara kw’Irembo ryo Hagati. Abo bari Nerugali-Sharezeri w’i Samugari-Nebo, Sarusekimu umukuru w’ingabo, Nerugali-Sharezeri umuhanuzi mukuru n’abandi batware bose b’umwami w’i Babiloni.

Maze Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda hamwe n’ingabo zose bababonye barahunga, bava mu gisagara mw’ijoro bajanye inzira ica mu murima w’umwami, baca mw’irembo riri hagati y’ibihome bibiri, bahunga berekeye ikiyaya ca Araba.

Ariko ingabo z’Abanyababiloni zikurikira umwami Zedekiya bamufatira mu kiyaya c’i Yeriko. Baramucakira, bamushira Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni aho yari ari i Ribula mu ntara y’i Hamati, na we amucira urubanza aho nyene.
Umwami w’i Babiloni yicira abahungu ba Zedekiya imbere yiwe aho nyene i Ribula, yica n’abatware bose b’i Buyuda.
Maze anogora amaso Zedekiya, amubohesha iminyororo y’umwakaka kugira ngo amujane i Babiloni.
Abanyababiloni baturira ikirimba c’umwami n’amazu y’abantu, basenyurira hasi inzitiro z’i Yerusalemu.
Nebuzaradani umukuru w’abarinzi b’umwami ajana mu kinyago i Babiloni abantu bari basigaye mu gisagara, hamwe n’abari bagiye kwishikana kuri we, n’abandi bose bari basigaye.
Ariko uwo Nebuzaradani umukuru w’ingabo zirinda umwami asigaza inyuma mu gihugu c’i Buyuda bamwe mu bantu b’abakene, ata co bari batunze; maze aca abaha imizabibu n’imirima.
Muri ico gihe umwami Nebukadineza w’i Babiloni yari yatanze itegeko ryerekeye Yeremiya abicishije kuri Nebuzaradani umukuru w’ingabo zirinda umwami ati:
“Mumufate mumurinde; ntimumugirire nabi ariko mumukorere ico azobasaba cose.”
Nuko Nebuzaradani umukuru w’ingabo zirinda umwami, Nebushazibani umukuru w’ingabo, Nerugali-Sharezeri umutware mukuru n’abandi batware bose b’umwami w’i Babiloni
barungika Yeremiya bamukura mu rugo rw’abarinzi, bamushikiriza Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu mwene Shafani, ngo amusubize iwe. Nuko yigumira mu b’iwabo.
Igihe Yeremiya yari acugaraniwe mu rugo rw’abarinzi, ijambo ry’Uhoraho ritumwa kuri we riti:

“Genda ubwire Ebedi-Meleki Umunyakushi uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana y’Abisirayeli, avuze: Ngira nshitse ivyo navuze kuri iki gisagara biciye mu vyago, atari mu mahirwe. Muri ico gihe bizoshitswa uvyibonera.
Ariko nzokurokora kuri uwo musi, ni ko Uhoraho avuze; ntuzogwa mu maboko y’abo utinya.
Nzogukiza; ntuzokwicwa n’inkota ahubwo uzorokora ubugingo bwawe, kuko unyizigiye,’ ” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Ijambo ritumwa kuri Yeremiya rivuye k’ Uhoraho , inyuma y’uko Nebuzaradani umukuru w’abarinzi b’umwami yari amubohoye akamurungika i Rama. Yari yasanze Yeremiya aboheshejwe iminyororo ari hagati y’abandi bagizwe imbohe bategerezwa kujanwa i Babiloni bavuye i Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda.
Wa mukuru w’abarinzi abonye Yeremiya, aramubwira ati: “Ni Uhoraho Imana yawe yashinze ko haba iki cago kikabera aha hantu.
Kandi raba ubu Uhoraho aragishikije; yabikoze nk’uko yari yabivuze. Ibi vyose vyabaye kubera ko mwacumuye k’ Uhoraho ntimwamwumvira.

Ariko uwu musi ndakubohoye iminyororo iri ku maboko yawe. Nuze tujane i Babiloni, niwaba ubishaka, nanje nzokurinda; ariko nimba utabishaka, ntuze. Ehe raba, igihugu cose kiri imbere yawe; genda aho ugomba hose.”

Ariko Yeremiya atarahindukira ngo agende, Nebuzaradani yongerako ati: “Subira kwa Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu mwene Shafani, uwo umwami w’i Babiloni yashinze ibisagara vy’i Buyuda, maze ubane na we mu bandi, canke wigire ahandi ugomba.” Nuko uwo mukuru amuha ivyo akeneye n’ingabire aca aramureka aragenda.
Nuko, Yeremiya agenda kwa Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu i Misipa agumana na we mu bantu bari basigaye inyuma mu gihugu.

Maze intwazangabo zose n’abantu babo bari bakiri mu gihugu hagati bumvise ko umwami w’i Babiloni yagenye Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu ngo abe umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda kandi ko yamushinze abagabo, abagore n’abana bakenye kurusha abandi bose bo mu gihugu batajanywe nk’inyagano i Babiloni;

baca baja kubonana na Gedaliya i Misipa. Abo na bo ni Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya, Yohanani na Yonatani bene Kareya, Seraya mwene Tanihumeti, bene Efayi Umunetofati, na Yazaniya umuhungu w’Umumayaka, n’abantu babo.

Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu mwene Shafani, arabarahira kugira ngo abahumurizanye n’abantu babo. Arababwira ati: “Ntimutinye Abanyababiloni. Nimugende mube amahoro mu gihugu, muyoboke umwami w’i Babiloni, ibindi vyose bizogenda neza.

Nanje ubwanje nzoguma i Misipa ngo ndabaserukire imbere y’Abanyababiloni baza iwacu, ariko mwebwe muze mube abo kwimbura imivinyu, ivyamwa vyo ku mpeshi n’amavuta, mubishire mu mibindi yo kubibika, mwibere mu bisagara mwigaruriye.”

Abayuda bose bahungiye i Mowabu, mu Bamoni, muri Edomu no mu bindi bihugu bumvise ko umwami w’i Babiloni yasigaje amasigarira i Buyuda kandi ko yashinze Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu mwene Shafani, kuba umukuru w’intara ngo abarongore,
bose baragaruka mu gihugu c’i Buyuda, kuri Gedaliya i Misipa, bavuye mu bihugu aho bari barasanzariye. Bimbura imivinyu myinshi cane n’ivyamwa vyo ku mpeshi.
Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abakuru b’ingabo bose bari bagisigaye mu gihugu baza aho Gedaliya ari i Misipa.
Baramubwira bati: “Mbega ntuzi ko Bayalisi umwami w’Abamoni yarungitse Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya ngo akwice?” Ariko Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu ntiyabizera.

Nuko Yohanani mwene Kareya abwira Gedaliya mu mpisho i Misipa ati: “Ndeka ngende nice Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya, kandi nta n’umwe azobimenya. Ni iki cotuma akwica agatuma Abayuda bose bagukikije basanzara n’amasigarira y’i Buyuda agahona?”
Ariko Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu abwira Yohanani mwene Kareya ati: “Ntukore ikintu nk’ico! Ivyo uriko uravuga kuri Ishimayeli si ivy’ukuri.”

Mu kwezi kugira indwi Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya, Netaniya mwene Elishama, wo mu muryango w’abami akaba yari yahoze ari umwe mu batware b’umwami, aza azananye n’abagabo icumi kwa Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu i Misipa. Bakiriko barasangirira hamwe aho nyene,

Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya na ba bagabo cumi bari kumwe na we bava hasi bicisha inkota Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu mwene Shafani, bica uwo umwami w’i Babiloni yari yagenye ngo abe umutware w’intara y’i Buyuda.
Ishimayeli yica n’Abayuda bose bari kumwe na Gedaliya i Misipa, hamwe n’abasoda b’Abanyababiloni bari aho.
Haciye umusi umwe Gedaliya agandaguwe, ata n’umwe arabimenya,

abagabo mirongo umunani bari bimosheje inkomvorera ubwanwa bwabo, bitabaguriyeko impuzu zabo kandi bikebaguye baza bavuye i Shekemu, Shilo n’i Samariya, bazanye amashikanwa y’ifu n’ibimota neza mu Ngoro y’Uhoraho.
Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya arasohoka ava i Misipa aja kubasanganira, agenda arira ingenda. Ahuye na bo, avuga ati: “Nimuze kwa Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu murabe ivyamushikiye.”
Binjiye mu gisagara, Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya n’abagabo bari kumwe na we babicisha inkota baca babaterera mu kinogo kibika amazi.
Ariko icumi muri bo babwira Ishimayeli bati: “Ntutwice! Turafise ingano na sayiri, amavuta n’ubuki, binyegejwe mu murima umwe.” Nuko aca arabareka ntiyabicana n’abandi.

Ico kinogo batayemwo ya mivyimba yose ya ba bagabo yari yiciye hamwe na Gedaliya cari ico umwami Asa yari yarimbishije mu kwikingira kubera umwami Bayasha w’Abisirayeli. Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya acuzuza imivyimba y’abapfuye.

Ishimayeli aca afata abasigaye bose bari i Misipa abagira imbohe, abakobwa b’umwami hamwe n’abandi bose bari basigaye aho, abo Nebuzaradani umukuru w’ingabo zirinda umwami yari yashinze Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu. Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya arabafata aca aragenda ajabuka yerekeye mu Bamoni.
Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abakuru b’ingabo bari kumwe na we bumvise ibibi Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya yakoze,
baca bajana n’ingabo zose bari kumwe kugwanya Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya. Bamufatira i ruhande y’ikidengeri kinini c’i Gibeyoni.
Ba bantu Ishimayeli yari afise babonye Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abakuru b’ingabo bari kumwe na we, baranezerwa.
Abantu bose Ishimayeli yari yafashe i Misipa barahindukira baja ku ruhande rwa Yohanani mwene Kareya.
Ariko Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya n’abantu umunani mu ngabo ziwe batoroka Yohanani baja mu Bamoni.

Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abakuru b’ingabo zari kumwe na we baca batwara abarokotse bose b’i Misipa, abo Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya yari yafashe amaze kwica Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, bari abasoda, abagore, abana n’abakora i bwami yari yakuye i Gibeyoni.
Maze barabandanya, baruhukira i Geruti Kimuhamu i ruhande y’i Betelehemu bariko baraja muri Egiputa
ngo bahunge Abanyababiloni. Barabatinya kubera Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya yari yishe Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, uwo umwami w’i Babiloni yari yashizeho ngo abe umukuru w’intara y’i Buyuda.
Nuko abakuru b’ingabo bose, harimwo na Yohanani mwene Kareya na Yezaniya mwene Hoshaya, n’abantu bose, uhereye ku muto inyuma y’abandi ukageza ku mukuru aruta abandi, begera

Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana bamubwira bati: “Turakwinginze wumve ico tugusaba maze udusengere k’ Uhoraho Imana yawe usabire aba bantu bose b’amasigarira. Kuko nk’uko ubibona ubu, naho twari benshi, ubu hasigaye bake cane.
Senga ngo Uhoraho Imana yawe atubwire aho twoja n’ico twokora.”
Yeremiya arabishura ati: “Nabumvise. Ni ivy’ukuri ndabasengera k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu nk’uko mwabisavye; kandi ndabamenyesha ivyo Uhoraho aza kuvuga vyose. Nta co nza kubahisha.”
Nuko babwira Yeremiya bati: “ Uhoraho atubere icabona c’ukuri kandi co kwizigirwa kandi aduhane nitutakora ivyo Uhoraho Imana yawe aza kugutuma kuri twebwe vyose.
Vyaba ari vyiza canke bibi, tuzokwumvira Uhoraho Imana yawe, iyo tugutumyeko, kugira ngo ivyacu bigende neza, tuzokwumvira Uhoraho Imana yawe.”
Haheze imisi icumi, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ritumwa kuri Yeremiya.
Maze akoranya Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abakuru b’ingabo bose bari kumwe na we n’abantu bose uhereye ku muto inyuma y’abandi ukageza ku mukuru aruta abandi.
Arababwira ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, uwo mwantumyeko ngo ndabasabire, avuze:
‘Nimwaguma muri iki gihugu, nzobubaka sinzobasambura; nzobateragira sinzobarandura, kuko mbabajwe n’icago nabateje.
Ntimutinye umwami w’i Babiloni, uwo mutinya ubu. Ntimumutinye, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, kuko ndi kumwe namwe kandi nzobatabara ndabakize amaboko yiwe.
Nzobagirira akagongwe kugira ngo na we abagirire akagongwe abasubize mu gihugu canyu.’
Ariko, nimwavuga muti: ‘Ntituzoguma muri iki gihugu, maze ntimunyumvire jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu,’
kandi nimwavuga muti: ‘Oya, tuzoja kwibera muri Egiputa, aho tutazobona intambara canke ngo twumve inzamba canke ngo dusonze tubure ico kurya,’
nuko nimwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, yemwe masigarira ya Yuda. Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: ‘Nimwaba mwafashe ingingo yo kuja muri Egiputa mukabayo,
inkota mutinya izobasangayo, n’inzara mutinya izobakurikira muri Egiputa, mupfireyo.
Ni ukuri, abafashe ingingo yo kuja muri Egiputa ngo babeyo bazokwicwa n’inkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza; nta n’umwe azorokoka canke ngo akire icago nzobateza.’ ”

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: “Nk’uko uburake bwanje n’ubushangashirwe bwanje vyasutswe ku baba i Yerusalemu, ni ko uburake bwanje buzosukwa kuri mwebwe nimwaja muri Egiputa. Muzoba akamenyo, agatwengo, abo gucirwa urubanza no kuvugirizwa agahwa; ntimuzosubira kubona aha hantu.”
Yemwe masigarira ya Yuda, Uhoraho arababwiye ati: “Ntimuje muri Egiputa.” Nimumenye ibi mudakekeranya: ndababuriye uwu musi
ko mwakoze ikosa ry’agacamutwe igihe mwantuma k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu mukavuga muti: “Dusengere k’ Uhoraho Imana yawe; utubwire ivyo aza kuvuga vyose kugira ngo natwe tubikore.”
Ndababwiye uwu musi, ariko n’ubu ntimurumvira Uhoraho Imana yanyu mu vyo yantumye kubabwira vyose.
Nuko rero, mumenye ibi mudakekeranya: muzopfa mwishwe n’inkota, ikigoyi n’ikiza muri aho mugomba kuja kuba.
Yeremiya ahejeje kubwira abantu amajambo yose y’ Uhoraho Imana yabo, ivyo Uhoraho yari yamutumye ngo ababwire vyose,
Azariya mwene Hoshaya na Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abantu bose b’ubwibone babwira Yeremiya bati: “Urabesha! Uhoraho Imana yacu ntiyagutumye kuvuga ngo: ‘Ntimuje muri Egiputa kubayo.’
Ariko Baruki mwene Neriya ni we akuduteranyako ngo adutange mu maboko y’Abanyababiloni, kugira ngo batwice canke batujane turi inyagano i Babiloni.”
Nuko Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abakuru b’ingabo bose n’abantu bose bagarariza icagezwe c’Uhoraho co kuguma mu gihugu c’i Buyuda.
Mbere Yohanani mwene Kareya n’abakuru b’ingabo baca barongora amasigarira yose y’i Buyuda yari yagarutse kuba mu gihugu c’i Buyuda bavuye mu mahanga yari yasanzariyemwo barabajana.

Bajana abagabo bose, abagore, n’abana n’abakobwa b’umwami abo Nebuzaradani umukuru w’ingabo zirinda umwami yari yasigaranye Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, mwene Shafani, na Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana na Baruki mwene Neriya.
Nuko binjira muri Egiputa ntibumvira Uhoraho baca baragenda gushika i Tafanihesi.
Bari aho i Tafanihesi ijambo ry’ Uhoraho riza kuri Yeremiya riti:
“Fata amabuye maninimanini uyahambe mw’ibumba, Abayuda bose bariko barakuraba, mu musezero w’amatafari mu rwinjiriro rw’ikirimba ca Farawo i Tafanihesi.

Maze ubabwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: Nzorungika umushumba wanje Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni, kandi nzoshira intebe y’ubwami yiwe kuri aya mabuye nahamvye aha; azosasa umusezero wiwe w’ubwami hejuru yayo.
Azoza atere Egiputa, yice abagerewe gupfa, afate mpiri abagerewe gufatwa mpiri, yicishe inkota abagerewe kwicishwa n’inkota.

Azotongoza umuriro ingoro z’imana zo muri Egiputa; azoturira ingoro zazo atware mu kinyago imana zaho. Nk’uko umwungere yizingirako umutamana wiwe, ni ko na we azokwizingirako Egiputa aheze yigire anesheje.
