Harya mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana c’izuba muri Egiputa azosenyura inkingi zaco atongoze umuriro ingoro z’imana zo muri Egiputa.’ ”
Iri ni ryo jambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya ryerekeye Abayuda bose baba muri Egiputa mu kiyaya, i Migidoli, i Tafanihesi n’i Memfisi, no muri Egiputa hari imisozi, rivuga riti:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: Mwarabonye icago gikomeye nateje i Yerusalemu n’ibisagara vyose vy’i Buyuda. Uwu musi ni imisaka nta bantu babibamwo
kubera ibibi bakoze. Baranshavuje kuko batuririye ibimota neza izindi mana, bagasenga izo mana bo canke ba sekuruza batigeze bamenya.
Narungitse kenshi abasavyi banje navugisha, ngo bababwire bati: Ntimukore ivyo bintu bisesema, ivyo nanka urunuka!
Ariko ntibigeze bavyumva canke ngo bantege ugutwi; ntibavuye mu bibi canke ngo bareke gucanira ibimota neza izindi mana.
Ni co catumye, uburake bwanje bw’inkazi busukwa; buziriringira ibisagara vy’i Buyuda n’amabarabara y’i Yerusalemu bukabisiga ari imisaka nk’uko biri uwu musi.

Ubu rero, uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: Ni kuki mugomba ko abateza icago nk’ico kizozimanganya abagabo n’abagore, abana n’abonka b’i Buyuda, maze ntabasigire amasigarira?

Ni kuki mugomba kumuratsa n’ivyo ibikorwa vy’intoke zanyu vyamye, mu guturirira izindi mana ibimota neza muri Egiputa, aho mwaje kuba? Muzokwiyica ubwanyu muhinduke akabarore n’abo kwankwa urunuka mu mahanga yose yo kw’isi.
Mwibagiye ibibi vyakozwe na ba sogokuruza banyu n’abami n’abamikazi b’i Buyuda no mu mayira y’i Yerusalemu?
Kugeza uwu musi ntibaricisha bugufi canke ngo batinye, canke ngo bitondere ivyagezwe vyanje n’amategeko yanje nashize imbere yanyu na ba sogokuruza banyu.
Nuko rero, uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: Nagabiye guteza icago mwebwe no guherengeteza Abayuda bose.

Nzokuraho amasigarira y’Abayuda bafashe ingingo yo kuja muri Egiputa kubayo. Bose bazopfira muri Egiputa. Bazokwicwa n’inkota canke bicwe na kigoyi. Bazoba ibivume n’agaterasoni, abo gucirwa urubanza no kuvugirizwako agahwa.
Nzohana ababa muri Egiputa ndabahanishije inkota, ikigoyi n’icago, nk’uko nahanye Yerusalemu.

Nta n’umwe wo mu masigarira y’i Buyuda yagiye kuba muri Egiputa azorokoka canke ngo asigare aze agaruke i Buyuda, aho bipfuza cane kugaruka no kuba; nta n’umwe azogaruka kiretse bake mu bacitse kw’icumu.”

Hanyuma abagabo bose bari bazi ko abagore babo bariko baraturirira ibimota neza izindi mana, hamwe n’abagore bari aho, ikoraniro rinini, n’abantu bose baba muri Egiputa mu kiyaya no mu misozi, babwira Yeremiya bati:
“Ntitugomba kwumva ubutumwa watubwiye mw’izina ry’Uhoraho!

Twebwe tuzokora ivyo twavuze ko tuzokora vyose: Tuzoturirira ibimota neza Umugabekazi wo mw’ijuru kandi tuzosuka ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa hasi ku bwiwe nk’uko twebwe na ba sogokuruza, n’abami n’abatware bacu, babikora i Buyuda no mu mayira y’i Yerusalemu. Muri ico gihe twari dufise agahimbo k’ivyokurya kandi twari tumerewe neza ata ngorane dufise.
Ariko kuva igihe twarekeye guturirira ibimota neza Umugabekazi w’Ijuru no kumushikanira amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa, nta kintu twari tugifise kandi twamazwe n’inkota n’ikigoyi.”

Abagore bongerako bati: “Aho twaturirira ibimota neza umugabekazi wo mw’ijuru tukamushikanira ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa, mbega abagabo bacu ntibamenye ko twakora udutsima dusa n’ishusho yiwe tukamushikanira ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa?”
Maze Yeremiya abwira abantu bose, abagabo n’abagore, bariko baramwishura, ati:

“Mbega Uhoraho ntiyibuka kandi akagarukana mu bwenge bwiwe ibimota neza vyatuririwe mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu mabarabara y’i Yerusalemu na mwebwe na ba sogokuruza banyu, abami banyu n’abatware banyu n’abantu bose bari mu gihugu?
Igihe Uhoraho atari agishoboye kwihanganira ibikorwa vyanyu bibi n’ibindi bigayitse mwakoze, igihugu canyu yagihinduye umuvumo n’umusaka, ahatakigira abantu, nk’uko biri uwu musi.

Kubera ko mwatuririye ibimota neza izindi mana, mugacumura k’Uhoraho kandi ntimumwumvire ngo mwitondere ivyagezwe vyiwe canke amabwirizwa yiwe n’ivyo yihanikirije, ni co gituma iki cago caje kuri mwebwe, nk’uko mubibona uwu musi.”
Maze Yeremiya abwira abantu bose, harimwo n’abagore, ati: “Nimwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, yemwe bantu mwese b’i Buyuda muri muri Egiputa.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: ‘Mwebwe n’abagore banyu mwarakoze ivyo mwavuze ko muzokora muranabisezerana muti: Tuzoshitsa indahiro twarahiye yo guturira ibimota neza no gutanga ishikanwa ry’ibinyobwa ku Mugabekazi w’Ijuru.’ Nuko nimushishikare, mukore ivyo mwasezeranye! Nimushitse ivyo mwarahiye!

Ariko nimwumve ijambo ry’Uhoraho, yemwe Bayuda mwese muba muri Egiputa: Ndahiye izina ryanje rihambaye, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ko ata n’umwe yavuye i Buyuda aho ari hose muri Egiputa azokwigera asubira kwambaza izina ryanje canke ngo arirahire ati: ‘Ndahiye Imana nzima.’
Kuko ndabarindiriye ngo ndabagirire nabi, si ukubagirira neza. Abayuda bari muri Egiputa bazohona n’inkota n’ikigoyi gushika aho bazoherengetezwa bose.

Abazokira inkota bagasubira mu gihugu c’i Buyuda bavuye muri Egiputa bazoba bake cane. Maze amasigarira yose y’i Buyuda yaje kuba muri Egiputa azomenya ijambo rizokwubahirizwa; na mba ari iryanje canke ari iryabo.
Iki ni co kimenyetso kuri mwebwe ko nzobahanira muri iki kibanza, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, kugira ngo mumenye ko ivyo nababwiye ko nzobagirira nabi bitazohinduka vy’ukuri.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Ngiye gutanga Farawo Hofura umwami wa Egiputa mu maboko y’abansi biwe barondera kumwica, nk’uko natanze umwami Zedekiya w’i Buyuda mu maboko ya Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni, umwansi wiwe yarondera kumwica.’ ”

Igihe Baruki mwene Neriya yandika mu muzingo amajambo uwavugishwa n’Imana Yeremiya amubwiye, mu mwaka ugira kane umwami Yehoyakimu, mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda, ari ku ngoma, Yeremiya yabwiye Baruki ati:
“Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze kuri wewe Baruki:
Waravuze uti: ‘Ewe jewe ndagowe! Uhoraho anyongerereje imibabaro ku yo nari mfise; ncitse intege ku bwo kuniha kandi nta buruhukiro ngira.’ ”
Ariko, Uhoraho yambariye ngo ndakubwire nti: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Nzosenyura ivyo nubatse kandi nzorandura ivyo nateye, mu gihugu cose.
Mbega none woba ukwiye kwironderera ibihambaye? Ntubirondere. Kuko nzoteza ivyago abantu bose, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ariko aho uzoja hose nzokiza ubugingo bwawe.’ ”
Iri ni ryo jambo Uhoraho yatumye kuri Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana ryerekeye amahanga ngo:

Ku vyerekeye Egiputa: Ubu ni bwo butumwa butumwe ku ngabo za Farawo Neko umwami wa Egiputa, zanesherejwe i Karikemishi ku ruzi Efurate na Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni, mu mwaka ugira kane Yehoyakimu mwene Yosiya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma:
“Tegura inkinzo zanyu, nini na ntoya, maze mugende mu ntambara!
Shira amatandiko ku mafarasi, mutegure imikogote! Fata ibibanza mwambare inkofero! Karisha amacumu, mwambare ibigwanisho!
Mbega mbona iki? Batekewe n’ubwoba, basubije umugongo inyuma, abahizi babo baraneshejwe. Bahunze isabagire bataraba inyuma, kandi hari ibiteye ubwoba impande zose, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Unyaruka cane ntashobora guhunga kandi umunyenkomezi ntashobora gukira urugamba. Mu buraruko bw’uruzi Efurate baratsitaye kandi baratemvye.
Uwo ni nde ava hasi nk’uruzi Nili, nk’inzuzi z’amazi asebuye?
Egiputa hahagurutse nk’uruzi Nili, nk’inzuzi z’amazi asebuye. Haravuga ngo: ‘Nzova hasi maze nkwire isi; nzosangangura ibisagara n’abantu bavyo.’
Nimugende, yemwe mafarasi! Munyaruke, yemwe abagendera ku mikogote! Nimuje imbere yemwe bahizi, bagabo b’i Kushi n’i Puti mwitwaje inkinzo, bagabo b’i Ludiya bitwaje imiheto.

Ariko uwo musi ni uw’Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, umusi wo kwihora, wo kwihora abansi biwe. Inkota izorya gushika ihaze, gushika yimaze inyota y’amaraso. Kuko Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, azotanga ikimazi mu gihugu co mu buraruko i ruhande y’uruzi Efurate.
Duga uje i Gileyadi wironkere umuti wo gusomora, yewe mukobwa wa Egiputa. Ariko ugwiriza imiti ubusa; nta gukira kuri kuri wewe.
Amahanga azokwumva ibimaramare vyawe; n’amaborogo yawe bizokwuzura isi. Umuhizi azotsitara ku wundi muhizi; bose bazogwira hasi rimwe.”
Ubu ni bwo butumwa Uhoraho yabwiye Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana bwerekeye ukuza kwa Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni aje gutera Egiputa:
“Menyesha ibi muri Egiputa, kandi ubivuge i Migidoli; bivuge kandi n’i Memfisi n’i Tafanihesi uti: ‘Fata ibibanza mwitegure, kuko inkota igira itabagure abagukikuje.’
Ni kuki abahizi bawe baryamye? Ntibashobora guhagarara, kuko Uhoraho azobatsinda hasi.
Bazotsitagurika kenshi; bazogwanako bahindikirane. Bazovuga bati: Va hasi dusubire inyuma mu bacu no mu mavukiro yacu, duhunge inkota y’uwuducinyiza.
Aho ni ho bazokwiha akamo bavuga bati: ‘Umwami Farawo wa Egiputa ni akarimi gusa; yahushije akaryo.’
‘Ni ukuri nk’uko Uhoraho ari muzima,’ ni ko Umwami avuze, izina ryiwe ni Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, hari uwuzoza ameze nk’umusozi Tabori iyo uri hagati mu yindi misozi, nka Karumeli i ruhande y’ikiyaga.
Tekera ivyawe witegurire kuja mu kinyago, wewe uba muri Egiputa, kuko Memfisi hazosigara ari amatongo, kandi hazocika umusaka ata muntu ahaba.
Egiputa ni inyana nziza, ariko ikibugu kirayiziye giturutse mu buraruko.
Kandi n’abacangero bari muri bo bameze nk’inyana zinuze. Na bo nyene bazohindukira bahunge bose, ntibazoshobora kurinda, kuko umusi w’ivyago uje kuri bo, ni igihe co guhanwa kwabo.
Egiputa hazovuza agahwa nk’inzoka ihunze aho umwansi azoba ariko arabegereza abakurikiye n’inkomezi nyinshi; bazomutera bafise incabiti, nk’abantu bicira ibiti.
Bazotemera hasi ishamba ryiwe, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, naho ari insobane. Ni benshi bameze nk’inzige, ntiboharurika.
Umukobwa wa Egiputa azoteterwa, ashirwe mu maboko y’abantu bo mu buraruko.”
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze ati: “Ngira nshitse igihano kuri Amoni imana y’i Tebesi, kuri Farawo, kuri Egiputa n’imana zaho n’abami baho, n’abizigiye Farawo.
Nzobatanga mu maboko y’abagomba kubica, ya Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni n’abakuru b’ingabo biwe. Hanyuma ariko, Egiputa hazosubira kubamwo abantu nk’uko vyahoze ubwa mbere,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

“Ntutinye, yewe Yakobo musavyi wanje; ntucike intege, yewe Isirayeli. Kuko vy’ukuri nzogukiza ngukuye mu gihugu ca kure, uruvyaro rwawe ndarukuye mu gihugu bajanywemwo ari inyagano. Yakobo azosubira kugira amahoro n’umutekano, kandi nta wuzomutera ubwoba.

Ntutinye, Yakobo musavyi wanje, kuko ndi kumwe na we,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. “Naho nzosangangura rwose amahanga yose ayo nzogusanzarizamwo, wewe sinzoguherengeteza. Nzoguhana ariko mu kugororoka; sinzokureka ngo ugende udahanywe rwose.”
Iri ni ryo jambo ryatumwe kuri Yeremiya umuvugishwa rivuye k’ Uhoraho ryerekeye Abafilisitiya imbere y’uko Farawo atera i Gaza, ryavuga riti:

Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Ehe ingene amazi asuriranije mu buraruko; azohinduka umugezi utemba amazi menshi. Azosendanisha mu gihugu no ku bintu vyose biri muri co, ibisagara n’ababibamwo. Abantu bazoboroga; ababa mu gihugu bose bazovuza induru
bumvise imirindi y’amafarasi akomeye, bakumva uguhinda kw’imikogote y’umwansi hamwe n’uruyogoyogo rw’amaguru yayo. Abavyeyi ntibazohindukira gutabara abana babo; amaboko yabo azocika nk’imigozi.
Kuko umusi uje wo gutikiza Abafilisitiya no gukuraho abacitse kw’icumu bose boshoboye gutabara Tiro na Sidoni. Uhoraho yiteguye gusangangura Abafilisitiya, amasigarira yo ku kizinga c’i Kafutori.
Gaza hazokwimwesha inkomvorera ku bwo kugandara; Ashikeloni hazozibwa akanwa. Yemwe masigarira yo mu kiyaya, muzogeza ryari kwikebagura?
‘Yo, wa nkota y’Uhoraho we, mbega uzoruhuka ryari? Subira mu rwubati rwawe; sigaho guma hamwe.’
Ariko yotekereza gute? Kandi Uhoraho ari we yayitegetse, yarayihaye itegeko ryo gutera Ashikeloni n’inkengera y’ikiyaga?”
Ku vyerekeye Mowabu: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: I Nebo haragowe, kuko hazosangangurwa. I Kiriyatayimu hazoteterwa hafatwe; umunara waho uzoteterwa usangangurwe.
I Mowabu ntihazosubira guhimbazwa; i Heshiboni ni ho abantu bazogirira inama yo kuhasenyura: Nimuze dukureho rirya hanga. Na wewe nyene, yewe Madimeni, uzozibwa akanwa; inkota izogukurikirana.
Umve amaborogo aturutse i Horonayimu, amaborogo atewe n’icago gihambaye n’agatikizo.
I Mowabu hazovunagurwa; abana baho bazoboroga.
Baduze umusozi baja i Luhiti, bagiye barira cane ingenda; ku nzira imanuka ija i Horonayimu amaborogo y’umubabaro kubera gusamburwa kwaho arumvikana.
Hunga! Nyaga amagara; mumere nk’indogoba y’inyeshamba mu bugaragwa.
Ko mwizigiye ibikorwa vy’amaboko yanyu n’ubutunzi bwanyu, na mwebwe nyene muzofatwa mujanwe muri inyagano, kandi n’imana yanyu Kemoshi izojanwa ari inyagano, hamwe n’abaherezi bayo n’abatware bayo.
Uwutikiza azoza atumbereye ibisagara vyose, kandi nta gisagara na kimwe kizokira. Ibiyaya bizosigara ari amatongo n’intara z’imirambi zizosamburwa, kuko Uhoraho yabivuze.
Shira umunyu kuri Mowabu, kuko hazosigara ari amatongo; ibisagara vyaho bizohinduka imisaka, ata muntu n’umwe wo kubibamwo.
Aravumwe umuntu anebwa mu gikorwa c’Uhoraho! Aravumwe umuntu arinda inkota yiwe ngo ntivishe amaraso!

“I Mowabu hamye hatekanye kuva mu buto, nk’umuvinyu wiretse ku mvuzo zawo, utacuranuwe ngo uve mu mubindi uje mu wundi, ntihigeze hajanwa ari inyagano. Ni co catumye hadahindura uburyohe, n’akamoto kaho ntikahindutse.
Ariko imisi iraje, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, aho nzorungika abagabo bazi gucuranura, kandi bazohacuranura; bazosiga imibindi yaho igaragara kandi bazomenagura imikuza yaho.
Nuko i Mowabu hazoteterwa ku bwa Kemoshi, nk’uko ab’inzu ya Isirayeli bateterewe igihe bizigira i Beteli.
Ni gute mushobora kuvuga muti: Turi abagwanyi, abahizi mu ntambara?
I Mowabu hazosamburwa n’ibisagara vyaho bizoterwa; abasore baho bezabeza bazomanukanwa gusogotwa inkota, ni ko Umwami, izina ryiwe ni Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avuze.
Ugusangangurwa kwa Mowabu kuri hafi; ivyago vyaho biraje vyihuta.
Nimuhagandarire, mwebwe mwese muhakikije, mwebwe mwese muzi icubahiro caho; muvuge muti: ‘Ese ingene inkoni yo kuganza gukomeye ivunaguwe, ese ingene inkoni y’ubwiza ivunaguwe!’
Ururuka muve mu bwiza bwanyu mwicare mu mukungugu, yemwe ababa ku mukobwa w’i Diboni, kuko uwuriko arasangangura Mowabu azoduga abashikire maze azohindura imisaka ibisagara vyanyu bizitijwe inzitiro.
Hagarara ku nzira maze mwirabire, mwebwe ababa i Aroweri. Mubaze umugabo ariko arahunga n’umugore ariko aranyaga amagara yiwe, mubabaze muti: Ni ibiki vyabaye?
I Mowabu harateterejwe, kuko hahinduwe amatongo. Boroga ushire induru ku munwa! Bimenyeshe uri kuri Arunoni ko i Mowabu hasanganguwe.
Amateka aciriwe uturambi, Holoni, Yahiza na Mefayati,
Diboni, Nebo na Beti-Dibulatayimu,
Kiriyatayimu, Beti-Gamuli na Beti-Meyoni,
Keriyoti na Bozira, ku bisagara vyose vy’i Mowabu, ivya hafi n’ivya kure.
Ihembe rya Mowabu rirakondotse; ukuboko kwaho kuravunitse, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nimuhaboreze, kuko hagararije Uhoraho . Mowabu nihitembagaze mu vyo hadashwe; maze hahinduke akamenyo.
Mbega ntiwashinyaguriye Isirayeli? Mbega bari bafashwe bariko bariba, ko wabazunguriza umutwe ubatwenga igihe cose wabavuga?
Nimuhebe ibisagara vyanyu maze muje kuba mu bitandara, mwebwe ababa i Mowabu. Mumere nk’inuma yiyubakira icari ku munwa w’igihomoka.
Twarumvise ubwibone bwa Mowabu, ubwibone bwiwe burenze urugero, ukwishira hejuru, ubwibone, ukwirata n’ukwidundarika kwo mu mutima wiwe.
Ndazi ukwishira hejuru kwiwe ariko ni ukw’ubusa, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, kandi ukwirata kwiwe nta co kumaze.
Ni co gituma mborogera Mowabu, kubera Abanyamowabu bose ndaboroga, ndagandaye kubera abantu b’i Kiru-Hareseti.
Ndakuririra nk’uko Yazeri arira, yemwe mizabibu y’i Sibuma. Amashami yawe yari asagaraye gushika ku kiyaga, yashika ku kiyaga c’i Yazeri. Uwutikiza yaguye ku mizabibu yawe yimbuwe.
Umunezero n’agahimbare biraheze mu mirima no mu gihugu c’i Mowabu. Mpagaritse ugutemba kw’umuvinyu mu bwato bugana; nta wukigana aririmbana umunezero. Naho hari akamo, si akamo k’umunezero.
Ijwi ryo kuboroga kwabo riduga riva i Heshiboni gushika i Eliyalehi n’i Yahazi, kuva i Zowari gushika i Horonayimu n’i Egulati-Shelishiya, kuko mbere n’amazi ya Nimurimu arakamye.
Nzoshira iherezo kuri Mowabu no ku batanga ibimazi ku mpinga z’imisozi bagaturirira ibimota neza imana zabo, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nuko umutima wanje ucura intimba ku bwa Mowabu kurya kw’ijwi ry’umwironge; ucura intimba nk’umwironge kubera abantu b’i Kiru-Hareseti. Ubutunzi bwegeranijwe buraheze.
Umutwe wose umowe inkomvorera kandi ubwanwa bwose buramowe; amaboko yose arikebaguye kandi urukenyerero rwose rwambaye igunira.
Hejuru ku mazu y’i Mowabu no mu bibanza bahuriramwo nta kindi kihari atari kugandara gusa, kuko menaguye Mowabu nk’umubindi abantu bose bazinutswe, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Ese ukuntu amenaguwe! Ese ukuntu baboroga! Ese ukuntu i Mowabu bahunze kandi bateterewe! Mowabu hahindutse ikimaramare, agaterantimba ku bantu bose bahakikije.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Raba! Inkona iriko irarara, ishanje amababa yayo hejuru ya Mowabu.
Keriyoti hazofatwa n’iminara izofatwa. Kuri uwo musi imitima y’abahizi b’i Mowabu izomera nk’umutima w’umugore ari ku gise.
Mowabu hazosamburwa nk’ihanga kuko bagararije Uhoraho .
Ibiteye ubwoba n’imanga n’umutego birabarindiriye, yemwe bantu b’i Mowabu, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Uwuzohunga ibiteye ubwoba azogwa mu manga, uwuzokwurira ngo ave mu manga azofatwa n’umutego; kuko nzoshitsa kuri Mowabu umwaka wo guhanwa kwaho, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Mu gitutu ca Heshiboni abahunze ni ho bahagaze batagira gitabara, kuko umuriro uvuye i Heshiboni, urubeya ruvuye muri Sihoni; ruturira ab’i Mowabu ku ruhanga, n’ubuhanga bw’abantu birata bayogora.
Uragowe, ewe Mowabu! Abantu ba Kemoshi bararanduwe; abana bawe bajanywe ari inyagano n’abakobwa bawe bajanywe mu kinyago.
Ariko nzosubira kwubaka Mowabu mu misi izoza,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Aho ni ho amateka ya Mowabu ahereye.

Ku vyerekeye Abamoni: Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Mbega Abisirayeli ntibari bafise abahungu? Mbega ntibari bafise abo kuraga? None ni kuki Moleki yigaruriye intara ya Gadi? Ni kuki abantu biwe baba mu bisagara vyaho?

Ariko, imisi iraje, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, aho nzovuza inzamba y’urugamba rwo kugwanya i Raba ho mu Bamoni; hazohinduka ikigunguzi c’isakamburira, kandi n’imihana ihakikuje izotongozwa umuriro. Maze Abisirayeli bazosohora abigeze kubasohora hanze, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Boroga, yewe Heshiboni, kuko Hayi hasanganguwe! Nimurire cane, yemwe bantu muba i Raba! Nimwambare amagunira mugandare; nimwiruke irya n’ino muri mu nzitiro; kuko Moleki izojanwa ari inyagano, hamwe n’abaherezi bayo n’abatware bayo.
Ni kuki mwishimira ibiyaya vyanyu, mukishimira ibiyaya vyanyu vyimbuka? Mukobwa Amoni utizigirwa, wizigira ubutunzi bwawe maze ukavuga ngo: ‘Ni nde yoza kungwanya?’
Nzoguteza ibiteye ubwoba bivuye mu mpande zose, ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze. Umwe wese muri mwebwe azojanwa, kandi nta n’umwe azokwegeranya abahunze.
Ariko, naho biri uko, nzosubira kwubaka Abamoni, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.”
Ku vyerekeye Edomu: uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Mbega nta bwenge bukiri i Temani? Mbega inama nziza yarahonye mu banyabwenge? Mbega ubwenge bwabo bwaguye ingese?
Hindukira uhunge, wihishe mu binogo birebire, wewe uba i Dedani, kuko nzozana icago kuri Esawu aho nzomuhanira.
Abimbuzi b’inzabibu baje kwimbura mw’itongo iwawe, mbega ntibasigaza dukeya? Ibisuma biguteye mw’ijoro, mbega ntivyokwiba ivyo bikeneye vyose?
Ariko jewe nzosiga Esawu ari gusa; nzokwerekana ibibanza yinyegezamwo, kandi ntazosubira kuronka aho yihisha. Abana biwe bazohona, hamwe n’abavukanyi biwe n’ababanyi biwe kandi ntazokwongera kubaho.
Siga impfuvyi zawe; nzokingira ubugingo bwazo. Kandi n’abapfakazi banyu bakwiye kunyizigira.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nimba abatari bakwiye kunywa ku gikombe bategerezwa kukinywako, ni kuki mwogenda mudahanywe? Ntimuzogenda mudahanywe, ariko muzotegerezwa kukinywako.
Indahiro ni jewe nyene,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “I Bozira hazohinduka umusaka kandi hazoba akabarore, n’aho kuvuzako agahwa no kuvumwa; kandi n’ibisagara vyaho bizoba imisaka ibihe bidashira.”
Numvise inkuru ivuye k’ Uhoraho kandi intumwa yatumwe ku mahanga kuyabwira iti: “Nimwegerane muhatere! Nimuhaguruke muje mu ntambara!”
“Ubu, ngiye kukugira muto mu yandi mahanga, ube inkengerwa mu bantu bose.

Gutera abantu ubwoba hamwe n’ubwibone bw’umutima wawe vyaraguhenze; wewe wibera mu myobo yo mu bitandara, ukagerera mu mataba y’imisozi miremire. Naho wokwarika icari cawe kure nk’inkona, nzokumanurayo, ndagukororere hasi ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Edomu hazotuma abantu bajugumira, abahaca bose bazohinda agashitsi bavuze agahwa kubera ibikomere vyaho.
Nk’uko Sodomu na Gomora hasambuwe, hamwe n’ibisagara vyari bihakikije, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ni ko ata muntu n’umwe azosubira kuhaba; nta bantu bazosubira kukibamwo.

Nk’uko intare iduga iva mu bibundo vya Yorodani ije gutera mu buragiro butotahaye, ni ko nzokwirukana Abanyedomu ndabakure mu gihugu cabo mu kanya isase. Ni nde yatoranijwe nzotuma kunkorera ivyo? Ni nde ameze nkanje kandi ni nde yompangara? Ni uwuhe mwungere yoza kumpagarara imbere?”

Nuko rero, nimwumve umugambi Uhoraho yateguye wo kugwanya Edomu, n’imigabo yagize yo kugwanya ababa i Temani: Imyagazi yo mu mikuku izojanwa; uburagiro bwabo buzoherengetezwa nk’uko vyashinzwe kuri bo.
Isi niyumva ugutemba kwabo izojugumira; ijwi ry’amaborogo yabo rizosamirana gushika ku Kiyaga Gitukura.
Raba! Inkona izoduga maze yarare, isanze amababa yayo kuri Bozira. Kuri uwo musi imitima y’abahizi ba Edomu izoba nk’umutima w’umugore ari ku gise.
Ku vyerekeye Damasiko: “Hamati na Arupadi batekewe n’ubwoba, kuko bumvise inkuru mbi. Bahagaritse umutima, babuze uburagamo nk’ikiyaga gisuriranya.
Damasiko hahindutse nk’umunyantegenke, hahindukiye inyuma harahunga kandi hafashwe n’ubwoba bwinshi; umubabaro n’agahinda birabafashe, uburibwe nk’ubw’umugore ari ku gise.
Ni kuki ico gisagara rurangiranwa kitahebwe, igisagara nanezererwa?
Ni ukuri, abasore baho bazogwa mu mabarabara; abasoda baho bose bazozibwa akanwa kuri uwo musi,” ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze.
“Nzodomeka inzitiro z’i Damasiko; maze umuriro uzotongora iminara ya Beni-Hadadi.”
Ku vyerekeye Kedari n’ubwami bw’i Hazori, ubwo Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni yateye: Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Haguruka, utere Kedari kandi uherengeteze abantu bo mu buseruko.
Amahema yabo n’imikuku yabo bizonyagwa; insago zabo zizonyagwa hamwe n’ibirimwo vyose n’ingamiya. Abantu bazokwiha akamo bati: Iterabwoba riri impande zose!
Hunga ningoga! Guma mu masenga, yemwe ababa i Hazori, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni yagiye inama yo kukugirira nabi; agufitiye umugambi mubi.
Haguruka utere ihanga ryari ryiraramiye, bari bazi ko bibereye mu mutekano, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, ihanga ritagira amarembo canke imyugariro; abantu baho bibera ukwabo.
Ingamiya zabo zizoba isahu, amasho yabo manini azoba iminyago y’intambara. Nzosanzariza mu birere vyose abimosha ibimwerere kandi nzobateza ivyago bivuye mu mpande zose, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Hazori hazoba ikirimbiro ry’imbwebwe, ahantu h’ubugaragwa ibihe vyose. Nta muntu n’umwe azoba akihaba; nta bantu bazongera kuhaba.”
Iri ni ijambo Uhoraho yatumye kuri Yeremiya uwavugishwa n’Imana ryerekeye Elamu, mu ntango y’ingoma ya Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda:
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Raba, nzovuna umuheto wa Elamu, ari wo nkomezi zabo.
Nzoteza Elamu imiyaga ine ivuye mu mfuruka zine z’amajuru; nzobasanzaza ku miyaga ine, kandi nta hanga na rimwe ritazojamwo abahunze bava i Elamu.
Nzosanzaza Elamu imbere y’abansi babo, imbere y’abipfuza kubica; nzobateza ivyago, ndetse n’uburake bwanje bw’inkazi, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Nzobakinagiza n’inkota kugeza ndabaherengeteje.
Nzoshinga intebe yanje y’ubwami i Elamu ndandure umwami waho n’abatware baho, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Ariko nzosubira kwubaka Elamu mu misi izoza, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.”
Iri ni ijambo Uhoraho yavugiye mu kanwa k’uwo yavugisha Yeremiya ryerekeye Babiloni n’igihugu c’Abanyababiloni:

“Menyesha kandi wamamaze mu mahanga yose, duza ibendera kandi uvyamamaze, ntihagire ico usiga, ariko uvuge uti: ‘Babiloni hazofatwa, Beli hazomaramazwa, Mariduki huzure ubwoba. Ibishushanyo vyaho bizomaramazwa n’ibigirwamana vyaho bije mu gatengo.
Ihanga riturutse mu buraruko rizohatera risige igihugu ari amatongo. Nta muntu n’umwe azoba akihaba; abantu n’ibikoko bizohahunga vyose.’
Muri iyo misi, kandi muri ico gihe, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, abantu b’i Bwisirayeli n’abantu b’i Buyuda bose hamwe bazogenda barira baja kurondera Uhoraho Imana yabo.
Bazobaririkiza inzira ija i Siyoni maze bayihindukirire bayijane. Bazoza bunamire Uhoraho bari mw’isezerano ritazoshira ritazokwigera ryibagirwa.
Abantu banje babaye intama zizimiye, abungere babo barabazimije batuma bangarira ku misozi. Bangariye ku misozi no ku mirambi bibagira uburuhukiro bwabo.
Uwababonye wese yarabashihaguye; abansi babo baravuze bati: ‘Nta caha twagirizwa, kuko bacumuye k’ Uhoraho , uburuhukiro bwabo bw’ukuri, Uhoraho ivyizigiro vya ba sekuruza.’
Nimuhunge muve i Babiloni; nimuve mu gihugu c’Abanyababiloni, maze mumere nk’impene zirongora umukuku.

Kuko nzovyura kandi ngateza Babiloni amahanga ahambaye yishize hamwe aturutse mu gihugu co mu buraruko. Bazobundira kuhatera, kandi hazofatwa n’abaturutse mu buraruko. Imyampi yabo izoba imeze nk’abahizi b’abahinga badasubira inyuma imbokoboko.
Nuko Babiloni hazonyagwa; abazobanyaga bose bazokwegeranya buzuze, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Kubera ko munezerewe kandi muhimbawe, mwebwe mwanyaze ishamvu yanje, kubera ko mwikina amatavu nk’inyana mu bwatsi butotahaye kandi muvuza akamo nk’amafarasi;
nyoko azoteterwa; uwakwibarutse azoterwa n’isoni. Azoba uwo hanyuma mu mahanga, ubugaragwa, igihugu cumye, n’ubweranyange.
Kubera uburake bw’Uhoraho, nta wuzoshobora kuhaba, ariko hazoba ari agahinga gusa. Abazoca i Babiloni bose bazofatwa n’ubwoba kandi bazokwitwengera kubera ibikomere vyaho.
Nimukikuze Babiloni, yemwe mwese mufoye imiheto. Nimuharase! Ntimuziganye imyampi, kuko hacumuye k’ Uhoraho .
Nimuhahe akamo ku mpande zose! Haratanze imihoho, iminara yaho iraguye, inzitiro zaho zihomvokeye hasi. Kubera ko ari uguhora kw’ Uhoraho , nimuhihore; nimuhakorere nk’uko hakoreye abandi.
Nimukure i Babiloni uwubiba imbuto, n’uwukoresha umuhoro mu gihe c’iyimbura. Kubera inkota y’uwucinyiza umuntu wese nasubire mu bwoko bwiwe, umuntu wese nahungire mu gihugu ciwe.
Isirayeli ni umukuku wasanzaye uwo intambwe zahize. Uwa mbere yawushihaguye ni umwami w’i Ashuri; uwa nyuma yawuvunaguye amagufa ni Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni.”
Nuko uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: “Nzohana umwami w’i Babiloni n’igihugu ciwe nk’uko nahanye umwami w’i Ashuri.
Ariko nzogarukana Isirayeli mu buragiro bwiwe azorisha kuri Karumeli n’i Bashani; azoshira inzara ari ku misozi ya Efurayimu n’i Gileyadi.

Muri iyo misi, muri ico gihe,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “bazorondera ivyo gutsindisha Isirayeli, ariko ntihazoboneka na kimwe, barondere n’ivyaha vya Yuda, ariko nta na kimwe kizoboneka, kuko nzoharira amasigarira nzoziguriza.
Nimutere igihugu ca Meratayimu n’ababa i Pekodi. Nimubakurikire, mubice kandi mubaherengeteze,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Nimukore ivyo nabageze vyose.
Akaruru k’intambara kari mu gihugu, ijwi ryo gusambuka gukomeye!
Mbega ukuntu isambutse igacika ubunywenye ya nyundo yahonda isi yose! Ese ukuntu Babiloni habaye amatongo mu yandi mahanga!
Naguteze umutego, yewe Babiloni, maze ufatwa utarabimenya; bagusanzeho baragufata kuko wagwanije Uhoraho .
Uhoraho yuguruye ububiko bwiwe bw’ibigwanisho, asohora ibigwanisho vy’uburake bwiwe, kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose afise ico ashaka gukora mu gihugu c’Abanyababiloni.
Nimuze kumugwanya muvuye kure. Nimumene ibigega vyiwe; nimuharundanye nk’ibigunguzi vy’imiganda y’ingano. Nimuhasangangure ntimuhasige n’umwe w’amasigarira.
Nimwice amashuri yaho yose; nibamanuke baje ku macuniro! Baragowe! Kuko umusi wabo ushitse, igihe cabo co guhanwa.
Nimwumvirize abahunga hamwe n’impunzi zivuye i Babiloni bavugira i Siyoni ingene Uhoraho Imana yacu yahoye, ahora Ingoro yiwe.

“Tumako abanyamiheto baze kugwanya Babiloni, abo bose bitwaje imiheto. Nimuhakikuze; ntihagire uwubacika. Nimuhasubirize mu nkoko ivyo hakoze; nimuhakorere nk’ivyo hakoze. Kuko hagararije Uhoraho , Uwera wa Isirayeli.
Ni co gituma, abasore baho bazogwa mu mabarabara; abasoda baho bose bazozibwa akanwa kuri uwo musi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
“Ehe, ndakugwanya, wa munyabwibone we,” ni ko Umwami, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avuze, “kuko umusi wawe ushitse, igihe cawe co guhanwa.
Uwibona azotsitara agwe hasi kandi nta wuzomuvyura. Nzodomeka umuriro mu bisagara vyaho uzotongora ahantu hose hahakikije.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Abisirayeli baracinyijwe, n’Abayuda ni uko nyene. Ababafashe mpiri bose barabagumije, banse kubarekura.
Ariko umucunguzi wabo arakomeye; Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo zina ryiwe. Azobagwanira bikomeye kugira ngo ahe akaruhuko igihugu cabo, ariko azobuza uburagamo ababa i Babiloni.
Inkota ije kugwanya Abanyababiloni!” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, kugwanya ababa i Babiloni no kugwanya abaganwa baho n’abanyabwenge baho!
Inkota ije kugwanya abavugishwa baho b’ibinyoma! Bazoba ibipfu. Inkota ije kugwanya abahizi baho! Bazofatwa n’ubwoba.
Inkota ije kugwanya amafarasi n’imikogote yaho n’abanyamahanga bivanze na bo! Bazohinduka abanyantegenke. Inkota ije kugwanya ubutunzi bwaho! Buzonyagwa.
Uruzuba ruziye amazi yaho! Azokama. Kuko ari igihugu c’ibigirwamana, ibigirwamana bizogwara mu mutwe kubera ibiteye ubwoba.
Ni co gituma ibikoko vyo mu bugaragwa n’imfyisi bizokwiberaho, n’ibinyoni vyitwa otirishe bizohagira inzu yavyo. Ntihazosubira kuba abantu canke ngo bahabe uhereye ku runganwe ugashika ku rundi.
Nk’uko nasambuye Sodomu na Gomora hamwe n’ibisagara vyari bihakikije, ni ko Uhoraho ivuze, ni ko ata muntu n’umwe azosubira kuhaba; nta bantu bazosubira kukibamwo.
Raba! Ingabo ziraje zivuye mu gihugu co mu buraruko; ihanga rikomeye n’abami benshi barahagurutse bavuye ku mpera z’isi.

Bitwaje imiheto n’amacumu; bateye ubwoba kandi ni ba ruburakigongwe. Akamo kabo, bariko bariruka ku mafarasi yabo, ni nk’ukubomborana kw’ikiyaga gisuriranya. Baje kurya kw’abagabo bariko barimenyereza intambara ngo bagutere, yewe mukobwa w’i Babiloni.
Umwami w’i Babiloni yumvise inkuru zabo, amaboko yiwe yaciye acika inkokora. Umubabaro uramufata, umubabaro nk’urya w’umugore ariko aravyara.

Nk’uko intare iduga iva mu bibundo vya Yorodani ije gutera mu buragiro butotahaye, ni ko nzokwirukana ab’i Babiloni ndabakure mu gihugu cabo mu kanya isase. Ni nde yatoranijwe nzotuma kunkorera ivyo? Ni nde ameze nkanje kandi ni nde yompangara? Kandi ni uwuhe mwungere yoza kumpagarara imbere?

Nuko rero, nimwumve umugambi Uhoraho yateguye wo kugwanya Babiloni, n’imigabo yagize yo kugwanya igihugu c’Abanyababiloni: Imyagazi yo mu mikuku izojanwa; uburagiro bwabo buzoherengetezwa nk’uko vyashinzwe kuri bo.
Isi niyumva urwamo rw’ugufatwa kwa Babiloni izojugumira; ijwi ry’amaborogo yaho rizosamirana mu mahanga.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Raba, nzokabura impwemu y’uwuhonya ngo atere Babiloni n’abantu b’i Lebi Kamayi.
Nzotuma abanyamahanga kuri Babiloni ngo bahagosore kandi batabagure igihugu caho; bazohatera baturutse ku mpande zose ku musi w’ivyago vyaho.
Ntimureke umurashi ngo afore umuheto wiwe, canke ngo mumwemerere kwambara ibigwanisho vyiwe. Ntimuzigurize abasore baho; nimusangangure ingabo zaho.
Bazogwa basogoswe inkota i Babiloni, bazokomereka uruguma rwo kubica bari mu mabarabara yaho.
Kuko Isirayeli na Yuda batahebwe n’Imana yabo, Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, naho igihugu cabo cuzuye ivyaha mu nyonga z’Uwera w’Abisirayeli.
Nimuhunge muve i Babiloni! Nimwiruke mukize amagara yanyu! Ntimupfe muzize ivyaha vyaho. Ni igihe co guhora kw’ Uhoraho ; azohasubiriza mu nkoko ibihakwiye.
Babiloni hari hameze nk’igikombe c’inzahabu mu kiganza c’ Uhoraho ; haboreje isi yose. Amahanga yaborewe umuvinyu waho; ni co gituma yataye umutwe.
Babiloni hazogwa giturumbuka kandi hazomenagurika. Nimuhaborogere! Nimuharonderere umuti wo kuhatimbura; kumbure hokira.
Twari kuvura Babiloni, ariko ntihashobora kuvurwa; reka tuhave umwe wese yigire mu gihugu ciwe, kuko amateka yaho yashikiriye ibicu, kandi akaba yaduze agashikira amajuru.
Uhoraho araduhoye; nimuze tuvugire i Siyoni ivyo Uhoraho Imana yacu yakoze.
Nimusongore imyampi yanyu, muhitane inkinzo zanyu! Uhoraho yakabuye abami b’Abamedi, kuko umugambi wiwe ari uwo kurandura Babiloni. Uhoraho azohora, azohorera Ingoro yiwe.
Nimuduze ibendera ryo kugwanya inzitiro z’i Babiloni! Ongereza abarinzi, shiraho abateramyi, nimutegure imitego! Uhoraho azoshitsa umugambi wiwe, ivyo yategetse ku bantu b’i Babiloni.
Wewe uba i ruhande y’amazi menshi kandi ufise ubutunzi bwinshi, iherezo ryawe rirashitse, n’igihe cawe co kugesezwa.
Uhoraho Mushoboravyose yirahiye ati: Nzokwuzuzamwo ingabo zimeze kurya kw’inzige, kandi zizokwiha akamo ko kukunesha.
Yaremye isi mu bushobozi bwayo; iremesha isi ubwenge bwayo, yagura amajuru mu gutahura kwayo.
Iyo ituragaye, amazi yo hejuru aca abomborana; ituma ibicu biduga biva ku mpera z’isi. Irungika umuravyo n’imvura, igasohora umuyaga iwukuye mu bubiko bwayo.
Umuntu wese ni ikijuju nta bwenge agira, umucuzi w’inzahabu wese naterwe isoni n’ibigirwamana vyiwe. Kuko ibishushanyo vyiwe ari ibinyoma gusa; nta mpwemu y’ubuzima iri muri vyo.
Nta co bimaze, ni ivyo gukengerwa gusa; igihe c’urubanza rwavyo nicashika, bizohona.
Ariko wa wundi, we mugabane wa Yakobo, ntameze nka vyo, kuko ari Umuremyi w’ibintu vyose, harimwo n’abantu yagize inyegu yiwe. Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo zina ryiwe.
Wambereye inkota, n’ikigwanisho c’intambara, ni wewe nasanganguje amahanga, ni wewe nasambuje ubwami,
ni wewe nasanganguje ifarasi n’uwuyigenderako, ni wewe nasanganguje umukogote n’uwuwutwara;
ni wewe natabaguje umugabo n’umugore, ni wewe natabaguje umutama n’umusore, ni wewe natabaguje umusore n’inkumi,
ni wewe natabaguje umwungere n’umukuku, ni wewe natabaguje umurimyi n’inka zirima, ni wewe natabaguje abarongozi n’abatware.
Imbere y’amaso yanyu nzosubiriza mu nkoko Babiloni n’ababa mu Bukaludaya bose ibibi bakoze i Siyoni, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Mfise ico dupfa nawe, yewe wa musozi uhonya, wewe uhonya isi yose, ni ko Uhoraho avuze. Nzogororera ukuboko kwanje kukugwanya, nzogutembagaza ndagukuye hejuru y’ibitandara, ndaguhindure nk’umusozi waturiwe.
Nta buye na rimwe rizokurwa kuri wewe ngo ribe irigumya imfuruka, canke ibuye na rimwe ryo kwubaka itanguriro, kuko uzoba uri nk’ubugaragwa ibihe vyose, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.

Nimuduze ibendera mu gihugu! Nimuvuze inzamba mu mahanga yose! Nimutegure amahanga aje kuhagwanya; tumako ubu bwami buze kuhagwanya: Ararati, Mini na Ashikenazi. Nimushinge umukuru w’ingabo aze kuhatera; nimurungike amafarasi ameze nk’igitero c’inzige.
Nimutegurire amahanga intambara yo kuhagwanya, abami b’Abamedi, abategetsi babo n’abatware babo bose, n’ibihugu vyose baganza.
Igihugu kirajugumira kandi cuzuye ubwoba, kuko imigambi yo kukigwanya Uhoraho yakigeneye itazohinduka, kugira ngo Babiloni hasigare ari agahinga, ata muntu n’umwe agishobora kuhaba.
Abahizi b’i Babiloni baretse kugwana; bagumye mu bibundo bikomeye vyabo. Inkomezi zabo zaheze; babaye nk’abagore. Amazu yaho yadometswe n’umuriro; ibihindizo vyo ku marembo yaho vyavunaguwe.
Abazanye inkuru barakurakuranwa umwe akurikira uwundi ngo bamenyeshe umwami w’i Babiloni ko igisagara caho cose cafashwe,
amajabukiro y’uruzi yafashwe, inkombe z’uruzi zaturiwe, abasoda batekewe n’ubwoba.”
Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze: “Umukobwa w’i Babiloni ameze nk’imbuga yo kugosorerako ingano mu gihe co kuyisiribanga; igihe co kuhimbura kigira gishike.”

“Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni yaradushihaguye, yadutaye mu kuzazanirwa, yaduhinduye nk’umubindi ugaragara. Nk’uko inzoka imira miyonzwa, ni ko yatumize ataduhekenye yujuje inda yiwe ivyiza vyacu, maze adushiburira hanze.
Icoduha ubwicanyi bwabaye kuri twebwe bugashika kuri Babiloni,” ni ko ababa i Siyoni bavuga. “Ese amaraso yacu yoba ku baba i Babiloni,” ni ko Yerusalemu bavuga.
Nuko rero, uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Raba, nzobaburanira kandi nzobahora; nzokamya ikiyaga cabo n’amasoko yaho nzoyakamya.
Babiloni hazoba imisaka, ahaba imbwebwe, akabarore n’aho gucokorwa, ahantu ata muntu akihaba.
Abantu baho baroha nk’imikangara y’intambwe, bivuga nk’ivyana vy’intambwe bikiri bito.
Ariko aho bamaze kururumba, nzobategurira umusi mukuru ndababoreze, kugira ngo bashire urwamo hejuru batwenga, hanyuma bazosinzira ubutikoma ibihe vyose,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Nzobamanukana nk’imyagazi y’intama ijanwa kwicwa, nk’impfizi z’intama n’impene.
Ese ukuntu Sheshaki hazofatwa, ukwirata kw’isi yose kurafashwe! Ese ukuntu Babiloni hazoba akabarore mu mahanga yose!
Ikiyaga kizohagurukira Babiloni; imipfunda yaco ibomborana izohatwikira.
Ibisagara vyaho bizocika ubweranyange, isi yumye y’ubugaragwa, igihugu ata n’umwe akibamwo, ata muntu n’umwe agicamwo.
Nzohana Beli h’i Babiloni nzotuma hadahwa ivyo hamize. Amahanga ntazosubira kuhirukira. Kandi inzitiro z’i Babiloni zizosenyuka.
Nimusohoke muveyo, yemwe bantu banje! Nimuhunge mukize amagara yanyu! Nimuhunge uburake bw’inkazi bw’ Uhoraho .
Ntimuzocike intege canke ngo mugire ubwoba aho muzokwumvira ibihuha mu gihugu; igihuha kimwe kiza uwu mwaka, ikindi mu mwaka uza, ibihuha vy’ubwicanyi mu gihugu n’ivy’uwuganza agwanya uwundi.
Kuko igihe kizogera vy’ukuri aho nzohana ibigirwamana vy’i Babiloni, igihugu caho cose kizoteterwa, kandi abishwe baho bazorambarara mu mabarabara.
Maze ijuru n’isi n’ibiri muri vyo vyose bizovuza akamo k’umunezero ku bwa Babiloni, kuko mu buraruko ni ho hazova abahonya bo kuhatera, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
I Babiloni hazofatwa mpiri kubera ubwicanyi bakoze mu Bisirayeli, n’ubwo bakoze mw’isi yose ni ko bizomera no kuri Babiloni.
Wewe wakize inkota, va ngaha ntutebagane! Wibuke Uhoraho uri mu gihugu ca kure, kandi wiyumvire kuri Yerusalemu.
Turateterewe, kuko twaratutswe isoni ziratwishe, kuko abanyamahanga binjiye ahera h’Ingoro y’Uhoraho.
Ariko imisi iraje, ni ko Uhoraho avuze, aho nzohana ibigirwamana vyaho, kandi mu gihugu cose abakomeretse bazoboroga.
Naho Babiloni hoshika kw’ijuru hagakomeza inzitiro zaho, nzorungika abo kuhasambura, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Ijwi ry’ugutaka rije riva i Babiloni, ijwi ry’ugutikiza gukomeye riva mu gihugu c’Abanyababiloni.
Uhoraho azosambura i Babiloni; azozivya akanwa kavuza urwamo. Imipfunda y’abansi izosuriranya nk’amazi menshi; ugusuriranya kwayo kuzokwumvikana.
Uwutikiza azoza ku bwa Babiloni; abahizi baho bazofatwa mpiri, n’imiheto yabo izovunagurwa. Kuko Uhoraho ari Imana ihora; azobasubiriza mu nkoko ibihwanye n’ivyo bakoze.
Nzoboreza abatware n’abanyabwenge baho, abatware baho, abakuru n’abagwanyi baho na bo; bazosinzira ubutikoma ibihe bidashira, ni ko Umwami, izina ryiwe ni Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, avuze.

Uku ni ko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose avuze: “Uruzitiro rw’intimba nini rw’i Babiloni ruzosamburwa rwose n’amarembo yaho maremare azoturirwa. Abantu biruhiriza ubusa, ubutame bw’amahanga buzoba ibitoro vy’imbeya z’umuriro.”
Ubu ni bwo butumwa Yeremiya yahaye umukuru w’abakozi Seraya mwene Neriya, mwene Mahaseya, igihe yaja i Babiloni ari kumwe na Zedekiya umwami w’i Buyuda mu mwaka ugira kane ari ku ngoma.
Yeremiya yari yanditse igitabu kirimwo ivyago bizoshika kuri Babiloni, ivyari vyaranditswe vyerekeye Babiloni.
Abwira Seraya ati: “Niwashika i Babiloni, uze witwararike gusomerayo aya majambo yose n’ijwi rirenga.
Maze uze uvuge uti: ‘Yewe Uhoraho , waravuze ko uzosangangura aha hantu, ku buryo ata muntu canke igikoko kizoshobora kuhaba; hazoba agahinga ibihe vyose.’
Maze niwaheza gusoma iki gitabu, uze ugihambirireko ibuye maze ugiterere mu ruzi Efurate.
Hanyuma uvuge uti: ‘Uko ni ko Babiloni hazonyika ubutakigaruka kubera ivyago nzohateza, kandi abantu baho bazohona.’ ” Amajambo ya Yeremiya agarukiye aha.
Zedekiya yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’umwe igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka cumi n’umwe ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Hamutali mwene Yeremiya w’i Libuna.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko Yehoyakimu yakoze.
Ivyo vyose vyashikiye Yerusalemu n’Ubuyuda kubera uburake bw’Uhoraho bwari bwaziririnze, akirukana abantu biwe mu maso hiwe. Maze Zedekiya agarariza umwami w’i Babiloni.

Nuko, mu mwaka ugira icenda Zedekiya ari ku ngoma, ku musi ugira cumi w’ukwezi kw’icumi, Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni aja gutera Yerusalemu ajanye n’ingabo ziwe zose. Bacumbika inyuma y’igisagara, bacubakira ivyo kwuririrako ku mpande zose.
Igisagara kiguma cugarijwe gushika mu mwaka ugira cumi na rimwe Zedekiya ari ku ngoma.
Ku musi ugira icenda w’ukwezi kwa kane inzara iba nyinshi mu gisagara gushika aho abantu babura ico batamira.

Nuko uruzitiro rw’igisagara bararusatura, maze ingabo zose zirahunga. Bava mu gisagara mw’ijoro baca mw’irembo riri hagati y’ibihome bibiri hafi y’umurima w’umwami, naho Abanyababiloni bari bakikuje igisagara. Bahunga berekeye ikiyaya ca Yorodani citwa Araba,
Ariko ingabo z’Abanyababiloni zikurikira umwami Zedekiya zimufatira mu kiyaya c’i Yeriko. Abasoda biwe bose baramuta, barasanzara.
Nuko na we aca arafatwa, bamujana ku mwami w’i Babiloni yari i Ribula mu ntara y’i Hamati, aca amucira urubanza aho nyene.
Umwami w’i Babiloni yicira abahungu ba Zedekiya mu maso yiwe; yongera yica n’abatware bose b’i Buyuda akiri aho nyene i Ribula.
Aca anogora amaso Zedekiya, amubohesha iminyororo y’umwakaka, aca amujana i Babiloni, amushira mw’ibohero kugeza umusi yapfiriyeko.

Ku musi ugira icumi w’ukwezi kwa gatanu, mu mwaka ugira icumi n’icenda Nebukadineza ari umwami w’i Babiloni, ni ho Nebuzaradani umukuru w’ingabo zo ku kirimba, akaba n’umwishikira w’umwami w’i Babiloni, yashika i Yerusalemu.
Aturira Ingoro y’Uhoraho, ikirimba c’umwami, hamwe n’ayandi mazu yose yari i Yerusalemu. Inyubakwa zose zihambaye zo mu gisagara araziturira.
Abasoda bose b’i Babiloni bari barongowe n’uwo mukuru w’ingabo zo ku kirimba, baraza basenyura inzitiro zose z’i Yerusalemu.
Nebuzaradani, umukuru w’abasoda bo ku kirimba, ajana mu kinyago bamwe mu bakene, hamwe n’abari bagisigaye mu gisagara, abanyamyuga hamwe n’abari barishikanye ku mwami w’i Babiloni.
Ariko Nebuzaradani asiga bamwe mu bakene bo mu gihugu ngo bakorere imizabibu n’imirima.
Abanyababiloni basenyura za nkingi z’umwakaka hamwe na ca gikarabiro c’umwakaka n’ivyo cari giteretseko vyari mu Ngoro y’Uhoraho, batwara n’umwakaka wabo wose i Babiloni.
Batwara n’udukono two kuyoreramwo umunyota, ivyo kuyoza umunyota, ibikombe, amabesani, amapanu, hamwe n’ibindi bikoresho vyose vy’umwakaka, vyakoreshwa mu Ngoro.

Uwo mukuru w’abasoda bo ku kirimba atwara ibikoresho vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu nziza vyose no mw’ifeza, harimwo amabesani, ivyo guturirirako ibimota neza, inkono, ibiterekwako amatara, amasahani n’ibikombe vyakoreshwa mu gutanga amashikanwa y’ibinyobwa.

Umwakaka wavuye muri za nkingi zibiri, ca gikarabiro bita ikiyaga na ya mashuri icumi n’abiri acuzwe mu mwakaka yari musi yaco, na vya bitereko biterurwa, ivyo umwami Salomo yari yarakoze ngo bibe ivyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , vyari biremereye cane ku buryo bitashobora gupimwa ku munzane.

Inkingi imwe yose yapima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi n’umunani z’uburebure n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi na zibiri zo kuzunguruka; imwimwe yose yari ikirohori, kandi yari ifise intimbatimba ingana n’isantimetero umunani.

Umwashi w’umwakaka wari hejuru y’inkingi imwe wareha n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitanu z’uburebure ukaba usharijweko amakomamanga y’umwakaka awukikuje. Ku yindi nkingi, hari uwundi ufise amakomamanga yawo nk’uko nyene.
Amakomamanga mirongo icenda ku mpande, igitigiri cose c’amakomamanga cari hejuru ya rwa rusobekerane cari ijana.
Uwo mukuru w’abasoda bo ku kirimba agira imbohe Seraya umuherezi mukuru, Zefaniya umuherezi wa kabiri hamwe n’abarinzi b’irembo batatu.

Mu bari basigaye mu gisagara, atwara intwazangabo yatwara abasoda baja ku rugamba hamwe n’abahanuzi indwi b’umwami, atwara n’umunyamabanga yari ajejwe kwinjiza abantu mu gisoda, hamwe n’abandi bantu mirongo itandatu yasanze mu gisagara hagati.
Iyo ntwazangabo Nebuzaradani ica ifata ba bantu bose ibashira umwami w’i Babiloni i Ribula.
Aca abicira aho nyene i Ribula mu ntara y’i Hamati. Uko ni ko Abayuda batwawe mu kinyago, bakurwa mu gihugu cabo.
Iki ni co gitigiri c’abantu Nebukadineza yajanye ari inyagano: mu mwaka ugira indwi, Abayuda ibihumbi bitatu na mirongo ibiri na batatu;
Mu mwaka ugira icumi n’umunani Nebukadineza ari ku ngoma, abavuye i Yerusalemu bari amajana umunani na mirongo itatu na babiri;

mu mwaka wiwe wa mirongo ibiri na gatatu, Abayuda amajana indwi na mirongo ine na batanu bajanywe ari inyagano na Nebuzaradani umukuru w’ingabo zarinda umwami. Bose hamwe bari ibihumbi bine n’amajana atandatu.

Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu n’indwi Yehoyakini umwami w’i Buyuda ari mu kinyago, umwaka Evili-Merodaki yimikiwemwo ngo abe umwami w’i Babiloni, ku musi wa mirongo ibiri na gatanu w’ukwezi kw’icumi na kabiri, ni ho yarekura Yehoyakini ava mw’ibohero.
Amufata neza, amuha n’ikibanza c’icubahiro gisumba ivy’abandi bami bari kumwe na we i Babiloni.
Nuko Yehoyakini ntiyasubira kwambara impuzu z’imbohe, kandi yama asangira n’umwami ku meza yiwe imisi yose yari asigaje y’ukubaho kwiwe.
Umwami w’i Babiloni yama aha Yehoyakini ku musi ku musi ivyo kumutunga imisi yose yari akiriho, kugeza ku musi yapfiriyeko.
